local local_class = newclass('Buoy')

--- 생성자
--- @param data_path string 해당 기믹이 사용할 Data의 경로.
--- @param data_key string 해당 기믹이 사용할 Data의 Key.
--- @param cs_behaviour any 해당 기믹의 C# Behaviour.
function local_class:init(data_path, data_key, cs_behaviour)
	self.cs_behaviour = cs_behaviour

	-- 기믹 데이터
	data_key = lua_helper.get_or_default(data_key, 'default')
	if data_key == '' then
		data_key = 'default'
	end

	self.data = load_util.load_lua_gimmick_data(data_path, data_key)

	-- 리셋 스위치 이름
	self.reset_switch_names = lua_helper.get_or_default(self.data.reset_switch_names, { 'resetSwitch' })

	self.buoy_type = {
		buoy = 1,
		switch = 2,
		brazier = 3
	}

	-- 현재 부표 타입
	self.current_type = self.buoy_type[self.data.type]

	self.buoy_state = {
		-- 기본 상태
		idle = {},
		moving = {
			update = self.update_moving_state,
			time_passed = 0,
			start_height = nil,
			end_height = nil,
			duration = 1
		},
		-- 밀리는 상태
		pushing = {
			update = self.update_pushing_state
		}
	}

	self.current_buoy_state = self.buoy_state.idle

	--region push 관련
	-- 푸쉬 상태
	self.push_state = {
		stopped = 1,
		pushing = 2,
		move_remain_distance = 3
	}

	-- 현재 푸쉬 상태
	self.current_push_state = nil

	-- 푸쉬에 사용되는 변수
	self.pushed_direction = nil
	self.target_pos = nil

	-- 해당 오브젝트를 미는 fo
	self.pusher = nil
	--endregion

	--region switch 관련
	-- 스위치를 누르고 있는 ifo 리스트
	self.pressing_obj = nil

	-- 스위치 눌린 상태 표현을 위한 스위치 transform
	self.button_transform = nil
	self.button_on_pos = unity_class.vector3.down * 0.08
	self.button_off_pos = unity_class.vector3.zero

	self.only_for_manual_character = lua_helper.get_or_default(self.data.only_for_manual_character, false)

	self.is_turned_on = false
	--endregion
end

-- IFO에 붙었을 때
function local_class:attach_to(fo)
	self.fo = fo

	self.cs_behaviour:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))
	self.cs_behaviour:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.ResetSwitchTurnedOnEvent))

	-- 리셋을 위한 초기값
	self.default_pos = self.fo.Position

	-- 현재 떠 있는지
	self.is_flying = false

	-- 부표 mesh transform
	if self.current_type == self.buoy_type.brazier then
		self.mesh_transform = self.fo.Transform:Find('buoy_brazier')
	else
		self.mesh_transform = self.fo.Transform:Find('mesh')
	end

	if self.current_type == self.buoy_type.switch then
		self.button_transform = self.mesh_transform:Find('switch2')
	end

	self.pressing_obj = {}

	-- 푸쉬 상태 초기화
	self.current_push_state = self.push_state.stopped
	self.pushed_direction = CS.Oak.Direction.None

	local bounds = self.fo.Bounds
	self.bounds_size_x = math.floor(bounds.size.x + 0.5)
	self.bounds_size_z = math.floor(bounds.size.z + 0.5)

	-- 물 찼을 때 막을 벽 생성
	self.walls = {}
	for _ = 1, self.bounds_size_x * 2 + self.bounds_size_z * 2 do
		local wall = field_object_util.create_virtual_field_object(self.fo.Position,
			{ crash_behaviour = CS.Oak.PassHoldableCrashBehaviour.Instance, active_state = 'disabled' })
		table.insert(self.walls, wall)
	end

	-- 기본 상태로 변경
	self.cs_behaviour:ChangeState(CS.Oak.FieldObjectIdleState.Instance)

	self:change_state(self.buoy_state.idle)
end

-- IFO에서 떨어졌을 때
function local_class:detach_from(fo)
end

--- LuaMessageSystem(message_system)을 이용하여 콜백을 등록하였을 경우 이 곳에서 해제하여야 한다.
--- detach_from의 경우 LuaMessageSystem이 이미 날아간 상태이기 때문에 Leak발생함.
function local_class:dispose()
	self.cs_behaviour:UnSubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))
	self.cs_behaviour:UnSubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.ResetSwitchTurnedOnEvent))

	self.fo = nil
	self.cs_behaviour = nil
end

-- 현재 기본 스테이트 얻기(아이들, 걷기 등 전신 및 하체 상태)
function local_class:current_state()
	return nil
end

-- 현재 IFO가 취하고 있는 액션
function local_class:current_action()
	if lua_helper.type_compare(self.cs_behaviour.CurrentState, CS.Oak.FieldObjectMoveState) or
		self.current_push_state == self.push_state.pushing or
		self.current_push_state == self.push_state.move_remain_distance then

		return CS.Oak.FieldObjectAction.Moving
	end

	return CS.Oak.FieldObjectAction.Stopped
end

--region event
-- 이벤트 호출
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.GetPushedStartEvent) then
		self.pusher = e.Pusher

		if self.current_push_state == self.push_state.move_remain_distance then
			return true
		end

		self.pushed_direction = e.Pusher.Direction

		local target_dist = 1
		local direction = direction_util.to_4way_vector3(self.pushed_direction)

		self.target_pos = self.fo.Position + direction * target_dist

		self.current_push_state = self.push_state.pushing
		self.fo.Pushable:StartPushedBy(e.Pusher)

		self:change_state(self.buoy_state.pushing)

		return true
	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.PushMoveStartEvent) then
		if self.current_push_state == self.push_state.move_remain_distance then
			return true
		end

		-- sfx 처리
		music_player_util.play_sfx({
			sfx_name = '01_push_rock_unit_01',
			parent = self.fo,
			type_priority = sfx_type_priority.gimmick,
			player_priority = sfx_player_priority.object
		})

		return true
	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.GetPushedEndEvent) then
		if self.current_push_state == self.push_state.move_remain_distance then
			return true
		end

		self.fo.Pushable:EndPushedBy(e.Pusher)
		self:check_remain_distance(self.pushed_direction)

		return true
	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.PushBlockedEvent) then
		self.current_push_state = self.push_state.stopped
		return true
	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.MoveBlockedEvent) then
		-- 미는데 던질 수 있는 오브젝트랑 충돌하면 던지는 오브젝트 초기화
		-- 해당 기믹이 무조건 유닛 단위로 움직이기 위함
		if e.Blocker and lua_helper.type_compare(e.Blocker.Holdable, CS.Oak.Holdable) then
			message_system:SendSync(e.Blocker.FieldObjectBehaviour, CS.Oak.GimmickResetEvent.Instance)
		else
			self.current_push_state = self.push_state.stopped
		end

		return true
	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent) then
		if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'fill_water_buoy' then
			self:fill_water()
			return true
		end

		if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'empty_water' then
			self:empty_water()
			return true
		end

		return false
	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.SwitchOnOffEvent) and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.SwitchObject, self.fo) then
		self.is_turned_on = e.IsTurningOn

		if self.is_turned_on then
			self.button_transform.localPosition = self.button_on_pos
		else
			self.button_transform.localPosition = self.button_off_pos
		end

		return true
	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.FloorSwitchStepOnEvent) then
		if self.only_for_manual_character and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Stepper, get_party_leader()) then
			return false
		end

		for i = 1, #self.pressing_obj do
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Stepper, self.pressing_obj[i]) then
				return false
			end
		end

		table.insert(self.pressing_obj, e.Stepper)

		if self.is_turned_on then
			return false
		end

		music_player_util.play_sfx({
			sfx_name = '02_switch_button_01',
			parent = self.fo,
			type_priority = sfx_type_priority.gimmick,
			player_priority = sfx_player_priority.object
		})

		local cmd = CS.Oak.SwitchOnOffCommand.Create(self.fo, true, e.Stepper)
		command_util.publish_cmd(e.Stepper.Owner, cmd)

		return true
	end

	-- 부표가 물 위로 떠 있을 때는 리셋 되지 않도록 함
	if not self.is_flying and lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ResetSwitchTurnedOnEvent) then
		for i = 1, #self.reset_switch_names do
			if e.SwitchObject.Name == self.reset_switch_names[i] then
				self:reset_object()
			end
		end
		return true
	end

	return false
end
--endregion

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	-- 스위치 처리
	if #self.pressing_obj ~= 0 then
		for i = #self.pressing_obj, 1, -1 do
			if self.pressing_obj[i].ActiveState & active_state('infield') == 0 or
				CS.BoundsExtensions.GetDistanceBetween(self.fo.Bounds, self.pressing_obj[i].Bounds) > 0 then

				table.remove(self.pressing_obj, i)
			end
		end

		if self.is_turned_on and #self.pressing_obj == 0 then
			local cmd = CS.Oak.SwitchOnOffCommand.Create(self.fo, false)
			command_util.publish_cmd(self.fo.Owner, cmd)
		end
	end

	self.current_buoy_state.time_passed = self.current_buoy_state.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_buoy_state.update then
		self.current_buoy_state.update(self, self.current_buoy_state.time_passed)
	end
end

--region 움직이는 상태
--- 움직이는 상태 업데이트
function local_class:update_moving_state(time_passed)
	if time_passed >= 1 then
		self.mesh_transform.position = vector_util.get_x0z(self.mesh_transform.position, self.current_buoy_state.end_height)

		if self.is_flying then
			self.is_flying = false
		else
			self.is_flying = true
		end

		self:set_wall()

		self:change_state(self.buoy_state.idle)

	else
		local progress = time_passed / self.current_buoy_state.duration
		local cur_y = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(self.current_buoy_state.start_height, self.current_buoy_state.end_height, progress)
		self.mesh_transform.position = vector_util.get_x0z(self.mesh_transform.position, cur_y)
	end
end
--endregion

--region 밀리는 상태
--- 밀리는 상태 업데이트
function local_class:update_pushing_state(_)
	if self.current_push_state == self.push_state.stopped then
		self:change_state(self.buoy_state.idle)
	end
end
--endregion

--- 상태 변경
function local_class:change_state(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.current_buoy_state
	if prev_state.exit then
		prev_state.exit(self, new_state)
	end

	self.current_buoy_state = new_state

	if self.current_buoy_state then
		self.current_buoy_state.time_passed = 0
	end

	if new_state.enter then
		new_state.enter(self, prev_state)
	end
end

--- 물 채우기
function local_class:fill_water()
	self:set_floor_height(1)

	self.buoy_state.moving.start_height = self.buoy_state.moving.end_height
	self.buoy_state.moving.end_height = 0.5

	-- 타입별 세팅
	if self.current_type == self.buoy_type.buoy then
		self.fo.ActiveState = active_state('visible')

	elseif self.current_type == self.buoy_type.switch then
		self.fo.Pushable = CS.Oak.NonPushable.Instance
		self.fo.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.FloorSwitchCrashBehaviour.Instance
		self.origin_hit_box = self.fo.Hitbox
		self.fo.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(0.5, 0.2, 0.5))

	elseif self.current_type == self.buoy_type.brazier then
		self.fo.Pushable = CS.Oak.NonPushable.Instance
	end

	self.fo.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(self.fo.Position, 1)
	self.mesh_transform.position = vector_util.get_x0z(self.mesh_transform.position, 0)

	self:change_state(self.buoy_state.moving)
end

--- 물 비우기
function local_class:empty_water()
	self:set_floor_height(0)

	-- 물 비울 때 부표 위에 있는 오브젝트 리셋
	local obj_list = CS.Oak.LuaCollisionUtil.GetFieldObjectsCollidedBy(self.fo.Bounds, unity_class.vector3.zero)
	for i = 0, obj_list.Count - 1 do
		local obj = obj_list[i]

		-- 자신 제외
		if not lua_helper.reference_equals(obj, self.fo) and
			not lua_helper.type_compare(obj.FieldObjectBehaviour, CS.Oak.WallBehaviour) and
			not lua_helper.type_compare(obj.FieldObjectBehaviour, CS.Oak.NullFieldObjectBehaviour) then

			message_system:SendSync(obj.FieldObjectBehaviour, CS.Oak.GimmickResetEvent.Instance)
		end
	end

	obj_list:Dispose()

	self.buoy_state.moving.start_height = self.buoy_state.moving.end_height
	self.buoy_state.moving.end_height = 0

	-- 타입별 세팅
	if self.current_type == self.buoy_type.buoy then
		self.fo.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')

	elseif self.current_type == self.buoy_type.switch then
		self.fo.Pushable = CS.Oak.UnitPushable()
		self.fo.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.WallCrashBehaviour.Instance
		self.fo.Hitbox = self.origin_hit_box

	elseif self.current_type == self.buoy_type.brazier then
		self.fo.Pushable = CS.Oak.UnitPushable()
	end

	self.fo.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(self.fo.Position, 0)
	self.mesh_transform.position = vector_util.get_x0z(self.mesh_transform.position, 0.5)

	self:change_state(self.buoy_state.moving)
end

--- 바닦 높이 설정
function local_class:set_floor_height(height)
	local min_pos = self.fo.Bounds.min + vector(0.5, 0, 0.5)

	for i = 1, self.bounds_size_z do
		for j = 1, self.bounds_size_x do
			local cur_pos = min_pos + vector(j - 1, 0, i - 1)

			-- 해당 위치의 타일 정보를 가져와 높이 설정함
			local tile_info = field:GetTileInfoAt(cur_pos)
			tile_info.y = height
			field:AddFloor(cur_pos, tile_info)
		end
	end
end

--- 벽 배치
function local_class:set_wall()
	if self.is_flying then
		-- 물이 찼을 때 오브젝트 주변 1층 바닦에 벽 배치

		-- 위치 확인이 필요한 좌표
		local checking_pos = {}

		local bounds = self.fo.Bounds
		local min_pos = vector(math.floor(bounds.min.x), 1, math.floor(bounds.min.z))

		-- 상하 위치 확인
		for i = 1, self.bounds_size_x do
			local pos = min_pos + unity_class.vector3.right * i
			table.insert(checking_pos, pos)
			table.insert(checking_pos, pos + unity_class.vector3.forward * (self.bounds_size_z + 1))
		end

		-- 좌우 위치 확인
		for i = 1, self.bounds_size_z do
			local pos = min_pos + unity_class.vector3.forward * i
			table.insert(checking_pos, pos)
			table.insert(checking_pos, pos + unity_class.vector3.right * (self.bounds_size_x + 1))
		end

		for i = 1, #checking_pos do
			local pos = checking_pos[i]

			-- 바닦이 1층이면 벽 배치
			if field:GetTileInfoAt(pos):GetHeightAt(pos) < 1 then
				self.walls[i].Position = pos
				self.walls[i].ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
			end
		end

	else
		-- 물이 비었을 때 모든 벽 비활성화
		for i = 1, #self.walls do
			self.walls[i].ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
		end
	end
end

--- 남은 유닛 단위 이동 거리 검사
function local_class:check_remain_distance(direction)
	local diff = 0

	local dir_vector = direction_util.to_vector3_ver2(direction)
	if direction_util.is_side(direction) then
		diff = (self.target_pos.x - self.fo.Position.x) * dir_vector.x
	else
		diff = (self.target_pos.z - self.fo.Position.z) * dir_vector.z
	end

	if diff > 0 then
		start_coroutine(self.move_remain_distance, self, direction)
	else
		self.current_push_state = self.push_state.stopped
	end
end

--- 유닛 단위 이동에 부족한 거리만큼 추가로 움직임
function local_class:move_remain_distance(dir)
	self.current_push_state = self.push_state.move_remain_distance

	local remain_dist = 0
	local speed = CS.Oak.Constants.UnitPushSpeed

	if vector_util.get_x0z(self.target_pos - self.fo.Position).magnitude > 2 then
		speed = CS.Oak.Constants.UnitPushSpeed * 3
	end

	repeat
		local diff = 0
		if self.current_push_state ~= self.push_state.move_remain_distance then
			break
		end

		if direction_util.is_side(dir) then
			diff = self.fo.Position.x - self.target_pos.x
		else
			diff = self.fo.Position.z - self.target_pos.z
		end

		remain_dist = math.abs(diff)

		local moving_dist = speed * unity_class.time.deltaTime

		CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameStageLogic.ExecutePush(self.fo, direction_util.to_vector3_ver2(dir), math.min(remain_dist, moving_dist))

		coroutine.yield(nil)

	until float_util.is_almost_zero(remain_dist)

	self.current_push_state = self.push_state.stopped
end

--- 오브젝트 위치 초기화
function local_class:reset_object()
	if self.fo.Position == self.default_pos then
		return
	end

	local prev_effect_pos = self.fo.Bounds.center
	local effect_size = self.fo.Bounds.size

	self.fo.Position = self.default_pos
	self.target_pos = self.default_pos

	local effect_pool = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_reset_object')

	local prev_pos_effect = effect_pool:Instantiate(prev_effect_pos)
	prev_pos_effect.transform.localScale = effect_size

	local reset_pos_effect = effect_pool:Instantiate(self.fo.Bounds.center)
	reset_pos_effect.transform.localScale = effect_size

	self:change_state(self.buoy_state.idle)
end

return {
	create = function(data_path, data_key, cs_behaviour)
		return local_class(data_path, data_key, cs_behaviour)
	end
}

local local_class = newclass('CCTV')

--- 생성자
--- @param data_path string 해당 기믹이 사용할 Data의 경로.
--- @param data_key string 해당 기믹이 사용할 Data의 Key.
--- @param cs_behaviour any 해당 기믹의 C# Behaviour.
function local_class:init(data_path, data_key, cs_behaviour)
	self.cs_behaviour = cs_behaviour

	-- 기믹 데이터
	if data_key == nil or data_key == '' then
		self.data = load_util.load_lua_gimmick_data(data_path, stage.Name)
	else
		self.data = load_util.load_lua_gimmick_data(data_path, data_key)
	end

	self.effect_names = {
	}

	-- 사용할 이펙트 풀 테이블
	self.effect_pools = {
		sight = nil
	}

	self.fo = nil

	-- CCTV 방향
	self.direction = nil

	-- 현재 작동 중인지
	self.activated = true

	-- 메인 퀘스트에서 CCTV 전원이 꺼졌는지
	self.cctv_off = false

	-- 메인 퀘스트에 영향을 받는지(기본값 true)
	self.is_affected_by_main_quest = true

	-- 플레이어가 카메라 시야에 걸렸는지
	self.is_detected = false

	-- 시야 이펙트
	self.sight_effect = nil

	-- 리셋 위치 마커 테이블
	self.reset_markers = {}

	-- 메인 퀘스트 ID
	self.main_quest_id = 258

	-- 틴트 키
	self.tint_key = 'cctv'

	-- Exclusive Event
	self.exclusive_event_key = 'detected_by_terrorist'

	-- Custom Event
	self.cctv_on_custom_event = 'cctv_on'
	self.cctv_off_custom_event = 'cctv_off'
end

-- IFO에 붙었을 때
function local_class:attach_to(fo)
	self.fo = fo

	-- 방향 설정
	if self.fo.Transform.localRotation.eulerAngles.y == 0 then
		self.direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Right
	elseif self.fo.Transform.localRotation.eulerAngles.y == 90 then
		self.direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Down
	elseif self.fo.Transform.localRotation.eulerAngles.y == 180 then
		self.direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Left
	else
		self.direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Up
	end

	-- 이벤트 구독
	self.cs_behaviour:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.StageStartEvent))
	self.cs_behaviour:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.QuestProgressedEvent))
	self.cs_behaviour:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))

	-- 이팩트 캐싱
	for key, name in pairs(self.effect_names) do
		self.effect_pools[key] = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(name)
	end

	local quest_progress = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(self.main_quest_id)
	self.cctv_off = quest_progress.InnerProgress >= 7

	self.is_affected_by_main_quest = lua_helper.get_or_default(self.data.is_affected_by_main_quest, true)
end

-- IFO에서 떨어졌을 때
function local_class:detach_from(fo)
end

--- LuaMessageSystem(message_system)을 이용하여 콜백을 등록하였을 경우 이 곳에서 해제하여야 한다.
--- detach_from의 경우 LuaMessageSystem이 이미 날아간 상태이기 때문에 Leak발생함.
function local_class:dispose()
	self.cs_behaviour:UnSubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.StageStartEvent))
	self.cs_behaviour:UnSubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.QuestProgressedEvent))
	self.cs_behaviour:UnSubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))

	self.fo = nil
	self.direction = nil

	self.sight_effect = nil

	self.reset_markers = nil

	self.cs_behaviour = nil
end

-- 현재 기본 스테이트 얻기(아이들, 걷기 등 전신 및 하체 상태)
function local_class:current_state()
	return nil
end

-- 현재 IFO가 취하고 있는 액션
function local_class:current_action()
	return CS.Oak.FieldObjectAction.None
end

--region event
-- 이벤트 호출
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.StageStartEvent) then
		return self:on_stage_start_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.QuestProgressedEvent) then
		return self:on_quest_progressed_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent) then
		return self:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_stage_start_event(e)
	for i = 1, self.data['reset_marker_num'] do
		table.insert(self.reset_markers, field:GetMarker(self.data['reset_marker_name']..i))
	end

	-- 메인 퀘스트의 진행도에 영향을 받아야 하는지 확인한다. 기본 값: true
	-- 카메라가 켜져있어야 하는 퀘스트에서도 꺼져있는 경우를 방지하기 위함.
	-- 관련 이슈: PS-5912
	if self.cctv_off and self.is_affected_by_main_quest then
		self.activated = false

		self.fo.Transform:GetChild(0).gameObject:SetActive(false)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_quest_progressed_event(e)
	-- 메인 퀘스트가 섹션 8로 넘어왔을 때
	if self.is_affected_by_main_quest == false then
		return
	end

	if e.QuestId == self.main_quest_id and e.CurrentProgress == 7 then
		self:deactivate_camera()

		self.cctv_off = true
		self.activated = false
		self.fo.Transform:GetChild(0).gameObject:SetActive(false)
	end
end

function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	-- 메인 퀘스트 상태와 관계없이 강제로 켜고 꺼준다
	if e:GetParamAt(0) == self.fo.Name and e:GetParamAt(1) == self.cctv_on_custom_event then
		self:activate_camera()
	elseif e:GetParamAt(0) == self.fo.Name and e:GetParamAt(1) == self.cctv_off_custom_event then
		self:deactivate_camera()
	end

	return false
end

--endregion

-- 업데이트. attach_to가 불린 시점부터 detach_from 이 불린 시점까지 매 프레임 불린다.
function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	-- 이미 걸렸거나 파티 리더가 죽었거나 파티 리더의 Entity Group이 Player0이 아니라면 CCTV 작동하지 않음
	if self.activated and not self.is_detected and not get_party_leader().FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead and
			get_party_leader().EntityGroup == CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Player0 then
		-- 캐릭터가 카메라의 시야 범위 내에 있는지 계산
		local dist = get_party_leader().Position - (self.fo.Position +
				direction_util.to_vector3_ver2(self.direction) * 2.3)

		-- 좌표가 타원 내부에 있는지
		if self.direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Down or self.direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Up then
			if (dist.z * dist.z) / (self.data['sight_x'] * self.data['sight_x']) +
					(dist.x * dist.x) / (self.data['sight_z'] * self.data['sight_z']) <= 1 then
				self.is_detected = true

				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.detected_event, self)
			end
		else
			if (dist.x * dist.x) / (self.data['sight_x'] * self.data['sight_x']) +
					(dist.z * dist.z) / (self.data['sight_z'] * self.data['sight_z']) <= 1 then
				self.is_detected = true

				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.detected_event, self)
			end
		end
	end
end

-- CCTV에 발견되는 이벤트
function local_class:detected_event()
	-- 플레이어로부터 가장 가까운 리셋 위치를 찾음
	local shortest_dist = 99999
	local reset_marker = nil

	for i = 1, #self.reset_markers do
		local cur_dist = (get_party_leader().Position - self.reset_markers[i].position).magnitude

		if shortest_dist > cur_dist then
			shortest_dist = cur_dist
			reset_marker = self.reset_markers[i]
		end
	end

	camera_util.shake(0.07, 0.25)

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_runaway_01' })

	local party_entity_groups = {}

	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		-- 테러리스트들에게 발각되지 않도록 EntityGroup 변경
		table.insert(party_entity_groups, user_party[i].EntityGroup)
		user_party[i].EntityGroup = CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Neutral

		-- 공격에 죽지 않도록 무적 설정
		character_util.set_immortal(user_party[i], true)

		character_util.look_at(user_party[i], detector)
		character_util.set_anim(user_party[i], { name = "embarrassed" })
		character_util.set_emotion(user_party[i], { name = "surprise" })
		character_util.jump(user_party[i], 0.3, 0.2)
	end

	field:Tint(self.tint_key, unity_color({1, 0, 0, 0.8}), 0.3)

	wait_for_sec(1)

	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(0.5, 'linear')

	field:RemoveTint(self.tint_key)

	party_util.align_party(reset_marker.position,
			CS.Oak.DirectionExtensions.GetOpposite(reset_marker.direction), 0, 'linear')

	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		character_util.remove_anim(user_party[i])
		character_util.remove_emotion(user_party[i])
	end

	wait_for_sec(1)

	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(0.5, 'linear')

	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		user_party[i].EntityGroup = party_entity_groups[i + 1]

		--무적 해제
		character_util.set_immortal(user_party[i], false)
	end

	self.is_detected = false
end

-- CCTV 켬
function local_class:activate_camera()
	self.activated = true

	self.fo.Transform:GetChild(0).gameObject:SetActive(true)
end

-- CCTV 끔
function local_class:deactivate_camera()
	self.activated = false

	self.fo.Transform:GetChild(0).gameObject:SetActive(false)
end

return {
	create = function(data_path, data_key, cs_behaviour)
		return local_class(data_path, data_key, cs_behaviour)
	end
}

local local_class = newclass('CeoThresherBehaviour')

--- 생성자
--- @param data_path string 해당 기믹이 사용할 Data의 경로.
--- @param data_key string 해당 기믹이 사용할 Data의 Key.
--- @param cs_behaviour any 해당 기믹의 C# Behaviour.
function local_class:init(data_path, data_key, cs_behaviour)
	self.cs_behaviour = cs_behaviour

	-- 데이터가 필요할 경우 아래 주석을 풀고 사용하면 된다.
	-- 데이터 사용 방법은 Confluence 참고
	local data = load_util.load_lua_gimmick_data(data_path, data_key)
	self.move_speed = lua_helper.get_or_default(data['speed'], 5)
	self.boss_name = nil
	self.attack_modifier = lua_helper.get_or_default(data['attack_modifier'], 1)
	self.attack_radius = lua_helper.get_or_default(data['attack_radius'], 3)
	self.boss = get_character(self.boss_name)

	--히트박스 기본 사이즈
	self.original_hitbox_size = lua_helper.get_or_default(data['original_size'], unity_class.vector3(4, 1, 1))
	--파티원 정보 저장하여 데미지 줄때 씀.
	self.party_infos = { }
	--보스와 부딛혔는가
	self.is_crashed_with_boss = false
	-- 마지막 대미지를 받은 시점부터 대미지를 받지 않을 시간
	self.non_damage_time = 0.3
	--탈곡기 숨겨둘 기본 포지션
	self.default_position = unity_class.vector3.zero

	self.fx_dust = nil
	self.sfx_holder = nil
end

-- IFO에 붙었을 때
function local_class:attach_to(fo)
	self.fo = fo
	self.default_position = fo.Position

	self.get_dust = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_awceo_thresher_dust')  end
	self.get_explosion = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_awceo_thresher_explosion')  end

	self.get_dust()
	self.get_explosion()

	self.subscribe_func = function(e)
		self:on_event(e)
	end
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), self.subscribe_func)
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), self.subscribe_func)
end

-- IFO에서 떨어졌을 때
function local_class:detach_from(fo)
	if self.subscribe_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), self.subscribe_func)
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), self.subscribe_func)
		self.subscribe_func = nil
	end
end

-- 현재 기본 스테이트 얻기(아이들, 걷기 등 전신 및 하체 상태)
function local_class:current_state()
	return nil
end

-- 현재 IFO가 취하고 있는 액션
function local_class:current_action()
	return CS.Oak.FieldObjectAction.None
end

-- 업데이트. attach_to가 불린 시점부터 detach_from 이 불린 시점까지 매 프레임 불린다.
function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	-- 특정 방향으로 세팅하여 전진 함.
	if self.is_start then
		self:move_thresher(self.fo, dt)
		if self.sfx_holder ~= nil then
			self.sfx_holder:SetPosition(self.fo.Position)
		end
		-- 각 파티원에게 연속해서 데미지 들어가지 않도록 데미지 받는 딜레이를 지정함.
		for _, v in pairs(self.party_infos) do
			if v.is_hit then
				v.time_passed = v.time_passed + dt
				if v.time_passed >=  self.non_damage_time then
					v.is_hit = false
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:move_thresher(thresher, dt)
	local magnitude = self.move_speed * dt
	local direction = direction_util.to_vector3(thresher.Direction)
	CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameStageLogic.ExecuteMove(thresher, direction, magnitude)
end

-- 이벤트 호출
function local_class:on_event(e)

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent) then
		if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'thresher_start' then
			if e:GetParamAt(1) == self.fo.Name then
				-- 자신한테 받았을때 실행
				self.is_start = true
				self.fo.Direction = self:string_to_direction(e:GetParamAt(2))
				local angle_vector = self:direction_to_angle(self.fo.Direction)
				local hitbox = self.fo.Hitbox
				if self.fo.Direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Left or self.fo.Direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Right then
					hitbox.size = unity_class.vector3(self.original_hitbox_size.z, hitbox.size.y, self.original_hitbox_size.x)

				elseif self.fo.Direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Down or self.fo.Direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Up then
					hitbox.size = self.original_hitbox_size

				end
				-- hitbox가 회전하지 않아 타격이 안되는 경우 가 있어 직접 변경해서 사용함.
				self.fo.Hitbox = hitbox
				message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.MoveFieldObjectEvent.Create(self.fo, self.fo.Position, hitbox))

				self.sfx_holder = music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '01_wagon_loop_01', play_pos = self.fo.Position, type_priority = 'event'})
					--Direction 변경만으로 회전되지 않아 직접 돌림.
				self.fo.Transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(angle_vector)
				self.boss_name = e:GetParamAt(3)
				self.boss = get_character(self.boss_name)

				self.fx_dust = self.get_dust():Instantiate(self.fo.Position, self.fo.Transform.rotation, self.fo.Transform)
				-- 유저파티의 경우에 중복된 데미지 적용을 막기 위해 옮겨와서 동작하도록 햔다.
				for _, v in pairs(user_party) do
					table.insert(self.party_infos, { fo = v, is_hit = false, time_passed = 0 })
				end

				self.is_crashed_with_boss = false
			end
		elseif e:GetParamAt(0) == 'thresher_self_destruct' then
			-- 보스 처치 시 그냥 벽에 부딫힌 것처럼 처리
			self:crash_with_wall()
		end
	end

	if self.is_start then
		if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.GotCrashedEvent) then
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Crasher, self.boss) then
				-- 폭파
				if not self.is_crashed_with_boss then
					self:crash_with_boss(e.Crasher)
					self.is_crashed_with_boss = true
				end
			end

			for _, v in pairs(self.party_infos) do
				if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Crasher, v.fo) then
					self:crash_with_party(v)
				end
			end
		end

		if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent) then
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, self.fo) then
				--존 빠져나가는 시점에 제거
				self:crash_with_wall()
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:direction_to_angle(direction)
	if direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Left then
		return unity_class.vector3(0, 90, 0)
	elseif direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Right then
		return unity_class.vector3(0, 270, 0)
	elseif direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Up then
		return unity_class.vector3(0, 180, 0)
	elseif direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Down then
		return unity_class.vector3(0, 0, 0)
	elseif direction == CS.Oak.Direction.None then
		return unity_class.vector3.zero
	end
end

function local_class:string_to_direction(direction_str)
	if type_util.is_string(direction_str) then
		if direction_str == 'left' then
			return CS.Oak.Direction.Left
		elseif direction_str == 'right' then
			return CS.Oak.Direction.Right
		elseif direction_str == 'up' then
			return CS.Oak.Direction.Up
		elseif direction_str == 'down' then
			return CS.Oak.Direction.Down
		elseif direction_str == 'none' then
			return CS.Oak.Direction.None
		end
	end

	return nil
end

-- 어느 대상에게 데미지를 보낼수 있는가
function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	--유저 파티원에게
	for _, v in pairs(user_party) do
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(target, v) then
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

--
function local_class:crash_with_boss(boss)
		-- 폭발 및 범위 데미지 후 보스 보호막 제거
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.fo, {'crash_by_thresher', boss.Name, self.fo.Name}))
	self:explode_thresher()
end

function local_class:explode_thresher()
	if not is_unity_null(self.fx_dust) then
		self.fx_dust:Dispose()
	end
	self.fx_dust = nil
	self.get_explosion():Instantiate(self.fo.Position, self.fo.Transform.rotation, nil)
	local candidates = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(self.fo.Position, self.attack_radius)
	for i = 0, candidates.Count - 1 do
		local target = candidates[i]
		if self:is_hittable(target) then
			local dist = vector_util.distance(self.fo.Position, target.Position)
			if dist <= self.attack_radius then
				--타겟에게 데미지
				local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
				damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
				damage_info.sender = self.fo
				damage_info.target = target
				damage_info.damage = math.floor(target.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP * self.attack_modifier)
				damage_info.direction = vector_util.get_x0z(target.Position - self.fo.Position).normalized
				local cmd = CS.Oak.DamageCommand.Create(damage_info)
				command_util.publish_cmd(damage_info.Owner, cmd)
			end
		end
	end
	music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '03_rock_break_03', play_pos = self.fo.Position, type_priority = 'event'})
	candidates:Dispose()
	self:reset_object()
end

function local_class:crash_with_party(crasher)
	-- 피격(데미지) 후 계속 진행
	if not crasher.fo.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead and not crasher.is_hit then
		local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
		damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
		damage_info.sender = self.fo
		damage_info.target = crasher.fo
		damage_info.damage = math.floor(crasher.fo.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP * self.attack_modifier)
		damage_info.noCritical = true
		local cmd = CS.Oak.DamageCommand.Create(damage_info)
		command_util.publish_cmd(damage_info.Owner, cmd)
		crasher.is_hit = true
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:crash_with_wall()
	--폭발 일으킴
	self:explode_thresher()
	self:reset_object()
end

--- 오브젝트 리셋
function local_class:reset_object()
	if self.fo.ActiveState == active_state('disabled') then
		return
	end
	--업데이트 중지
	self.is_start = false
	--비활성화
	self.fo.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
	-- 캐릭터 진행 방향
	self.fo.Position = self.default_position
	if self.sfx_holder ~= nil then
		self.sfx_holder:Stop()
		self.sfx_holder = nil
	end
	self:change_state(CS.Oak.FieldObjectIdleState.Instance)
end

--- Behaviour에 있는 StateMachine의 State를 변경
function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	self.cs_behaviour:ChangeState(next_state)
end

--- LuaMessageSystem(message_system)을 이용하여 콜백을 등록하였을 경우 이 곳에서 해제하여야 한다.
--- detach_from의 경우 LuaMessageSystem이 이미 날아간 상태이기 때문에 Leak발생함.
function local_class:dispose()
	-- 구독 해제
	if self.subscribe_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), self.subscribe_func)
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), self.subscribe_func)
		self.subscribe_func = nil
	end

	if not is_unity_null(self.fx_dust) then
		self.fx_dust:Dispose()
	end
	self.fx_dust = nil

	if self.sfx_holder ~= nil then
		self.sfx_holder:Stop()
		self.sfx_holder = nil
	end

	if self.party_infos ~= nil then
		for i = #self.party_infos, 1, -1 do
			self.party_infos[i].fo = nil
		end
		table.remove(self.party_infos, i)
	end
	self:change_state(nil)
end

return {
	create = function(data_path, data_key, cs_behaviour)
		return local_class(data_path, data_key, cs_behaviour)
	end
}

--- @in safe_range_radius float
local local_class = newclass('CharacterLightningRod')

local character_lightning_rod_base = newclass('CharacterLightningRodState')
local character_lightning_rod_state = {
	idle = newclass('CharacterLightningRodIdleState', character_lightning_rod_base),
	hold_up = newclass('CharacterLightningRodHoldUpState', character_lightning_rod_base),
	searching = newclass('CharacterLightningRodSearchingState', character_lightning_rod_base),
}

--- 생성자
--- @param data_path string 해당 기믹이 사용할 Data의 경로.
--- @param data_key string 해당 기믹이 사용할 Data의 Key.
--- @param cs_behaviour any 해당 기믹의 C# Behaviour.
function local_class:init(data_path, data_key, cs_behaviour)
	self.cs_behaviour = cs_behaviour

	--[[기믹 데이터
	data_key = lua_helper.get_or_default(data_key, 'default')
	if data_key == '' then
		data_key = 'default'
	end

	self.data = load_util.load_lua_gimmick_data(data_path, data_key)]]

	self.states = nil

	self.character_lightning_rod_state = nil

	-- 안전 지역 범위
	self.safe_range_radius = 3

	self.range_light_color = CS.UnityEngine.Color32(53, 255, 70, 76)
	self.range_dark_color = CS.UnityEngine.Color32(53, 255, 70, 153)

	-- 번개 맞았는지
	self.is_hit = false

	self.get_fx_reset = function()
		return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_reset_object')
	end
end

-- IFO에 붙었을 때
function local_class:attach_to(fo)
	self.fo = fo

	self.cs_behaviour:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridLeaveEvent))
	self.cs_behaviour:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.CharacterConvertEvent))
	self.cs_behaviour:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.PowerSourceTurnOnEvent))
	self.cs_behaviour:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.StageLoadedEvent))

	self.spine_controller = self.fo.UnityGameObject:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.SpineController))
	self.base_track = CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(CS.Oak.Character.SpineAnimationTrack.Base)

	self.default_pos = self.fo.Position

	self.states = {}

	for state_name, state in pairs(character_lightning_rod_state) do
		self.states[state_name] = state(self)
	end

	self:change_state(self.states.idle)
end

-- IFO에서 떨어졌을 때
function local_class:detach_from(fo)
	for _, state in pairs(self.states) do
		state:dispose()
	end

	self.spine_controller = nil
	self.base_track = nil

	self.default_pos = nil

	self.character_lightning_rod_state = nil
	self.states = nil
	self.fo = nil
end

--- LuaMessageSystem(message_system)을 이용하여 콜백을 등록하였을 경우 이 곳에서 해제하여야 한다.
--- detach_from의 경우 LuaMessageSystem이 이미 날아간 상태이기 때문에 Leak발생함.
function local_class:dispose()
	self.cs_behaviour:UnSubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridLeaveEvent))
	self.cs_behaviour:UnSubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.CharacterConvertEvent))
	self.cs_behaviour:UnSubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.PowerSourceTurnOnEvent))
	self.cs_behaviour:UnSubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.StageLoadedEvent))

	self.fo = nil
	self.cs_behaviour = nil
end

-- 현재 기본 스테이트 얻기(아이들, 걷기 등 전신 및 하체 상태)
function local_class:current_state()
	return nil
end

-- 현재 IFO가 취하고 있는 액션
function local_class:current_action()
	local current_state = self.cs_behaviour.CurrentState

	if lua_helper.type_compare(current_state, CS.Oak.FieldObjectThrownState) then
		if current_state.DidLandOnFloor then
			return CS.Oak.FieldObjectAction.ImpactMoving
		else
			return CS.Oak.FieldObjectAction.Flying
		end
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(current_state, CS.Oak.FieldObjectHeldUpState) then
		return CS.Oak.FieldObjectAction.Held
	end

	return CS.Oak.FieldObjectAction.Stopped
end

function local_class:set_anim(name)
	self.spine_controller:SetAnimation(self.base_track, name, true)
end

--region event
-- 이벤트 호출
function local_class:on_event(e)
	local consumed = CS.Oak.LuaScriptQuestUtil.CastToEventListenerAndSendSync(self.cs_behaviour.CurrentState, e, false)

	if consumed then
		return true
	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.HoldUpEvent) then
		self:change_state(self.states.hold_up)
		self.cs_behaviour:ChangeState(CS.Oak.FieldObjectHeldUpState.Create(self.fo, e.Holder))
		return true
	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.GetThrownEvent) then
		self.cs_behaviour:ChangeState(CS.Oak.FieldObjectThrownState.Create(e.ThrowInfo))
		return true
	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.GetThrownEndEvent) then
		self.cs_behaviour:ChangeState(CS.Oak.FieldObjectIdleState.Instance)
		return true
	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.HitFloorEvent) then
		music_player_util.play_sfx({
			sfx_name = '01_hit_npc_01',
			play_pos = self.fo.Position,
			type_priority = 'gimmick',
			player_priority = 'object'
		})

		self:change_state(self.states.searching)
		self.cs_behaviour:ChangeState(CS.Oak.FieldObjectIdleState.Instance)
		return true
	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.CameraGridLeaveEvent) and e.CameraGrid:Contains(self.default_pos) and
		self.character_lightning_rod_state ~= self.states.idle and
		(lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, get_party_leader()) or lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, get_user_party())) then
		self:reset_object()
		return true
	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.PowerSourceTurnOnEvent) and
		not self.is_hit and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.PowerSourceFo, self.fo) then

		self.is_hit = true
		self.spine_controller:AddColor(self.fo.Name, unity_class.color.black, 1, 0)

		return true
	end

	return false
end
--endregion

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	self.character_lightning_rod_state:update(dt)
end

--- 상태 변경
function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	local prev_state = self.character_lightning_rod_state

	if prev_state == next_state then
		return
	end

	if prev_state then
		prev_state:exit(next_state)
	end

	self.character_lightning_rod_state = next_state

	if next_state then
		next_state:enter(prev_state)
	end
end

--- 오브젝트 초기화
function local_class:reset_object()
	if self.fo.Holdable.IsHeld then
		local holder = self.fo.Holdable.Holder
		self.fo.Holdable:GetThrownBy(holder)

		message_system:SendSync(self.fo, CS.Oak.GetThrownEndEvent.Instance)
		message_system:SendSync(holder, CS.Oak.ReleaseHoldingObjectEvent.Create(holder))
	end

	self:change_state(self.states.idle)

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.PowerSourceTurnOffEvent.Create(self.fo))

	if (self.fo.ActiveState & active_state_type.visible) ~= active_state_type.disabled then
		self.get_fx_reset():Instantiate(self.fo.Position)

		music_player_util.play_sfx({
			sfx_name = '01_character_warp_01',
			play_pos = self.fo.Position,
			type_priority = 'gimmick',
			player_priority = 'object'
		})
	end

	self.get_fx_reset()self.get_fx_reset():Instantiate(self.default_pos)
	self.fo.Position = self.default_pos

	music_player_util.play_sfx({
		sfx_name = '01_character_warp_01',
		play_pos = self.default_pos,
		type_priority = 'gimmick',
		player_priority = 'object'
	})

	field_object_util.set_active_state(self.fo, active_state_type.enabled)
end

--region Base State
function character_lightning_rod_base:init(controller)
	self.controller = controller
	self.fo = controller.fo

	self.time_passed = 0
end

function character_lightning_rod_base:dispose()
	self.fo = nil
	self.controller = nil
end

function character_lightning_rod_base:enter()
	self.time_passed = 0
end

function character_lightning_rod_base:exit()
	self.time_passed = 0
end

function character_lightning_rod_base:update(dt)
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt
end
--endregion Base State

--region Idle State
function character_lightning_rod_state.idle:init(controller)
	self.super:init(controller)
end

function character_lightning_rod_state.idle:dispose()
	self.super:dispose()
end

function character_lightning_rod_state.idle:enter()
	self.super:enter()

	self.fo.Electrocutable.IsElectrocutable = false

	self.controller.is_hit = false

	self.controller.spine_controller:RemoveColor(self.fo.Name, 0)

	self.controller:set_anim('eat')
end

function character_lightning_rod_state.idle:exit()
	self.super:exit()
end

function character_lightning_rod_state.idle:update(dt)
	self.super:update(dt)
end
--endregion Idle State

--region HoldUp State
function character_lightning_rod_state.hold_up:init(controller)
	self.super:init(controller)
end

function character_lightning_rod_state.hold_up:dispose()
	self.super:dispose()
end

function character_lightning_rod_state.hold_up:enter(prev_state)
	self.super:enter()

	if prev_state == self.controller.states.idle then
		self.controller:set_anim('embarrassed')

		music_player_util.play_sfx({
			sfx_name = '03_runaway_01',
			parent = self.fo,
			type_priority = 'gimmick',
			player_priority = 'object'
		})
	end

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.PowerSourceTurnOffEvent.Create(self.fo))

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.fo, { 'remove_lightning_rod' }))
end

function character_lightning_rod_state.hold_up:exit()
	self.super:exit()
end

function character_lightning_rod_state.hold_up:update(dt)
	self.super:update(dt)
end
--endregion HoldUp State

--region Searching State
function character_lightning_rod_state.searching:init(controller)
	self.super:init(controller)
end

function character_lightning_rod_state.searching:dispose()
	self.super:dispose()
end

function character_lightning_rod_state.searching:enter()
	self.super:enter()

	self.is_searched = false

	self.controller:set_anim('prostrate')

	self.fo.Electrocutable.IsElectrocutable = true

	self.attack_range = attack_range_util.create_circle(self.fo.Position + vector(0, 0.07, 0),
		self.controller.safe_range_radius, self.controller.range_light_color, self.controller.range_dark_color)

	attack_range_util.show(self.attack_range)

	self.sqr_radius = self.controller.safe_range_radius * self.controller.safe_range_radius
end

function character_lightning_rod_state.searching:exit()
	self.super:exit()

	self.fo.Electrocutable.IsElectrocutable = false

	attack_range_util.destroy(self.attack_range)
end

function character_lightning_rod_state.searching:update(dt)
	self.super:update(dt)

	-- 안전 구역에 플레이어가 들어오면 번개 기믹 컨트롤러에 알려줌
	if not self.is_searched and (get_party_leader().Position - self.fo.Position).sqrMagnitude < self.sqr_radius then
		self.is_searched = true
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.fo, { 'add_lightning_rod' }))
	end
end
--endregion Searching State

return {
	create = function(data_path, data_key, cs_behaviour)
		return local_class(data_path, data_key, cs_behaviour)
	end
}

local local_class = newclass('ChopperPatrolling')

-- 생성자
function local_class:init(data_path, data_key, cs_behaviour)
	self.cs_behaviour = cs_behaviour

	data_key = lua_helper.get_or_default(data_key, 'default')

	-- 헬기의 x축 보정 값

	-- 헬기의 z축 보정 값

	self.move_sfx_name = lua_helper.get_or_default(data['move_sfx_name'], '01_propeller_01')

	-- 로직 시작 딜레이
	self.logic_delay = lua_helper.get_or_default(data['logic_delay'], 0)

	-- 헬기가 경유할 마커 이름들
	self.marker_name_list = data['patrol_marker_list']

	-- 스포트 라이트 이팩트
	self.spotlight_effect = nil

	-- 공격 범위 range
	self.attack_range = nil

	-- 실제로 공격하는 범위 range
	self.detect_range = self.attack_range_value * 0.75

	-- 록온 중 인가?
	self.is_lock_on = false

	-- 스포트 라이트 이팩트
	self.spotlight_effect = nil

	-- 순찰 중인가?
	self.is_patrolling = false

	-- 현재 마커의 인덱스
	self.current_index = -1

	-- 일시정지
	self.is_pause = false

	-- 헬기 움직이는 sfx
	self.move_sfx = nil

	-- 총알 쏘는 sfx
	self.bullet_sfx = nil
end

-- IFO에 붙었을 때
function local_class:attach_to(fo)
	self.fo = fo
	self.fo.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled
	self.res_holder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()

	-- 크기 70%로 감소
	self.fo.Transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 0.55
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.hide_effect_name)

	-- 구독
	self.cs_behaviour:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))
	self.cs_behaviour:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.StageEndEvent))
end

-- IFO에서 떨어졌을 때
function local_class:detach_from(_)
end

function local_class:unsubscribe_events()
	self.is_patrolling = false
	self.cs_behaviour:UnSubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))
	self.cs_behaviour:UnSubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.StageEndEvent))

	self:stop_move_sfx()
	self:stop_bullet_sfx()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self:unsubscribe_events()

	-- 어택 레인지 제거
	if self.attack_range ~= nil then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.attack_range)
		self.attack_range = nil
	end

	-- 스포트라이트 이팩트 제거
	if self.spotlight_effect ~= nil then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.spotlight_effect)
		self.spotlight_effect = nil
	end

	-- 리소스 홀더 Dispose
	if self.res_holder ~= nil then
		self.res_holder:Dispose()
		self.res_holder = nil
	end

	self.fo = nil
	self.cs_behaviour = nil
end

-- 현재 IFO가 취하고 있는 액션
function local_class:current_action()
	return CS.Oak.FieldObjectAction.None
end

-- 이벤트 호출
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent) then
		if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'patrolling_stop' then
			if e:GetParamAt(1) == nil then
				self.is_patrolling = false
				if self.spotlight_effect ~= nil then
					self.spotlight_effect:SetActive(false)
				end
			else
				if e:GetParamAt(1) == self.fo.Name then
					self.is_patrolling = false
					if self.spotlight_effect ~= nil then
						self.spotlight_effect:SetActive(false)
					end
				end
			end

			return true
		elseif e:GetParamAt(0) == 'patrolling_start' then
			if e:GetParamAt(1) == nil then
				return self:patrolling_start()
			else
				if e:GetParamAt(1) == self.fo.Name then
					return self:patrolling_start()
				end
			end
		end
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.StageEndEvent) then
		self:unsubscribe_events()
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:patrolling_start()
	-- 순찰 시작 함수 순찰 중이면 return
	if self.is_patrolling then
		return false
	end

	-- 순찰 시작
	self.is_patrolling = true
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.patrolling_routine, self))
	return true
end

function local_class:patrolling_routine()
	wait_for_sec(self.logic_delay)

	-- 순찰자 오브젝트 활성화
	self.fo.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled

	-- 어택 레인지 세팅
	self:set_attack_range()

	-- 스포트 라이트 세팅
	self:set_spotlight_effect()

	-- 시작 inddex 세팅
	self.current_index = 1

	local lock_on_target = user_party.Leader

	-- 순회 방향 정하기
	local traversal_dir = 1

	-- 첫 시작 좌표 및 도착 좌표 세팅
	local start_pos = field:GetMarker(self.marker_name_list[self.current_index]).position
	local end_pos = field:GetMarker(self.marker_name_list[self.current_index + traversal_dir]).position
	self.fo.Position = vector(start_pos.x, self.y_value, start_pos.z)

	-- 방향에 따른 보정값 넣어주기
	local direction = vector_util.to_direction(end_pos - start_pos)
	local spot_add_pos = self:get_spot_add_pos(direction)
	self:set_fo_direction(direction)

	-- 탄쏘는 딜레이용
	local cur_shout_time_passed = 0

	-- 움직이는 sfx
	self.move_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = self.move_sfx_name, parent = self.fo
	, loop = true, type_priority = 'gimmick', player_priority = 'object' })

	-- 게임이 끝날 때 까지 돈다.
	while self.is_patrolling do
		if not self.is_pause then
			-- 목표 마커까지 이동 중 target을 발견 시 is_lock_on true로 변경 후 공격
			local time_passed = 0.0
			local move_time = (end_pos - start_pos).magnitude / self.move_speed
			while time_passed <= move_time do
				if not self.is_patrolling then
					break
				end

				time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
				cur_shout_time_passed = cur_shout_time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

				local x = CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear(time_passed, start_pos.x, end_pos.x - start_pos.x, move_time)
				local z = CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear(time_passed, start_pos.z, end_pos.z - start_pos.z, move_time)
				self.fo.Position = vector(x, self.y_value, z)
				self.spotlight_effect.transform.position = vector(x + spot_add_pos.x, 0.02, z + spot_add_pos.z)

				if cur_shout_time_passed > self.shout_delay then
					cur_shout_time_passed = 0
					coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.shout_routine, self, lock_on_target))
				end

				coroutine.yield(nil)
			end

			if not self.is_patrolling then
				break
			end

			-- 록온 하지 않은 상태로 도착했을 경우는 다음 마커를 목표로 지정
			self.current_index = self.current_index + (1 * traversal_dir)
			if self.current_index >= #self.marker_name_list or self.current_index <= 1 then
				traversal_dir = traversal_dir == 1 and -1 or 1
			end

			start_pos = field:GetMarker(self.marker_name_list[self.current_index]).position
			end_pos = field:GetMarker(self.marker_name_list[self.current_index + traversal_dir]).position

			-- 회전 처리
			local start_angle = self.fo.transform.localRotation.eulerAngles.y
			local next_dir = (end_pos - start_pos):ToDirection()
			local next_angle = self:get_dir_vector(next_dir).y

			-- 0 -> 270, 270 -> 0 예외 처리
			if start_angle == 0 and next_angle == 270 then
				next_angle = -90
			elseif start_angle == 270 and next_angle == 0 then
				next_angle = 360
			end

			if start_angle ~= next_angle then
				self.spotlight_effect:SetActive(false)
				self:rotate_chopper(start_angle, next_angle - (start_angle % 360))
				if not self.is_patrolling then
					break
				end
				self.spotlight_effect:SetActive(true)
				spot_add_pos = self:get_spot_add_pos(next_dir)
			end
		end
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	self:stop_move_sfx()
	self:stop_bullet_sfx()

	local hide_effect = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.hide_effect_name):Instantiate(self.fo.Position)
	hide_effect.transform.localScale = vector(1.5, 1.5, 1.5)

	self.fo.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled
	self.spotlight_effect:SetActive(false)
	self.attack_range:Hide()
end

function local_class:shout_routine(lock_on_target)
	if self.spotlight_effect ~= nil then
		self.spotlight_effect:SetActive(true)
	end

	local spot_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(self.spotlight_effect.transform.position)
	self:show_bullet_effect(spot_pos, lock_on_target)
end

function local_class:get_spot_add_pos(dir)
	if dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Up then
		self.spotlight_effect.transform.rotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(-90, 0, 0)
		return unity_class.vector3(0, 0, 7.5)
	elseif dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Down then
		self.spotlight_effect.transform.rotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 0, 0)
		return unity_class.vector3(0, 0, -0.5)
	elseif dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Left then
		self.spotlight_effect.transform.rotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 0, -15)
		return unity_class.vector3(-1.5, 0, 0)
	elseif dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Right then
		self.spotlight_effect.transform.rotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 0, 15)
		return unity_class.vector3(1.5, 0, 0)
	end
end

-- 방향을 회전 벡터로 리턴해줌
function local_class:get_dir_vector(dir)
	if dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Up then
		return unity_class.vector3(0, 90, 0)
	elseif dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Down then
		return unity_class.vector3(0, 270, 0)
	elseif dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Left then
		return unity_class.vector3(0, 0, 0)
	elseif dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Right then
		return unity_class.vector3(0, 180, 0)
	end

	return unity_class.vector3(0, 0, 0)
end

-- 방향 설정
function local_class:set_fo_direction(direction)
	if CS.Oak.Direction.Left == direction then
		self.fo.transform.rotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 0, 0)
	elseif CS.Oak.Direction.Right == direction then
		self.fo.transform.rotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 180, 0)
	elseif CS.Oak.Direction.Up == direction then
		self.fo.transform.rotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 90, 0)
	elseif CS.Oak.Direction.Down == direction then
		self.fo.transform.rotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, -90, 0)
	end
end

-- 어택 레인지 세팅
function local_class:set_attack_range()
	if self.attack_range == nil then
		self.attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateCircle(unity_class.vector3.zero, self.attack_range_value)
	end
	self.attack_range:Hide()
end

-- 스포트라이트 이팩트 세팅
function local_class:set_spotlight_effect()
	if self.spotlight_effect == nil then
		yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync,
				self.res_holder, self.spot_light_asset_name, self.spot_light_name, function(prefab)
					self.spotlight_effect = CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Instantiate(prefab)
				end)
	end
	self.spotlight_effect:SetActive(true)
end

function local_class:show_bullet_effect(spot_pos, lock_on_target)
	attack_range_util.show(self.attack_range, 0)
	attack_range_util.setup_by_position(self.attack_range, spot_pos, 0)

	-- 데미지를 주었는가?
	local is_damaged = false
	self.bullet_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_hit_loop_01', loop = true, parent = self.fo })

	-- self.bullet_effect_time 동안 탄 발사 이팩트를 보여준다.
	local time_passed = 0
	local random_range = self.attack_range_value * 0.9
	while time_passed < self.bullet_effect_time do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		if self.spotlight_effect ~= nil then
			local pos = self.spotlight_effect.transform.position
			local rad = math.pi * CS.UnityEngine.Random.value * 2
			local x = math.cos(rad) * CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(0.1, random_range)
			local z = math.sin(rad) * CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(0.1, random_range)

			unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.bullet_effect_name):Instantiate(pos + vector(x, 0, z)
			, unity_class.quaternion.identity, self.spotlight_effect.transform)

			-- 총알 이팩트를 보여줄 때,아직 데미지를 받지 않았을 경우
			-- 스포트라이트와의 magnitude가 attack_range_value보다 작을 경우 데미지를 준다.
			if not is_damaged then
				local magnitude = vector_util.get_x0z(lock_on_target.Position - pos).magnitude
				if magnitude < self.attack_range_value then
					is_damaged = true
					self:damage_to_target(lock_on_target)
				end
			end

			-- 공격 범위 포지션 보정
			attack_range_util.setup_by_position(self.attack_range, pos, 0)
			wait_for_sec(0.02)
		end
	end

	self:stop_bullet_sfx()
	self.attack_range:Hide()
end

function local_class:damage_to_target(lock_on_target)
	-- 타겟이 CharacterControllerScreenplayState 상태일 경우는 리턴
	if lua_helper.type_compare(lock_on_target.FieldObjectController.CurrentState,
			CS.Oak.CharacterControllerScreenplayState) then
		return
	end

	local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
	damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Trap
	damage_info.sender = lock_on_target
	damage_info.target = lock_on_target
	damage_info.damage = math.floor(lock_on_target.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP * self.damage_rate)
	damage_info.notMortal = self.is_not_mortal
	damage_info.noCritical = true
	command_util.execute_damage(damage_info)
end

-- 회전 연출
function local_class:rotate_chopper(start_angle, rotate_angle)
	local timer = 0
	while timer < self.rotate_duration do
		timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		local cur_angle = start_angle + rotate_angle * (math.min(1 - (self.rotate_duration - timer) / self.rotate_duration, 1))
		self.fo.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(vector(0, cur_angle, 0))
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	self.fo.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(vector(0, start_angle + rotate_angle, 0))

	-- 회전 값 복구
	if start_angle + rotate_angle == -90 then
		self.fo.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(vector(0, 270, 0))
	elseif start_angle + rotate_angle == 360 then
		self.fo.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(vector(0, 0, 0))
	end
end

function local_class:active_pause()
	-- 순찰중이 아니면 리턴
	if not self.is_patrolling then
		return false
	end

	-- 순찰 일시 중지 함수
	self.is_pause = true

	-- 어택 레인지 Hide
	if self.attack_range ~= nil then
		self.attack_range:Hide()
	end

	-- 스포트 라이트 비활성화
	if self.spotlight_effect ~= nil then
		self.spotlight_effect:SetActive(false)
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:release_pause()
	-- 순찰중이 아니면 리턴
	if not self.is_patrolling then
		return false
	end
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.release_pause_routine, self))
	return true
end

function local_class:release_pause_routine()
	wait_for_sec(0.25)

	-- 스포트 라이트 활성화
	if self.spotlight_effect ~= nil then
		self.spotlight_effect:SetActive(true)
	end

	-- 일시 정지 해제
	self.is_pause = false

	return true
end

function local_class:stop_move_sfx()
	if self.move_sfx == nil then
		return
	end

	self.move_sfx:Stop()
	self.move_sfx = nil
end

function local_class:stop_bullet_sfx()
	if self.bullet_sfx == nil then
		return
	end

	self.bullet_sfx:FadeOut(2)
	self.bullet_sfx = nil
end

function local_class:update_frame(_)
end

return {
	create = function(data_path, data_key, cs_behaviour)
		return local_class(data_path, data_key, cs_behaviour)
	end
}

local local_class = newclass('CoopEscapeTubeBehaviour')

function local_class:init(data_path, data_key, cs_behaviour)
	self.cs_behaviour = cs_behaviour

	data_key = lua_helper.get_or_default(data_key, 'default')
	if data_key == '' then
		data_key = 'default'
	end

	local data = load_util.load_lua_gimmick_data(data_path, data_key)

	-- 애니메이션 키
	self.animation_key = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'animation', 'start')
	-- 준비 효과음
	self.prepare_sfx_name = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'prepare_sfx')
	-- 시작 효과음
	self.start_sfx_name = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'start_sfx')
end

--region IComponent
function local_class:attach_to(fo)
	self.fo = fo
	self.animator = fo:GetComponentInChildren(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))

	-- 이벤트 구독
	self.on_event_func = function(e)
		self:on_count_down(e)
	end
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.CoopStageCountDownEvent), self.on_event_func)

	self.shaking = false
end

function local_class:detach_from(fo)
	self.fo = nil
	self.animator = nil

	-- 구독 해제
	if self.on_event_func then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.CoopStageCountDownEvent), self.on_event_func)
		self.on_event_func = nil
	end
end
--endregion

--region IFieldObjectBehaviour
function local_class:current_state()
	return nil
end

function local_class:current_action()
	return CS.Oak.FieldObjectAction.Stopped
end
--endregion

-- update frame
function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.shaking == true then
		self.shake_time = self.shake_time + dt
		local shake_value_x = self.shake_time * 0.13 * math.sin(2 * math.pi * self.shake_time * 8) * unity_class.vector3.right
		local shake_value_z = self.shake_time * 0.08 * math.sin(2 * math.pi * self.shake_time * 13) * unity_class.vector3.up

		self.fo.Position = self.shake_origin_pos + shake_value_x + shake_value_z
	end
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_count_down(e)
	if e.Count == 2 then
		-- 진동
		self.shaking = true
		self.shake_time = 0
		self.shake_origin_pos = self.fo.Position
	elseif e.Count == 1 then
		-- prepare SFX Play
		if (not string_helper.is_nil_or_empty(self.prepare_sfx_name)) then
			music_player:PlaySfx({ sfxName = self.prepare_sfx_name, playPosition = self.fo.Position,
								   typePriority = CS.Oak.SfxTypePriority.Gimmick})
		end
	elseif e.Count == 0 then
		-- 애니메이션 실행
		self.animator:Play(self.animation_key, -1, 0)
		self.shaking = false
		self.fo.Position = self.shake_origin_pos

		-- start SFX Play
		if (not string_helper.is_nil_or_empty(self.start_sfx_name)) then
			music_player:PlaySfx({ sfxName = self.start_sfx_name, playPosition = self.fo.Position,
								   typePriority = CS.Oak.SfxTypePriority.Gimmick, delayedTime = 0.2})
		end
	end

	return false
end
--endregion

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	self.cs_behaviour:ChangeState(next_state)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self:change_state()
end

return {
	create = function(data_path, data_key, cs_behaviour)
		return local_class(data_path, data_key, cs_behaviour)
	end
}

local local_class = newclass('DamageField')

-- FIXME: 추후 내부 벡터 계산에 사용 하기 위한 루아 vector 로 분리 되고 사용 할 방법을 고민 해봐야 한다.
-- 현재는 매우 심플하게 필요한 기능만 구현. (시간이 없음 - v2.17)
lua_vector = {}

lua_vector.__index = lua_vector

lua_vector.new = function(x, y, z)
	return setmetatable({ x = x or 0, y = y or 0, z = z or 0 }, lua_vector)
end

function lua_vector.__eq(lhs, rhs)
	if (lhs ~= nil and rhs == nil) or (lhs == nil and rhs ~= nil) then
		return
	end

	return lhs.x == rhs.x and lhs.y == rhs.y and lhs.z == rhs.z
end

--- 생성자
--- @param data_path string 해당 기믹이 사용할 Data의 경로.
--- @param data_key string 해당 기믹이 사용할 Data의 Key.
--- @param cs_behaviour any 해당 기믹의 C# Behaviour.
function local_class:init(data_path, data_key, cs_behaviour)
	self.cs_behaviour = cs_behaviour

	self.tiles = {}

	self.effects = {}

	self.frame_count = 0

	self.viewport_modifier = 1 / 1.414;
	self.effect_name = 'fx_coop_env_bugs_flying_nontop'
	self.remove_effect_name = 'fx_coop_env_bugs_flying_end_nontop'

	self.effect_mat = nil

	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.effect_name)

	local data = load_util.load_lua_gimmick_data(data_path, data_key)

	self.region_rect = nil

	if data.region == nil or not data.region then
		for i = data.marker_start_end_index[1], data.marker_start_end_index[2] do
			local marker_pos = field:GetMarker(data.marker_name .. i).position
			local cur_pos = lua_vector.new(math.floor(marker_pos.x), math.floor(marker_pos.y), math.floor(marker_pos.z))
			if not table_util.contain_value(self.tiles, cur_pos) then
				table.insert(self.tiles, cur_pos)
			end
		end
		-- 광역 공간에 마커 전부 깔기 힘들어서 특정 마커 A ~ B 사이의 공간 타일 전부 찾아서 벌레 설치함
		-- 소수점은 전부 버리고 정수 좌표만 받아옴
		-- Y 좌표는 고려 안함
	else
		-- region 의 경우 요 안에 안들어가면 아무것도 체크 하지 않는다. 카메라 체크 전에 해도 문제 없을듯.
		self.region_rect = { left = 9999999, right = -9999999, bottom = 9999999, top = -9999999 }
		self.region_rect.contains = function(rect, p)
			return p.x >= rect.left and p.x <= rect.right and p.z >= rect.bottom and p.z <= rect.top
		end

		local start_pos = field:GetMarker(data.marker_name .. data.marker_start_end_index[1]).position
		local end_pos = field:GetMarker(data.marker_name .. data.marker_start_end_index[2]).position
		for i = math.floor(start_pos.x), math.floor(end_pos.x) do
			for j = math.floor(start_pos.z), math.floor(end_pos.z) do
				local cur_pos = lua_vector.new(i, start_pos.y, j)
				if not table_util.contain_value(self.tiles, cur_pos) then
					table.insert(self.tiles, cur_pos)

					self.region_rect.left = math.min(self.region_rect.left, i)
					self.region_rect.right = math.max(self.region_rect.right, i)
					self.region_rect.bottom = math.min(self.region_rect.bottom, j)
					self.region_rect.top = math.max(self.region_rect.top, j)
				end
			end
		end
	end

	self.damage_rate = data.damage_rate
	self.damage_term = data.damage_term
	self.knock_back_force = data.knock_back_force
	self.no_effect = lua_helper.get_or_default(data.no_effect, false)

	self.is_leader_on_upper_floor = false

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.load_resource, self))
end

-- IFO에 붙었을 때
function local_class:attach_to(fo)
	self.fo = fo

	self.is_update = true
	self.elapse_time = 0.0
	self.damageImmediately = true

	self.viewport_scaler = CS.ViewportScaler.Instance
	self.viewport_scaler_camera = self.viewport_scaler.CurrentCamera
	self.stage_cam = stage_camera.Camera
end

-- IFO에서 떨어졌을 때
function local_class:detach_from(fo)
	self.is_update = false

	for i = 1, #self.effects do
		if not is_unity_null(self.effects[i]) then
			self.effects[remove_tiles[i]]:Dispose()
			self.effects[remove_tiles[i]] = nil
		end
	end
end

-- 현재 기본 스테이트 얻기(아이들, 걷기 등 전신 및 하체 상태)
function local_class:current_state()
	return nil
end

-- 현재 IFO가 취하고 있는 액션
function local_class:current_action()
	return CS.Oak.FieldObjectAction.None
end

-- 업데이트. attach_to가 불린 시점부터 detach_from 이 불린 시점까지 매 프레임 불린다.
function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	-- Active상태 아니면 리턴
	if is_unity_null(self.fo) or not self.is_update then
		return
	end

	-- 스테이지 컨트롤 될 수 없는 상황이면 리턴
	if not stage.StageControlStarted then
		return
	end

	local leader = user_party.Leader

	-- 리더가 죽어있으면 리턴
	if leader.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead then
		return
	end

	local leader_pos = leader.Position

	if not is_unity_null(self.effect_mat) and field:IsOnUpperFloor(leader_pos) ~= self.is_leader_on_upper_floor then
		self.is_leader_on_upper_floor = not self.is_leader_on_upper_floor
		if self.is_leader_on_upper_floor then
			self.effect_mat.renderQueue = 2450
		else
			self.effect_mat.renderQueue = 3000
		end
	end

	local visible_tiles = self:get_visible_tiles()

	if not self.no_effect then
		self:update_effect(visible_tiles)
	end

	if #visible_tiles == 0 then
		return
	end

	local round_leader_pos = lua_vector.new(self:round(leader_pos.x), self:round(leader_pos.y), self:round(leader_pos.z))
	---- region_rect 가 있을 때만 해당 펑션을 제일 먼저 처리. region 단위 이기 때문에 요 안에 없으면 없는 것
	if self.region_rect ~= nil and not self.region_rect.contains(self.region_rect, round_leader_pos) then
		self.damageImmediately = true
		return
	elseif not self:is_in_tiles(leader_pos, visible_tiles) then
		self.damageImmediately = true
		return
	end

	if not self.damageImmediately then
		self.elapse_time = self.elapse_time + dt
		if self.elapse_time < self.damage_term then
			return
		end
	end

	local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
	damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Trap
	damage_info.sender = self.fo
	damage_info.target = user_party.Leader
	damage_info.damage = math.floor(user_party.Leader.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP * self.damage_rate)
	damage_info.critical = false
	damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
	damage_info.knockBackForce = self.knock_back_force
	local dir = (user_party.Leader.Position - self:get_in_field(user_party.Leader.Position)):ToDirection()
	local dir_vector
	if dir == CS.Oak.Direction.None then
		dir_vector = direction_util.to_vector3(direction_util.get_opposite(user_party.Leader.Direction))
	else
		dir_vector = direction_util.to_vector3(dir)
	end

	damage_info.knockBackDirection = dir_vector
	command_util.execute_damage(damage_info)

	self.elapse_time = 0.0
	self.damageImmediately = false
end

-- 이벤트 호출
function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

--- Behaviour에 있는 StateMachine의 State를 변경
function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	self.cs_behaviour:ChangeState(next_state)
end

function local_class:load_resource()
	self.resource_holder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()
	local container_obj = load_util.load_prefab_async(self.resource_holder,
			'ondemand/v2_17_demonworld_2/effects', 'bug_material_container')

	local mat_container = container_obj:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.MaterialContainer))
	self.effect_mat = mat_container.MaterialList[0]

	CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(container_obj_1)
end

function local_class:update_effect(visual_tiles)
	local new_tiles = {}
	for i = 1, #visual_tiles do
		if self.effects[visual_tiles[i]] == nil then
			table.insert(new_tiles, visual_tiles[i])
		end
	end

	local remove_tiles = {}
	for key, _ in pairs(self.effects) do
		if not table_util.contain_value(visual_tiles, key) then
			table.insert(remove_tiles, key)
		end
	end

	for i = 1, #new_tiles do
		local effect = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.effect_name):Instantiate(new_tiles[i])
		self.effects[new_tiles[i]] = effect
	end

	for i = 1, #remove_tiles do
		self.effects[remove_tiles[i]]:Dispose()
		self.effects[remove_tiles[i]] = nil

		unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.remove_effect_name):Instantiate(remove_tiles[i])
	end
end
function local_class:is_in_tiles(pos, tiles)
	for _, compare in ipairs(tiles) do
		if compare.x == self:round(pos.x) and compare.y == self:round(pos.y) then
			if pos.z > compare.z then
				if pos.z >= compare.z and pos.z <= compare.z + 1 then
					return true
				end
			else
				if self:round(pos.z) == compare.z then
					return true
				end
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:is_in_field(pos)
	for _, compare in ipairs(self.tiles) do
		if compare.x == self:round(pos.x) and compare.y == self:round(pos.y) then
			if pos.z > compare.z then
				if pos.z >= compare.z and pos.z <= compare.z + 1 then
					return true
				end
			else
				if self:round(pos.z) == compare.z then
					return true
				end
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:get_in_field(pos)
	local current_pos = lua_vector.new(self:round(pos.x), self:round(pos.y), self:round(pos.z))
	for _, compare in ipairs(self.tiles) do
		if current_pos == compare then
			return compare
		end
	end

	return unity_class.vector3.zero
end

function local_class:round(val)
	return math.floor(val + 0.5)
end

function local_class:is_pos_in_camera(pos)
	local cam_half_height = stage_camera.Size
	local cam_half_width = stage_camera.HalfWidth
	local camera_pos = stage_camera.LookAtPosition

	if math.abs(camera_pos.x - pos.x) > cam_half_width + 4 or
			-- 카메라의 y값도 보정해서 계산
			math.abs(camera_pos.y * self.viewport_modifier + camera_pos.z - pos.z) > cam_half_height + 4 then
		return false
	end

	return true
end

-- 하나씩 하면 느림 벌크로 돌려야 한다.
function local_class:get_visible_tiles()
	local visible_tiles = {}

	local cam_half_height = stage_camera.Size
	local cam_half_width = stage_camera.HalfWidth
	local camera_pos = stage_camera.LookAtPosition
	local cam_x = camera_pos.x
	local cam_y = camera_pos.y
	local cam_z = camera_pos.z

	for i = 1, #self.tiles do
		local pos = self.tiles[i]
		if math.abs(cam_x - pos.x) <= cam_half_width + 4 and
				-- 카메라의 y값도 보정해서 계산
				math.abs(cam_y * self.viewport_modifier + cam_z - pos.z) <= cam_half_height + 4 then
			table.insert(visible_tiles, self.tiles[i])
		end
	end

	return visible_tiles
end

function local_class:set_is_update(is_update)
	self.is_update = is_update
end

function local_class:set_active(active)
	self:set_is_update(active)

	if not self.no_effect then
		if active then
			self:update_effect(self.tiles)
		else
			self:update_effect({})
		end
	end
end

--- LuaMessageSystem(message_system)을 이용하여 콜백을 등록하였을 경우 이 곳에서 해제하여야 한다.
--- detach_from의 경우 LuaMessageSystem이 이미 날아간 상태이기 때문에 Leak발생함.
function local_class:dispose()
	self:change_state()
end

return {
	create = function(data_path, data_key, cs_behaviour)
		return local_class(data_path, data_key, cs_behaviour)
	end
}
