local local_class = newclass('DroneStalker')

-- 생성자
function local_class:init(data_path, data_key, cs_behaviour)
	self.cs_behaviour = cs_behaviour

	data_key = lua_helper.get_or_default(data_key, 'default')
	if data_key == '' then
		data_key = 'default'
	end

	local data = load_util.load_lua_gimmick_data(data_path, data_key)

	-- 스포트라이트 이팩트 에셋번들 이름
	self.spot_light_asset_name = lua_helper.get_or_default(data['spot_light_asset_name'], 'ondemand/v2_15_demonworld/effects')

	-- 스포트라이트 이팩트 이름
	self.spot_light_name = lua_helper.get_or_default(data['spot_light_name'], 'fx_spotlight_police')

	-- 총알 이팩트 이름
	self.bullet_effect_name = lua_helper.get_or_default(data['bullet_effect_name'], 'FX_GunShot_Groundhit')

	-- 드론 사라질 때 이팩트 이름
	self.hide_effect_name = lua_helper.get_or_default(data['hide_effect_name'], 'FX_reset_object')

	-- 공격 범위
	self.attack_range_value = lua_helper.get_or_default(data['attack_range_value'], 1.25)

	-- 추격자의 이동속도
	self.move_speed = lua_helper.get_or_default(data['move_speed'], 7.5)

	-- 록 온 시간
	self.lock_on_time = lua_helper.get_or_default(data['lock_on_time'], 0.5)

	-- 주는 데미지 비율
	self.damage_rate = lua_helper.get_or_default(data['damage_rate'], 0.05)

	-- not_mortal 세팅
	self.is_not_mortal = lua_helper.get_or_default(data['is_not_mortal'], true)

	-- 탄 이팩트 보여주는 시간
	self.bullet_effect_time = lua_helper.get_or_default(data['bullet_effect_time'], 0.3)

	-- 드론이 공중에 떠있는 y축 값
	self.y_value = lua_helper.get_or_default(data['y_value'], 5)

	-- 드론이 움직일 때 나올 sfx 이름
	self.move_sfx_name = lua_helper.get_or_default(data['move_sfx_name'], '01_propeller_02')

	-- 스포트 라이트 이팩트
	self.spotlight_effect = nil

	-- 공격 범위 range
	self.attack_range = nil

	-- 실제로 공격하는 범위 range
	self.detect_range = self.attack_range_value * 0.75

	-- pause를 풀 때 좌표를 리셋해줄 최소 거리 값
	self.pause_reset_dist = 15

	-- 록온 중 인가?
	self.is_lock_on = false

	-- 스포트 라이트 이팩트
	self.spotlight_effect = nil

	-- 일시정지 상태 인가?
	self.is_pause = false

	-- 따라 다니는 중인가?
	self.is_stalking = false

	-- 드론 움직이는 sfx
	self.move_sfx = nil

	-- 총쏘는 sfx
	self.bullet_sfx = nil
end

-- IFO에 붙었을 때
function local_class:attach_to(fo)
	self.fo = fo
	self.res_holder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()

	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.hide_effect_name)

	-- CustomStageEvent 구독
	self.cs_behaviour:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))
	self.cs_behaviour:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.StageEndEvent))
end

-- IFO에서 떨어졌을 때
function local_class:detach_from(_)
end

function local_class:unsubscribe_events()
	self.is_stalking = false
	self.cs_behaviour:UnSubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))
	self.cs_behaviour:UnSubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.StageEndEvent))
	self:stop_move_sfx()
	self:stop_bullet_sfx()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self:unsubscribe_events()

	-- 어택 레인지 제거
	if self.attack_range ~= nil then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.attack_range)
		self.attack_range = nil
	end

	-- 스포트라이트 이팩트 제거
	if self.spotlight_effect ~= nil then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.spotlight_effect)
		self.spotlight_effect = nil
	end

	-- 리소스 홀더 Dispose
	if self.res_holder ~= nil then
		self.res_holder:Dispose()
		self.res_holder = nil
	end

	self.fo = nil
	self.cs_behaviour = nil
end

-- 현재 IFO가 취하고 있는 액션
function local_class:current_action()
	return CS.Oak.FieldObjectAction.None
end

-- 이벤트 호출
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent) then
		if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'stalking_stop' then
			self.is_stalking = false
			return true
		elseif e:GetParamAt(0) == 'stalking_start' then
			return self:stalking_start()
		elseif e:GetParamAt(0) == 'stalking_pause' then
			return self:active_pause()
		elseif e:GetParamAt(0) == 'stalking_resume' then
			return self:release_pause()
		end
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.StageEndEvent) then
		self:unsubscribe_events()
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:stalking_start()
	-- 추격 시작 함수 추격 중이면 return
	if self.is_stalking then
		return false
	end
	-- 추격 시작
	self.is_stalking = true

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.stalking_routine, self))
	return true
end

function local_class:stalking_routine()
	-- 록온 타겟은 리더
	--TODO: 현재는 록온 타겟을 리더로 고정하였는데, 고정하지 않을 거라면 CustomStageEvent로 추적할 캐릭터 이름을 받게 해야함
	local lock_on_target = user_party.Leader

	-- 록온 중인가?
	local is_lock_on = false

	-- 추격자 오브젝트 활성화
	self.fo.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled

	-- 어택 레인지 세팅
	self:set_attack_range()

	-- 스포트 라이트 세팅
	self:set_spotlight_effect()

	-- 1초 딜레이 있다가 시작
	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 주변에서 너무 멀리 있을 수 있으므로 보정 값
	local xz_vector = vector_util.get_x0z(lock_on_target.Position - self.fo.Position)
	local magnitude = xz_vector.magnitude
	if magnitude >= self.pause_reset_dist then
		self:set_drone_position_for_target(lock_on_target)
	end

	-- 움직이는 sfx
	local play_move_sfx = function()
		-- 플레이어가 죽은 경우에는 재생하지 않음
		if self.move_sfx == nil and not user_party_leader.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead then
			self.move_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = self.move_sfx_name, parent = self.fo
			, loop = true, type_priority = 'gimmick', player_priority = 'object' })
		end
	end

	-- 게임이 끝날 때 까지 돈다.
	play_move_sfx()
	while self.is_stalking do
		if not self.is_pause then
			if not is_lock_on then
				xz_vector = vector_util.get_x0z(lock_on_target.Position - self.fo.Position)
				magnitude = xz_vector.magnitude
				if magnitude <= self.detect_range then
					self:stop_move_sfx()
					is_lock_on = true
				else
					local normalized = xz_vector.normalized
					local cur_pos = normalized * self.move_speed * unity_class.time.deltaTime
					self.fo.Position = vector(self.fo.Position.x + cur_pos.x, lock_on_target.Position.y + self.y_value, self.fo.Position.z + cur_pos.z)
					self.spotlight_effect.transform.position = vector_util.get_x0z(self.fo.Position)
				end
			else
				-- 록온중 일 때 self.lock_on_time초간 범위를 보여 주고 난 뒤
				local spot_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(self.fo.Position)

				attack_range_util.setup_by_position(self.attack_range, spot_pos, 0)
				attack_range_util.show(self.attack_range, 0)

				wait_for_sec(self.lock_on_time)
				if not self.is_stalking then
					break
				end

				-- 데미지를 주며 총알 이팩트를 보여준다.
				self.attack_range:Hide()
				self:execute_damage_in_attack_range_radius(spot_pos, lock_on_target)
				self:show_bullet_effect(spot_pos)

				-- 0.2초 후 록온 해지
				wait_for_sec(0.2)
				if not self.is_stalking then
					break
				end
				is_lock_on = false
				play_move_sfx()
			end
		end
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	self:stop_move_sfx()
	self:stop_bullet_sfx()

	self.is_pause = false
	local hide_effect = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.hide_effect_name):Instantiate(self.fo.Position)
	hide_effect.transform.localScale = vector(1.5, 1.5, 1.5)

	self.fo.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled
	self.spotlight_effect:SetActive(false)
	self.attack_range:Hide()
end

function local_class:set_drone_position_for_target(target)
	local rnd_dir = random_util.get_random_int(1, 4)

	if rnd_dir == 1 then
		self.fo.Position = target.Position + vector(self.pause_reset_dist, 0, 0)
	elseif rnd_dir == 2 then
		self.fo.Position = target.Position + vector(-self.pause_reset_dist, 0, 0)
	elseif rnd_dir == 3 then
		self.fo.Position = target.Position + vector(0, 0, self.pause_reset_dist)
	else
		self.fo.Position = target.Position + vector(0, 0, -self.pause_reset_dist)
	end
end

-- 어택 레인지 세팅
function local_class:set_attack_range()
	if self.attack_range == nil then
		self.attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateCircle(unity_class.vector3.zero, self.attack_range_value)
	end

	self.attack_range:Hide()
end

-- 스포트라이트 이팩트 세팅
function local_class:set_spotlight_effect()
	if self.spotlight_effect == nil then
		yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync,
				self.res_holder, self.spot_light_asset_name, self.spot_light_name, function(prefab)
					self.spotlight_effect = CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Instantiate(prefab)
				end)
	end

	self.spotlight_effect:SetActive(true)
end

function local_class:execute_damage_in_attack_range_radius(pos, target)
	-- 타겟이 CharacterControllerScreenplayState 상태일 경우는 리턴
	if lua_helper.type_compare(target.FieldObjectController.CurrentState,
			CS.Oak.CharacterControllerScreenplayState) then
		return
	end

	-- 데미지를 준다.
	local hittable_targets = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(pos, self.attack_range_value)
	for i = 0, hittable_targets.Count - 1 do
		local hittable_target = hittable_targets[i]
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(hittable_target, target) then
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(nil, { 'detect_stalker' }))

			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Trap
			damage_info.sender = hittable_target
			damage_info.target = hittable_target
			damage_info.damage = math.floor(hittable_target.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP * self.damage_rate)
			damage_info.notMortal = self.is_not_mortal
			damage_info.noCritical = true
			command_util.execute_damage(damage_info)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:show_bullet_effect(target_pos)
	self.bullet_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_hit_loop_01', loop = true, parent = self.fo })
	-- self.bullet_effect_time 동안 탄 발사 이팩트를 보여준다.
	local time_passed = 0
	local random_range = self.attack_range_value * 0.9
	while time_passed < self.bullet_effect_time do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		local rad = math.pi * CS.UnityEngine.Random.value * 2
		local x = math.cos(rad) * CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(0.1, random_range)
		local z = math.sin(rad) * CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(0.1, random_range)
		unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.bullet_effect_name):Instantiate(target_pos + vector(x, 0, z))
		wait_for_sec(0.02)
	end
	self:stop_bullet_sfx()
end

function local_class:active_pause()
	-- 추격 일시 중지 함수
	self.is_pause = true

	-- 추격중이 아니면 리턴
	if not self.is_stalking then
		return false
	end

	-- 어택 레인지 Hide
	if self.attack_range ~= nil then
		self.attack_range:Hide()
	end

	-- 스포트 라이트 비활성화
	if self.spotlight_effect ~= nil then
		self.spotlight_effect:SetActive(false)
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:release_pause()
	-- 일시 정지 해제
	self.is_pause = false

	-- 추격중이 아니면 리턴
	if not self.is_stalking then
		return false
	end

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.release_pause_routine, self))
	return true
end

function local_class:release_pause_routine()
	wait_for_sec(0.25)

	-- 스포트 라이트 활성화
	if self.spotlight_effect ~= nil then
		self.spotlight_effect:SetActive(true)
	end

	-- pause를 풀 때 너무 멀리 떨어져있으면 근처로 이동
	local xz_vector = vector_util.get_x0z(user_party.Leader.Position - self.fo.Position)
	local magnitude = xz_vector.magnitude
	if magnitude >= self.pause_reset_dist then
		self:set_drone_position_for_target(user_party.Leader)
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:stop_move_sfx()
	if self.move_sfx == nil then
		return
	end

	self.move_sfx:Stop()
	self.move_sfx = nil
end

function local_class:stop_bullet_sfx()
	if self.bullet_sfx == nil then
		return
	end

	self.bullet_sfx:Stop()
	self.bullet_sfx = nil
end

function local_class:update_frame(_)
end

return {
	create = function(data_path, data_key, cs_behaviour)
		return local_class(data_path, data_key, cs_behaviour)
	end
}

local local_class = newclass('ExclusiveEventDoor')

--- 생성자
--- @param data_path string 해당 기믹이 사용할 Data의 경로.
--- @param data_key string 해당 기믹이 사용할 Data의 Key.
--- @param cs_behaviour any 해당 기믹의 C# Behaviour.
function local_class:init(data_path, data_key, cs_behaviour)
	self.cs_behaviour = cs_behaviour

	local data
	-- 기믹 데이터
	if data_key == nil or data_key == '' then
		data = load_util.load_lua_gimmick_data(data_path, 'default')
	else
		data = load_util.load_lua_gimmick_data(data_path, data_key)
	end

	-- event key
	-- 다수의 키를 받길 원하는 경우 list로 수정 필요
	self.exclusive_event_key = data['event_key']

	-- sfx
	self.play_sfx = data['play_sfx']
	self.show_sfx_name = data['show_sfx_name']
	self.destroy_sfx_name = data['destroy_sfx_name']

	self.show_anim_clip_name = 'start'
	self.end_anim_clip_name = 'end'

	self.battle_gate_animator = nil

	self.gate_state = {
		ready = 0,
		enabled = 1,
		close = 2,
		disabled = 3 -- 기존 battle gate처럼 완전히 제거 할 경우 로직 추가해야함
	}

	self.current_gate_state = self.gate_state.ready

	-- 예외처리 추가
	self.gate_open = true
end

-- IFO에 붙었을 때
function local_class:attach_to(fo)
	self.fo = fo

	self.battle_gate_animator = fo.transform:GetComponentInChildren(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))

	fo.EntityGroup = CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Neutral0
	fo.ActiveState =  CS.Oak.ActiveState.Visible

	-- 이벤트 구독
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageStartEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageEndEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ExclusiveQuestStartEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ExclusiveQuestEndEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.AnimationEndEvent), 'on_event')
end

-- IFO에서 떨어졌을 때
function local_class:detach_from(fo)
end

function local_class:unsubscribe_events()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageStartEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageEndEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ExclusiveQuestStartEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ExclusiveQuestEndEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.AnimationEndEvent))
end

--- LuaMessageSystem(message_system)을 이용하여 콜백을 등록하였을 경우 이 곳에서 해제하여야 한다.
--- detach_from의 경우 LuaMessageSystem이 이미 날아간 상태이기 때문에 Leak발생함.
function local_class:dispose()
	self:unsubscribe_events()
	self.battle_gate_animator = nil

	self.fo = nil
	self.cs_behaviour = nil
end

-- 현재 기본 스테이트 얻기(아이들, 걷기 등 전신 및 하체 상태)
function local_class:current_state()
	return nil
end

-- 현재 IFO가 취하고 있는 액션
function local_class:current_action()
	return CS.Oak.FieldObjectAction.None
end

--region event
-- 이벤트 호출
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.StageStartEvent) then
		return self:on_stage_start_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ExclusiveQuestStartEvent) then
		return self:on_exclusive_quest_start_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ExclusiveQuestEndEvent) then
		return self:on_exclusive_quest_end_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.AnimationEndEvent) then
		return self:on_animation_end_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.StageEndEvent) then
		self:unsubscribe_events()
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_stage_start_event(e)
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
		-- 시작 시 문 열어줌
		self.battle_gate_animator:Play(self.end_anim_clip_name, -1, 0)
	end))
	return false
end

function local_class:on_exclusive_quest_start_event(e)
	if e.Key == self.exclusive_event_key and self.gate_open then
		self.gate_open = false
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.door_close, self))
		return true
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_exclusive_quest_end_event(e)
	if e.Key == self.exclusive_event_key and self.fo.ActiveState == CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled and
			self.current_gate_state == self.gate_state.enabled and not self.gate_open then
		self.gate_open = true
		self.current_gate_state = self.gate_state.close
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.door_open, self))
		return true
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_animation_end_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.fo, e.Sender) and self.fo.ActiveState ~= CS.OaK.ActiveState.disabled then
		self.fo.ActiveState =  CS.Oak.ActiveState.Visible
		self.current_gate_state = self.gate_state.ready
		return true
	end

	return false
end
--endregion

-- 업데이트. attach_to가 불린 시점부터 detach_from 이 불린 시점까지 매 프레임 불린다.
function local_class:update_frame(dt)
end

-- 문 닫힘
function local_class:door_close()
	-- 문이 완전히 열린 상태가 아니라면 대기
	while self.current_gate_state ~= self.gate_state.ready and
			self.fo.ActiveState ~= CS.Oak.ActiveState.Visible do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	self.current_gate_state = self.gate_state.enabled
	self.fo.ActiveState =  CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled

	if self.play_sfx then
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = self.show_sfx_name,
									 type_priority = 'default', play_pos = self.fo.Position })
	end

	self.battle_gate_animator:Play(self.show_anim_clip_name, -1, 0)

	self.fo.EntityGroup = self.fo.EntityGroup | CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Obstacle
end

-- 문 열림
function local_class:door_open()
	if self.play_sfx then
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = self.destroy_sfx_name,
									 type_priority = 'default', play_pos = self.fo.Position })
	end

	self.battle_gate_animator:Play(self.end_anim_clip_name, -1, 0)
	self.fo.EntityGroup = self.fo.EntityGroup & CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Neutral0
end

return {
	create = function(data_path, data_key, cs_behaviour)
		return local_class(data_path, data_key, cs_behaviour)
	end
}

local local_class = newclass("FestivalCannon")

-- 생성자
function local_class:init()
	self.state = {
		none = 1, -- 포신이 내려가있는 상태
		rotate = 2, -- 포신이 돌아가고 있는 상태
		shot_ready = 3, -- 포신이 올라가고있는 상태
		burning = 4, -- 포신이 완전히 올라가고 불이 붙어있는 상태
		ride = 5, -- 파티가 대포에 탑승한 상태
		shoot = 6, -- 파티가 쏴지는 상태
		land = 7 --파티가 착륙하는 상태
	}

	-- TODO: 명시적으로 로드를 기다리게 하고싶지만 현재 기믹에는 로드 대기 구조가 마련돼있지않음. 추후에 개선
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_dead')
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_Common_Jump_small')

	-- 기믹 레이어에서 축제캐논 비헤비어를 가진 애들만 찾아서 매핑
	self.cannon_states = {}
	self.cannons = {}
	local gimmick_layer = stage.StageGameObject.transform:Find(stage.Name .. '/gimmick/')
	for i = 0, gimmick_layer.childCount - 1 do
		local cannon = gimmick_layer:GetChild(i):GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObject))
		if lua_helper.type_compare(cannon.FieldObjectBehaviour, CS.Oak.FestivalCannonBehaviour) then
			self.cannon_states[cannon] = self.state.none
			table.insert(self.cannons, cannon)
		end
	end

	-- 업데이트 루틴을 실행시켜줌.
	-- C# 수정을 할수가없어서, 내부에서 코루틴을 생성해 업데이트를 돌려줌.
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.update, self))
end

function local_class:change_state(cannon, state)
	self.cannon_states[cannon] = state
end

function local_class:get_current_state(cannon)
	return self.cannon_states[cannon]
end

function local_class:update()
	while true do
		for _, cannon in pairs(self.cannons) do
			local radius = math.max(cannon.Bounds.extents.x, cannon.Bounds.extents.z) * 1.5
			local targets = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(cannon.Bounds.center, radius)
			for i = 0, targets.Count - 1 do
				local target = targets[i]
				local is_burning = not target.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead and target.CombustibleBehaviour.IsBurning
				if is_burning and self:get_current_state(cannon) == self.state.none then
					coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.shot_ready, self, cannon))
				end
			end
			targets:Dispose()
		end

		coroutine.yield()
	end
end

function local_class:shot_ready(cannon)
	self:change_state(cannon, self.state.shot_ready)

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_push_rock_unit_02', play_pos = cannon.Position })
	animator_util.play_async(cannon, 'ready', 0.55)

	self:change_state(cannon, self.state.burning)
end

function local_class:rotate(cannon)
	self:change_state(cannon, self.state.rotate)

	music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '01_push_rock_unit_01'})

	local rotate_duration = 0.3125
	local cannon_mesh = cannon.Transform:Find('mesh')
	local start_rot = cannon_mesh.localRotation
	local target_dir = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(90, unity_class.vector3.up) * cannon_mesh.transform.right
	local end_rot = unity_class.quaternion.FromToRotation(unity_class.vector3.right, target_dir)
	local time_passed = 0
	while time_passed <= rotate_duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / rotate_duration)
		local cur_rot = unity_class.quaternion.Lerp(start_rot, end_rot, progress)
		cannon_mesh.transform.localRotation = cur_rot

		coroutine.yield()
	end

	cannon_mesh.transform.localRotation = end_rot

	self:change_state(cannon, self.state.none)
end

function local_class:on_interact(cannon, marker_name)
	if self:get_current_state(cannon) ~= self.state.none and self:get_current_state(cannon) ~= self.state.burning then return end

	if self:get_current_state(cannon) == self.state.none then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.rotate, self, cannon)
	else
		self:change_state(cannon, self.state.ride)
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.process, self, cannon, marker_name)
	end
end

function local_class:process(cannon, marker_name)
	local leader = user_party.Leader
	local cannon_dir = cannon.Transform:Find('mesh').right
	local shoot_point = cannon.Transform:Find('mesh'):Find('shot_point').position
	marker_name = marker_name .. '_' .. direction_util.to_str(vector_util.to_direction(cannon_dir))

	-- 연출에 들어갈때는 전투에 안걸리게 하기위해 visible 상태로 바꿔줌.
	party_util.for_each(function(_, member)
		member.ActiveState = active_state('visible')
	end)

	camera_util.move(cannon.Position, 0.5)

	local align_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(cannon.Bounds.center) + cannon_dir * 1.5
	party_util.align_party(align_pos, vector_util.to_direction(cannon_dir), 0.75)

	local ride_duration = 0.5

	party_util.for_each(function(_, member)
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(member, 0, ride_duration)
	end)

	music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '01_player_jump_01'})
	leader:SetEmotion('smile', true)
	leader:SetAnimation('get', true)
	character_util.jump(leader, 1, ride_duration)
	user_party.Leader.SpineController:Scale(unity_class.vector3.one * 0.85, ride_duration)
	character_util.move_to_async(leader, cannon.Bounds.center, ride_duration)

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_throw_01' })

	animator_util.play(cannon, 'shoot')

	self.anim_event_handler = {
		callback = function(_, e)
			if self:get_current_state(cannon) ~= self.state.ride then return false end

			if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, cannon) and e.EventName == 'shoot' then
				self:change_state(cannon, self.state.shoot)
			end
		end
	}
	message_system:Subscribe(self.anim_event_handler, typeof(CS.Oak.AnimationEvent), 'callback')

	-- 쏴질때까지 대기
	while self:get_current_state(cannon) ~= self.state.shoot do coroutine.yield() end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.anim_event_handler, typeof(CS.Oak.AnimationEvent))
	self.anim_event_handler = nil

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_explosion_01' })
	camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.2)
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_dead'):Instantiate(shoot_point)

	local shoot_routines = {}
	local shoot_interval = 0.05
	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		local member = user_party[i]
		local routine = coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.shoot,
				self, member, shoot_point - unity_class.vector3.up * member.Bounds.extents.y, cannon_dir))
		table.insert(shoot_routines, routine)

		wait_for_sec(shoot_interval)
	end
	coroutine_util.wait_coroutines(shoot_routines)

	wait_for_sec(0.3)
	wait_for_sec(0.7)

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_stage_in_teleport_01' })
	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(0.4, 'linear')

	-- 대포는 원래 상태로 되돌려줌.
	animator_util.play(cannon, 'idle')

	party_util.for_each(function(_, member)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(member)
		member.SpineController.SpineOffset = unity_class.vector3.zero
		member.SpineController:Rotate(0, 0)
		member.SpineController:Scale(unity_class.vector3.one, 0)
		member.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
	end)

	-- 마커 지점으로 카메라 이동
	local marker = field:GetMarker(marker_name)
	camera_util.move_async(marker.position, 0.05)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(0.4, 'linear')

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_fall_down_01' })

	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 착륙 상태 시작
	self:change_state(cannon, self.state.land)

	local land_routines = {}
	local land_interval = 0.05
	for i = 0, user_party.Count -1 do
		local member = user_party[i]

		-- 도착 지점 계산
		local land_dir = direction_util.to_vector3(marker.direction)
		local x_sign = unity_class.mathf.Sign(land_dir.z)
		local x_offset = land_dir.z ~= 0 and x_sign * 0.1 or 0 -- 상하 연출 할때만 사선으로 도착하게함.
		local land_pos = marker.position - land_dir * i + unity_class.vector3.right * x_offset

		local routine = coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
				util.cs_generator(self.land, self, member, land_dir , land_pos, i == 0 ))
		table.insert(land_routines, routine)

		wait_for_sec(land_interval)
	end
	coroutine_util.wait_coroutines(land_routines)

	-- 유효하지않은 지역에 도착했을때는 리스폰 시킴.
	local invalid_land = not field:IsThereFloorAt(marker.position)
	if invalid_land then
		local respawn_pos = field.RespawnManager:GetRespawnPos(user_party.Leader, 0.5, true);
		local align_dir = field.RespawnManager:GetRespawnDirection(user_party.Leader)
		party_util.position_party(respawn_pos, align_dir, 'arc')
		party_util.remove_emotion()
		party_util.remove_animation()

		camera_util.return_to_leader(0.05)

		wait_for_sec(0.5)
		screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(0.75, 'linear')
	else
		party_util.remove_emotion()
		party_util.remove_animation()

		stage_camera:SetTarget(leader)
	end

	-- 파티 상태 원래대로 원복
	party_util.for_each(function (_, member)
		member.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
	end)

	self:change_state(cannon, self.state.none)
end

function local_class:shoot(target, shoot_point, shoot_dir)
	local stage_cam = stage_camera.Camera
	local cam_half_height = stage_cam.orthographicSize
	local cam_half_width = stage_camera.HalfWidth
	local duration = 0.35
	local start_pos = shoot_point

	-- 화면 바깥쪽까지 이동하도록 함.
	local margin = 2
	local x_offset = shoot_dir.x ~= 0 and cam_half_width + margin or cam_half_height + margin
	local target_pos = shoot_point + shoot_dir * x_offset + unity_class.vector3.up * cam_half_height * 1.5

	local to_dir = vector_util.get_x0z(target_pos - start_pos)
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(target, 1, 0.15)
	target.Direction = vector_util.to_direction(to_dir)
	target:SetEmotion('scared', true)
	target:SetAnimation('embarrassed', true)

	-- 좌우로 쏠때만 45도 정도 기울여주고 상하로 쏠때는 기울여주지않는다.
	local is_side = direction_util.is_side(vector_util.to_direction(to_dir))
	local rot_sign = is_side and unity_class.mathf.Sign(to_dir.x) or 0
	target.SpineController:Rotate(rot_sign * 45, 0)

	local time_passed = 0
	while time_passed < duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / duration)
		local move_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, target_pos, progress)
		move_pos.y = 0
		target.Position = move_pos

		-- 아래 이외의 방향들은 스파인 오프셋을 올려준다.
		if shoot_dir.z >= 0 then
			local sin_val = unity_class.mathf.Sin((math.pi / 2) * progress)
			local y = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(start_pos.y, target_pos.y, sin_val)
			target.SpineController.SpineOffset = unity_class.vector3.up * y
		end

		coroutine.yield()
	end

	target.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(target_pos)
	target.SpineController.SpineOffset = shoot_dir.z < 0 and
			unity_class.vector3.zero or unity_class.vector3.up * target_pos.y
end

function local_class:land(target, land_dir, land_pos, is_leader)
	local margin = 1

	-- 시작위치 X축 위치 계산
	local x_sign = unity_class.mathf.Sign(-land_dir.x)
	local x_offset = land_dir.x ~= 0 and x_sign * margin or 0

	-- 시작위치 Z축 위치 계산
	local z_sign = unity_class.mathf.Sign(land_dir.z) * -1
	local z_offset = land_dir.z ~= 0 and z_sign * margin or 0

	local start_pos = land_pos + unity_class.vector3.right * x_offset + unity_class.vector3.up * 19 +
			unity_class.vector3.forward * z_offset

	target.Direction = vector_util.to_direction(land_dir)
	target:SetEmotion('scared', true)
	target:SetAnimation('embarrassed', true)
	target.ActiveState = active_state('visible')

	local bounce_cb = function(bounce)
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_jump_01' })

		-- 첫 착지 일때만 먼지구름을 보여준다.
		if bounce == 1 then
			unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_Common_Jump_small'):Instantiate(vector_util.get_x0z(target.Position))
		end
	end
	local gravity = CS.Oak.Constants.JumpGravity * 5
	local elasticity = 0.35
	local invalid_land = not field:IsThereFloorAt(land_pos)
	local bounce = invalid_land and 0 or 1 -- 유효하지않은 지역에 착륙할것이라면 바운스 시키지않음.
	local y_calculator = CS.CalculatorFreeFall.Create(0, gravity, start_pos.y, bounce, bounce_cb)
	y_calculator:SetElasticity(elasticity)

	local time_passed = 0
	local fall_duration = CS.CalculatorFreeFall.CalculateDurationIncludingBounces(0, gravity, start_pos.y, bounce, elasticity)
	while time_passed <= fall_duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		y_calculator:Proceed(unity_class.time.deltaTime)

		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / fall_duration)
		local move_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, land_pos, progress)
		move_pos.y = (y_calculator:GetDistance() + land_pos.y)
		target.Position = move_pos
		target.SpineController.ShadowTransform.localPosition = unity_class.vector3.up * 0.03

		coroutine.yield()
	end
	y_calculator:Dispose()

	target.Position = land_pos
	target.SpineController.ShadowTransform.localPosition = unity_class.vector3.up * 0.03

	-- 유효하지 않은(바닥이 없는) 지역에 착륙했다면 리스폰 연출 시작
	if invalid_land then
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_dialogue_negative_01' })
		target.Direction = direction_util.to_side_dir(target.Direction)
		target:SetEmotion('surprise', true)
		target:SetAnimation('embarrassed', true)
		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		-- 리더인 경우에만 페이드 연출 실행
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(target, user_party.Leader) then
			music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_stage_in_teleport_01' })
			screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(0.75, 'linear')
		end
	else
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_land_01' })
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	if self.anim_event_handler ~= nil then
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self.anim_event_handler, typeof(CS.Oak.AnimationEvent))
		self.anim_event_handler = nil
	end
end

return {
	create = function()
		return local_class()
	end
}

local local_class = newclass('Fireball')

--- 생성자
--- @param data_path string 해당 기믹이 사용할 Data의 경로.
--- @param data_key string 해당 기믹이 사용할 Data의 Key.
--- @param cs_behaviour any 해당 기믹의 C# Behaviour.

	-- 기믹 데이터
	data_key = lua_helper.get_or_default(data_key, 'default')
	if data_key == '' then
		data_key = 'default'
	end

	self.data = load_util.load_lua_gimmick_data(data_path, data_key)

	-- 불 범위
	self.attack_range_radius = self.data.attack_range_radius

	-- 시작했을 때 활성화 여부
	self.start_activate = self.data.start_activate

	-- 화염구 스피드

	self.ignore_grid = lua_helper.get_or_default(self.data.ignore_grid, false)

	-- 대미지 (최대 체력 비율)
	self.damage_ratio = lua_helper.get_or_default(self.data.damage_ratio, 20)

			{ type = sfx_type_priority.gimmick, player = sfx_player_priority.object })

	-- 화염구들
	self.fireballs = {}

	-- 불 기믹 상태
	self.fireball_state = {
		-- 기본 상태
		idle = {},
		-- 애니메이션 변경 상태
		changing = {
			enter = self.enter_changing_state,
			exit = self.exit_changing_state,
			update = self.update_changing_state,
			time_passed = 0,
		},
		changing_without_sp  = {
			update = self.update_changing_state,
			time_passed = 0,
		},
		-- 발사 상태
		shooting = {
			exit = self.exit_shooting_state,
			update = self.update_shooting_state,
			time_passed = 0
		},
		-- 대기 상태
		waiting = {
			enter = self.enter_waiting_state,
			update = self.update_waiting_state,
			time_passed = 0
		}
	}

	self.current_fireball_state = self.fireball_state.idle

	self.scene_version = scene_util.default_version

	-- 화염구 이펙트
	self.get_fireball_effect = function()
		return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.fireball_effect_name)
	end

	self.get_explosion_effect = function()
		return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_gimmick_fireball_explosion')
	end

	-- 반사 이펙트
	self.get_hit_fire_effect = function()
		return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_gimmick_fireball_shield_hit')
	end

	-- 발사 이펙트
	self.get_fire_effect = function()
		return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_gimmick_fireball_fire')
	end
end

-- IFO에 붙었을 때
function local_class:attach_to(fo)
	self.fo = fo

	if self.start_activate == 'on' then
		self.is_activate = true
	else
		self.is_activate = false
	end

	animator_util.play(self.fo, self.start_activate)

	self:refresh_direction()

	if not self.ignore_grid then
		self.cs_behaviour:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent))
		self.cs_behaviour:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridLeaveEvent))
	end

	self.get_fireball_effect()
	self.get_explosion_effect()
	self.get_hit_fire_effect()
	self.get_fire_effect()
end

-- IFO에서 떨어졌을 때
function local_class:detach_from(fo)
	self:dispose_fireball()
end

--- LuaMessageSystem(message_system)을 이용하여 콜백을 등록하였을 경우 이 곳에서 해제하여야 한다.
--- detach_from의 경우 LuaMessageSystem이 이미 날아간 상태이기 때문에 Leak발생함.
function local_class:dispose()
	self.cs_behaviour:UnSubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent))
	self.cs_behaviour:UnSubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridLeaveEvent))

	self.fo = nil
	self.cs_behaviour = nil
end

-- 현재 기본 스테이트 얻기(아이들, 걷기 등 전신 및 하체 상태)
function local_class:current_state()
	return nil
end

-- 현재 IFO가 취하고 있는 액션
function local_class:current_action()
	return CS.Oak.FieldObjectAction.None
end

--region event
-- 이벤트 호출
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if self.is_activate and lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent) and e.CameraGrid:Contains(self.fo.Position) and
		(lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, get_party_leader()) or lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party)) then
		self:change_state(self.fireball_state.waiting)
		return true
	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.CameraGridLeaveEvent) and e.CameraGrid:Contains(self.fo.Position) and
		(lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, get_party_leader()) or lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party)) then
		self:dispose_fireball()
		self:change_state(self.fireball_state.idle)
		return true
	end

	if self.current_fireball_state ~= self.fireball_state.changing and lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		self.fireball_state.changing.leader_interacted = lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Interactor, get_party_leader())
		self:change_state(self.fireball_state.changing)
		return true
	end

	return false
end
--endregion

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	-- 화염구 이동
	for fireball, data in pairs(self.fireballs) do
		-- 10초 동안 충돌이 없으면 제거
		if unity_class.time.time - data.last_crash_time > 10 then
			self.fireballs[fireball] = nil
			fireball:Dispose()
		else
			self:move_fireball(fireball, data, dt)
		end
	end

	if self.current_fireball_state == self.fireball_state.idle then
		return
	end

	self.current_fireball_state.time_passed = self.current_fireball_state.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_fireball_state.update then
		self.current_fireball_state.update(self, self.current_fireball_state.time_passed)
	end
end

--region 발사 상태
--- 발사 상태 업데이트
function local_class:update_shooting_state(time_passed)
	if time_passed >= 0.1 then
		self:create_fireball()

		self:change_state(self.fireball_state.waiting)
	end
end
--endregion

--region 대기 상태
--- 대기 상태 진입
function local_class:enter_waiting_state()
	-- 재발사 대기 시간
	local cool_down_data = self.data.cool_down
	self.cool_down = random_util.get_random_int(cool_down_data.min * 10, cool_down_data.max * 10) / 10
end

--- 대기 상태 업데이트
function local_class:update_waiting_state(time_passed)
	if time_passed >= self.cool_down then
		self:change_state(self.fireball_state.shooting)
	end
end
--endregion

--region 변경 상태
--- 변경 상태 진입
function local_class:enter_changing_state()
	local sfx_name
	if self.is_activate then
		sfx_name = '02_switch_button_03'
	else
		sfx_name = '02_switch_button_01'
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx({
		sfx_name = sfx_name,
		parent = self.fo,
		type_priority = self.sfx_priority.type,
		player_priority = self.sfx_priority.player
	})

	if not self.fireball_state.changing.leader_interacted then
		return
	end

	sp_util.enter_scene()

	scene_util.set_anim(get_party_leader(), self, { name = 'attack', count = 1 })
end

--- 변경 상태 나갈 때
function local_class:exit_changing_state()
	if not self.fireball_state.changing.leader_interacted then
		return
	end

	sp_util.exit_scene(nil, get_party_leader())
end

--- 변경 상태 업데이트
function local_class:update_changing_state(time_passed)
	if time_passed >= 0.5 then
		if self.is_activate then
			self:turn_off()
		else
			self:turn_on()
		end
	end
end
--endregion

--- 상태 변경
function local_class:change_state(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.current_fireball_state
	if prev_state.exit then
		prev_state.exit(self, new_state)
	end

	self.current_fireball_state = new_state

	self.current_fireball_state.time_passed = 0

	if new_state.enter then
		new_state.enter(self, prev_state)
	end
end

--- 화염구 폭발
function local_class:explosion_fireball(fireball)
	local pos = fireball.transform.localPosition
	self.get_explosion_effect():Instantiate(pos)

	music_player_util.play_sfx({
		sfx_name = '02_fire_explosion_01',
		play_pos = pos,
		type_priority = self.sfx_priority.type,
		player_priority = self.sfx_priority.player
	})

	local obj_list = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(pos, self.attack_range_radius)

	for i = 0, obj_list.Count - 1 do
		local obj = obj_list[i]

		-- 불을 붙일 수 있으면 붙임
		if not lua_helper.type_compare(obj.CombustibleBehaviour, CS.Oak.NonCombustibleBehaviour) then
			command_util.execute_burn(self.fo, obj)
		end

		local damage
		if self.damage_ratio == 0 then
			damage = 0
		else
			damage = math.floor(obj.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP / self.damage_ratio)
		end

		-- 폭발 반경 안에 있는 오브젝트에 대미지 줌
		local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
		damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Explosion | CS.Oak.DamageType.AffectGimmick | CS.Oak.DamageType.Trap
		damage_info.sender = self.fo
		damage_info.target = obj
		damage_info.damage = damage
		damage_info.direction = (obj.Position - pos).normalized

		command_util.execute_damage(damage_info)
	end

	obj_list:Dispose()

	self.fireballs[fireball] = nil
	fireball:Dispose()
end

--- 화염구 이동
function local_class:move_fireball(fireball, data, dt)
	data.transform.localPosition = data.transform.localPosition + data.speed * data.dir_vector * dt

	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local crash = false

	local obj_list = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(data.transform.localPosition, self.attack_range_radius)

	for i = 0, obj_list.Count - 1 do
		local obj = obj_list[i]

		-- 반사하여 쏜 주체는 제외
		if not lua_helper.reference_equals(data.owner, obj) then
			-- 방패 석상인지
			-- 방패인지 (플레이어가 들고있을 경우만)
			if lua_helper.type_compare(obj.FieldObjectBehaviour, CS.Oak.LuaGimmickBehaviour) and
				obj.FieldObjectBehaviour.ScriptName == 'ShieldStatue' or
				(lua_helper.reference_equals(obj, leader) and
					lua_helper.type_compare(leader.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentActionState, CS.Oak.CharacterHoldUpState) and
					leader.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentActionState.HoldTarget.FieldObjectBehaviour.ScriptName == 'ShieldHoldable') then

				-- 최대 충돌 횟수를 넘었는지 (넘었으면 폭발) (최대 충돌 횟수 - 2)
				if data.bounce > 13 then
					crash = true
					break
				end

				-- 화염구 재설정
				self.fireballs[fireball].dir_vector = direction_util.to_8way_vector3(obj.Direction)
				self.fireballs[fireball].owner = obj
				self.fireballs[fireball].speed = self.fireball_speed
				self.fireballs[fireball].bounce = self.fireballs[fireball].bounce + 1
				self.fireballs[fireball].last_crash_time = unity_class.time.time
				data.transform.localPosition = vector_util.get_x0z(
					obj.Position + self.fireballs[fireball].dir_vector * 0.3, fireball.transform.localPosition.y)

				self.get_hit_fire_effect():Instantiate(data.transform.localPosition + data.dir_vector * 0.6)

				-- sfx 처리
				music_player_util.play_sfx({
					sfx_name = '02_fire_explosion_01',
					play_pos = obj.Position,
					type_priority = self.sfx_priority.type,
					player_priority = self.sfx_priority.player
				})
				break
			end

			-- 캐릭터, 방해물 충돌 시 체크 (플레이어가 들고있는 오브젝트 제외)
			if not (lua_helper.type_compare(leader.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentActionState, CS.Oak.CharacterHoldUpState) and
				lua_helper.reference_equals(leader.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentActionState.HoldTarget, obj)) and
				(CS.Oak.EntityGroupsExtensions.IsObstacle(obj.EntityGroup) or lua_helper.type_compare(obj, CS.Oak.Character)) and
				not CS.Oak.EntityGroupsExtensions.HasEntityGroupOf(obj.EntityGroup, CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Cliff) and
				(not CS.Oak.EntityGroupsExtensions.IsPlayer(obj.EntityGroup) or lua_helper.reference_equals(obj, leader)) and
				not CS.Oak.ICrashBehaviourExtensions.IsEthereal(obj.CrashBehaviour) then

				crash = true
				break
			end
		end
	end

	obj_list:Dispose()

	if crash then
		self:explosion_fireball(fireball)
	end
end

--- 화염구 제거
function local_class:dispose_fireball()
	for fireball, _ in pairs(self.fireballs) do
		fireball:Dispose()
	end

	self.fireballs = {}
end

--- 기믹 방향 갱신
function local_class:refresh_direction()
	local y_angle = self.fo.Transform.eulerAngles.y

	if float_util.is_almost_zero(y_angle) then
		self.fo.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Down
	elseif float_util.almost_close_to(y_angle, 90) then
		self.fo.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Left
	elseif float_util.almost_close_to(y_angle, 180) then
		self.fo.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Up
	elseif float_util.almost_close_to(y_angle, -90) or float_util.almost_close_to(y_angle, 270) then
		self.fo.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Right
	end
end

--- 화염구 생성
function local_class:create_fireball()
	music_player_util.play_sfx({
		sfx_name = '02_villain_explosion_01',
		parent = self.fo,
		type_priority = self.sfx_priority.type,
		player_priority = self.sfx_priority.player
	})

	local dir_vector = direction_util.to_vector3(self.fo.Direction)
	local fire_effect = self.get_fire_effect():Instantiate(self.fo.Position + dir_vector * 0.9 + vector(0, 0.8, 0))
	fire_effect.transform.localEulerAngles = vector_util.get_x0z(fire_effect.transform.localEulerAngles, self.fo.Transform.localEulerAngles.y + 90)
	field_object_util.shake(self.fo, 0.1, 0.2)

	local fireball = self.get_fireball_effect():Instantiate(self.fo.Position + dir_vector * 1.1 + vector(0, 0.8, 0))
	self.fireballs[fireball] = {
		transform = fireball.transform,
		-- 생성 또는 반사한 오브젝트
		owner = self.fo,
		-- 이동 방향
		dir_vector = dir_vector,
		-- 튕긴 횟수
		bounce = 0,
		-- 스피드
		speed = self.fireball_speed,
		-- 마지막으로 충돌됐을 때 시간
		last_crash_time = unity_class.time.time
	}
end

function local_class:turn_on()
	self.is_activate = true
	animator_util.play(self.fo, 'on')
	self:change_state(self.fireball_state.waiting)
end

function local_class:turn_off()
	self.is_activate = false
	animator_util.play(self.fo, 'off')
	self:change_state(self.fireball_state.idle)
end

return {
	create = function(data_path, data_key, cs_behaviour)
		return local_class(data_path, data_key, cs_behaviour)
	end
}

local local_class = newclass('GimmickCharacter')

-- 생성자
function local_class:init(data_path, data_key, cs_behaviour)
	self.cs_behaviour = cs_behaviour

	data_key = lua_helper.get_or_default(data_key, 'default')
	if data_key == '' then
		data_key = 'default'
	end

	local data = load_util.load_lua_gimmick_data(data_path, data_key)

	-- 캐릭터 스팩의 이름
	self.character_name = lua_helper.get_or_default(data['name'], 'racing_onigirl')

	-- 자석에 끌리기 시작하면 재생할 애니메이션 이름
	self.magnet_force_start_anim = data['magnet_force_start_anim']

	-- 자석에 영향에 벗어났을 때 재생할 애니메이션
	self.magnet_force_end_anim = data['magnet_force_end_anim']

	-- 자석 이팩트 이름
	self.magnet_effect_name = lua_helper.get_or_default(data['magnet_effect_name'], 'fx_gimmick_char_magnetic_fx')

	-- 테슬라 이팩트 이름
	self.tesla_effect_name = lua_helper.get_or_default(data['tesla_effect_name'], 'FX_Tesla_Electric_Ray_Idle')

	-- 자석 이팩트 캐싱
	self.magnet_connect_effect = nil

	-- 테슬라 이팩트 캐싱
	self.tesla_connect_effect = nil

	-- 동적 생성한 캐릭터
	self.optimized_character = nil
end

-- IFO에 붙었을 때
function local_class:attach_to(fo)
	self.fo = fo

	-- 동적 생성 캐릭터 생성
	start_coroutine(self.create_dynamic_npc, self)

	-- 이벤트 구독
	self.cs_behaviour:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.TeslaCoilOnOffEvent))
	self.cs_behaviour:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.StageEndEvent))
	self.cs_behaviour:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.MagnetForceStartEvent))
	self.cs_behaviour:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.MagnetForceStopEvent))

	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.magnet_effect_name)
end

-- IFO에서 떨어졌을 때
function local_class:detach_from(_)
	self:dispose_tesla_effect()
	self:dispose_magnet_connect_effect()
end

function local_class:unsubscribe_events()
	self.cs_behaviour:UnSubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.TeslaCoilOnOffEvent))
	self.cs_behaviour:UnSubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.StageEndEvent))
	self.cs_behaviour:UnSubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.MagnetForceStartEvent))
	self.cs_behaviour:UnSubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.MagnetForceStopEvent))

	return true
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self:unsubscribe_events()

	self.fo = nil
	self.cs_behaviour = nil
end

-- 현재 IFO가 취하고 있는 액션
function local_class:current_action()
	if lua_helper.type_compare(self.cs_behaviour.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.MoveByMagnetState)) then
		return CS.Oak.FieldObjectAction.MoveByMagnet
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(self.cs_behaviour.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectUnitPushedState)) then
		return CS.Oak.FieldObjectAction.Moving
	end

	return CS.Oak.FieldObjectAction.Stopped
end

--region Event

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.TeslaCoilOnOffEvent) then
		return self:on_tesla_on_off_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.MagnetForceEvent) then
		return self:on_magnet_force_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.MagnetForceStartEvent) then
		if self.magnet_force_start_anim ~= nil then
			local character = self:get_character()
			character_util.set_anim(character, { name = self.magnet_force_start_anim })
		end
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.fo, { 'magnet_force_start' }))
		self:set_magnet_connect_effect()
		self.cs_behaviour:ChangeState(CS.Oak.MoveByMagnetState.Create(self.fo))
		return true
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.MagnetForceStopEvent) then
		local character = self:get_character()
		if self.magnet_force_end_anim == nil then
			character_util.remove_anim(character)
		else
			character_util.set_anim(character, { name = self.magnet_force_end_anim })
		end

		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.fo, { 'magnet_force_end' }))
		self:dispose_magnet_connect_effect()
		self.cs_behaviour:ChangeState(CS.Oak.FieldObjectIdleState.Instance)
		return true
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.StageEndEvent) then
		return self:unsubscribe_events()
	end

	return false
end

-- 테슬라 영향 받기 시작 함
function local_class:on_tesla_on_off_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.CoilObject, self.fo) then
		if e.IsTurningOn then
			self:create_tesla_effect()
		elseif not e.IsTurningOn then
			self:dispose_tesla_effect()
		end

		return true
	end

	return false
end

-- 자석 영향 받기 시작하게 함
function local_class:on_magnet_force_event(e)
	if not e.IsForceSendable then
		return false
	end

	if self.fo.Magnetizable.IsAffectingByMagnet == false then
		message_system:SendSync(self.fo.Magnetizable.MovableMagnetIfo
		, CS.Oak.MagnetForceStartEvent.Create())
	end

	self.fo.Magnetizable.ForceAppliersHashSet:Add(e.ForceApplier)
	return true
end

--endregion

function local_class:update_frame(_)
	if self.optimized_character == nil then
		return
	end

	self.optimized_character[self.fo.Name].Position = self.fo.Position
end

function local_class:create_dynamic_npc()
	self.optimized_character = load_util.create_dynamic_npcs_async({
		[self.fo.Name] = self.character_name,
	})
end

function local_class:set_magnet_connect_effect()
	self:dispose_magnet_connect_effect()
	self.magnet_connect_effect = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.magnet_effect_name):Instantiate(
			self.fo.Position + vector(0, 1, 0), unity_class.quaternion.identity, self.fo.Transform)
end

function local_class:dispose_magnet_connect_effect()
	if self.magnet_connect_effect == nil then
		return
	end

	self.magnet_connect_effect:Dispose()
	self.magnet_connect_effect = nil
end

-- 테슬라 이팩트 생성
function local_class:create_tesla_effect()
	self:dispose_tesla_fx()
	self.tesla_connect_effect = self.get_fx_tesla_ray_effect():Instantiate(
			self.fo.Position + vector(0, 1, 0), unity_class.quaternion.identity, self.fo.Transform)
end

-- 테슬라 이팩트 해제
function local_class:dispose_tesla_effect()
	if self.tesla_connect_effect == nil then
		return
	end
	
	self.tesla_connect_effect:Dispose()
	self.tesla_connect_effect = nil
end

-- 기믹에 종속된 캐릭터 가져오는 함수
function local_class:get_character()
	if self.optimized_character == nil then
		return
	end

	return self.optimized_character[self.fo.Name]
end

return {
	create = function(data_path, data_key, cs_behaviour)
		return local_class(data_path, data_key, cs_behaviour)
	end
}

local local_class = newclass('HideBox')

--- 생성자
--- @param data_path string 해당 기믹이 사용할 Data의 경로.
--- @param data_key string 해당 기믹이 사용할 Data의 Key.
--- @param cs_behaviour any 해당 기믹의 C# Behaviour.
function local_class:init(data_path, data_key, cs_behaviour)
	self.cs_behaviour = cs_behaviour

	local data
	-- 기믹 데이터
	if data_key == nil or data_key == '' then
		data = load_util.load_lua_gimmick_data(data_path, 'default')
	else
		data = load_util.load_lua_gimmick_data(data_path, data_key)
	end

	-- 탐지 거리
	self.sight_distance = data['distance']

	-- 탐지할 각도
	self.sight_angle = data['angle']

	-- 근접 거리
	self.near_distance = data['near_distance']

	-- 탑승 시간
	self.ride_duration = data['duration']

	-- exclusive_event_key
	self.exclusive_event_key = data['exclusive_event_key']

	-- direction
	self.direction = data['direction']

	-- 사운드 키
	self.sound_key = data['sound_key']

	-- 검사용 박스
	self.bound_box = nil

	-- 경계상태인지
	self.detected_on = false

	-- 나올 방향
	self.cur_vector = nil

	-- 상태
	self.box_state = {
		none = 1,
		hiding = 2,
		hide = 3,
		going_out = 4,
	}

	self.current_state = self.box_state.none
end

-- IFO에 붙었을 때
function local_class:attach_to(fo)
	self.fo = fo

	-- 이벤트 구독
	self.cs_behaviour:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.StageStartEvent))
	self.cs_behaviour:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.StageEndEvent))
	self.cs_behaviour:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	self.cs_behaviour:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))
	self.cs_behaviour:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.ExclusiveQuestStartEvent))
	self.cs_behaviour:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.ExclusiveQuestEndEvent))
end

-- IFO에서 떨어졌을 때
function local_class:detach_from(fo)
end

function local_class:unsubscribe_events()
	self.cs_behaviour:UnSubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.StageStartEvent))
	self.cs_behaviour:UnSubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.StageEndEvent))
	self.cs_behaviour:UnSubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	self.cs_behaviour:UnSubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))
	self.cs_behaviour:UnSubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.ExclusiveQuestStartEvent))
	self.cs_behaviour:UnSubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.ExclusiveQuestEndEvent))
end

--- LuaMessageSystem(message_system)을 이용하여 콜백을 등록하였을 경우 이 곳에서 해제하여야 한다.
--- detach_from의 경우 LuaMessageSystem이 이미 날아간 상태이기 때문에 Leak발생함.
function local_class:dispose()
	self:unsubscribe_events()

	self.bound_box = nil

	self.fo = nil
	self.interactor = nil
	self.cs_behaviour = nil
end

-- 현재 기본 스테이트 얻기(아이들, 걷기 등 전신 및 하체 상태)
function local_class:current_state()
	return nil
end

-- 현재 IFO가 취하고 있는 액션
function local_class:current_action()
	return CS.Oak.FieldObjectAction.None
end

--region event
-- 이벤트 호출
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.StageStartEvent) then
		return self:on_stage_start_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ExclusiveQuestStartEvent) then
		return self:on_exclusive_quest_start_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ExclusiveQuestEndEvent) then
		return self:on_exclusive_quest_end_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.TouchEvent) then
		return  self:on_touch_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.StageEndEvent) then
		self:unsubscribe_events()
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_stage_start_event(e)
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.setting_box, self))
	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	self.interactor = e.Interactor

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.interactor, user_party.Leader)
		and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.fo) then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.hiding_box, self))
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_touch_event(e)
	if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.Action1TouchDown and
			self.current_state == self.box_state.hide then
		self.going_out = true
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_exclusive_quest_start_event(e)
	if e.Key == self.exclusive_event_key then
		self.detected_on = true
		return true
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_exclusive_quest_end_event(e)
	if e.Key == self.exclusive_event_key then
		self.detected_on = false
		return true
	end
	return false
end
--endregion

-- 업데이트. attach_to가 불린 시점부터 detach_from 이 불린 시점까지 매 프레임 불린다.
function local_class:update_frame(dt)
end

function local_class:setting_box()
	-- bound 세팅
	local cur_center = self.fo.Position
	local cur_size = vector(self.sight_distance + 1, 0, self.sight_distance + 1)

	self.bound_box = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(cur_center, cur_size)
	self.fo.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()

	if self.direction == 'down' then
		self.cur_vector = unity_class.vector3.back
	elseif self.direction == 'up' then
		self.cur_vector = unity_class.vector3.forward
	elseif self.direction == 'left' then
		self.cur_vector = unity_class.vector3.left
	elseif self.direction == 'right' then
		self.cur_vector = unity_class.vector3.right
	else
		if self.fo.Transform.localRotation.eulerAngles.y == 0 then
			self.cur_vector = unity_class.vector3.back
			self.direction = 'down'
		elseif self.fo.Transform.localRotation.eulerAngles.y == 90 then
			self.cur_vector = unity_class.vector3.left
			self.direction = 'left'
		elseif self.fo.Transform.localRotation.eulerAngles.y == 180 then
			self.cur_vector = unity_class.vector3.forward
			self.direction = 'up'
		else
			self.cur_vector = unity_class.vector3.right
			self.direction = 'right'
		end
	end
end

-- 대상이 캐릭터인지 검사
function local_class:is_character(fo)
	local type = fo:GetType()
	local result = false

	cast(fo, typeof(CS.Oak.Character))

	if lua_helper.type_compare(fo, typeof(CS.Oak.Character)) then
		result = true
	end

	cast(fo, type)

	return result
end

function local_class:collision_check(obj)
	local full_diff = self.bound_box.center - obj.Bounds.center
	local diff = self.bound_box.center - obj.Bounds.center
	diff.y = 0

	-- 적과 리더가 가까운 경우(먼저 검사)
	local leader_diff = vector_util.magnitude(user_party.Leader.Position - obj.Bounds.center)
	if self.near_distance > leader_diff then
		return false
	end

	-- 감시 거리보다 먼 경우
	if full_diff.magnitude > self.sight_distance then
		return true
	end

	-- fo를 바라보고 있지 않을 경우
	if unity_class.vector3.Angle(diff.normalized, direction_util.to_vector3(obj.Direction)) > self.sight_angle * 0.5 then
		return false
	end

	local closest_object = field:GetClosestFieldObjectByLineSegment(
			obj.Bounds, CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Obstacle, vector_util.get_x0z(full_diff))

	-- 장애물이 막고 있는 경우
	if closest_object ~= nil and not lua_helper.reference_equals(closest_object, self.fo) then
		return true
	end

	return false
end

-- 박스 검사
function local_class:check_bound_box()
	local bound_check = true
	local fo_list = CS.Oak.LuaCollisionUtil.GetFieldObjectsCollidedBy(self.bound_box, unity_class.vector3.zero)
	for i = 0, fo_list.Count - 1 do
		local obj = fo_list[i]

		if obj:GetType() == typeof(CS.Oak.Character) and lua_helper.type_compare(
				obj.FieldObjectController, CS.Oak.PatrolMonsterCharacterController) then
			if not self:collision_check(obj) then
				bound_check = false
				break
			end
		end
	end

	fo_list:Dispose()
	return bound_check
end

-- 박스에 숨을 때
function local_class:hiding_box()
	-- 이미 사용중인 경우
	if self.current_state ~= self.box_state.none then return end

	-- 들어갈 수 없는 경우
	if self.detected_on and not self:check_bound_box() then
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(
				self.fo, {key = 'lilithtower_hide_box_1', world_pos = self.fo.Position })
		return
	end

	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	-- 숨는 중 상태로 변경
	self.current_state = self.box_state.hiding

	-- 박스 interactable 제거
	self.fo.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance

	local animator = self.fo:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))

	local hide_pos = self.fo.Position

	if self.direction == 'down' then
		hide_pos = hide_pos + vector(1,0,0)
	elseif self.direction == 'up' then
		hide_pos = hide_pos + vector(-1,0,0)
	elseif self.direction == 'left' then
		hide_pos = hide_pos + vector(0,0,-1)
	elseif self.direction == 'right' then
		hide_pos = hide_pos + vector(0,0,1)
	end

	message_system:SendSync(user_party.Leader.FieldObjectController, CS.Oak.StateResetEvent.Instance)

	local action_button = field_ui_manager:GetSingleUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ActionButton)
	action_button.OverridenButtonAction = CS.Oak.CharacterControllerManualTouchState.Button1Action.Interact

	local entity_group_list = {}

	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		local member = user_party[i]
		character_util.set_immortal(member, true)

		-- 리더의 경우 여러가지 이유로 EntityGroup이 바뀌는 경우가 있어서 따로 처리합니다.
		-- ex) 부활 후 3초간 테러리스트에 걸리지 않도록 Neutral0으로 변경하는데 여기서 그 값을 가져오면 고장남
		if i ~= 0 then
			table.insert(entity_group_list, member.EntityGroup)
		end

		member.EntityGroup = CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Neutral0
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot(self.sound_key)
	animator:Play('lilithtower_cabinet_open')
	animator.speed = 1 / self.ride_duration

	character_util.align_party(hide_pos, self.direction, self.ride_duration * 0.5, 'arc')

	-- 숨는 연출
	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		local member = user_party[i]
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(member, 0, self.ride_duration * 0.5)
		member:HideWeapon(true)
		character_util.set_immortal(member, true)
		character_util.move_to(member, hide_pos, self.ride_duration * 0.5
		, nil, true, true)
	end
	wait_for_sec(self.ride_duration * 0.5)

	animator:Play('lilithtower_cabinet_idle')
	wait_for_sec(self.ride_duration * 0.5)

	-- 액션버튼을 제외하고 제거
	field_ui_manager:HideTargetUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ClassButton
			| CS.Oak.FieldUiType.TeamCombinationButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.SkillButton
			| CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ModeChangeButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.RoleButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.DPad,
			user_party.Leader)
	coroutine.yield()
	field_ui_manager:SetUI(user_party.Leader, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ActionButton)
	field_ui_manager:ShowTargetUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ActionButton, user_party.Leader)
	coroutine.yield()

	-- 숨어있는 상태
	self.going_out = false
	self.current_state = self.box_state.hide
	field_ui_manager:Show()

	while not self.going_out do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	-- 나오는 상태
	self.current_state = self.box_state.going_out

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot(self.sound_key)
	animator:Play('lilithtower_cabinet_open')
	wait_for_sec(self.ride_duration * 0.5)

	-- 나오는 연출
	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		local member = user_party[i]
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(member, 1, self.ride_duration * 0.5)
		member:HideWeapon(false)
		character_util.move_to(member, hide_pos + self.cur_vector,
				self.ride_duration * 0.5, nil, true, true)
	end

	wait_for_sec(self.ride_duration * 0.5)
	animator:Play('lilithtower_cabinet_idle')
	wait_for_sec(self.ride_duration * 0.5)

	-- 다시 인터렉트 가능하도록 변경
	self.current_state = self.box_state.none
	self.fo.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()

	-- 다시 복구
	field_ui_manager:ShowTargetUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ClassButton
				| CS.Oak.FieldUiType.TeamCombinationButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.SkillButton
				| CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ModeChangeButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.RoleButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.DPad,
				user_party.Leader)

	action_button.OverridenButtonAction = nil

	party_util.remove_animation()

	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		local member = user_party[i]
		character_util.set_immortal(member, false)

		if i ~= 0 then
			member.EntityGroup = entity_group_list[i]
		else
			member.EntityGroup = CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Player0
		end
	end
	field_ui_manager:Show()
	party_util.reset_controllers()
end

return {
	create = function(data_path, data_key, cs_behaviour)
		return local_class(data_path, data_key, cs_behaviour)
	end
}

	self.remove_anim_and_emotion_when_done = lua_helper.get_or_default(data['remove_anim_and_emotion_when_done'], true)
	-- 인터랙트가 끝나면 reset_controllers 하는 지
	self.reset_controllers_when_done = lua_helper.get_or_default(data['reset_controllers_when_done'], true)

	self.playing_other_anim_args = lua_helper.get_or_default(data['playing_other_anim_args'], nil)

	self.target_name = lua_helper.get_or_default(data['target_name'], nil)

	self.prev_time_passed = 0

--region IFieldObjectBehaviour
-- 현재 기본 스테이트 얻기(아이들, 걷기 등 전신 및 하체 상태)
function local_class:current_state()
	return nil
end

-- 현재 IFO가 취하고 있는 액션
function local_class:current_action()
	return CS.Oak.FieldObjectAction.None
end
--endregion

--region event
-- 이벤트 호출
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractCancelEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_cancel_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractFinishEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_finish_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.DamageEvent) then
		return self:on_damage_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	self.interactor = e.Interactor

	if self.is_interacting then
		return false
	end

	if stage.BattleManager:GetBattleForMyParty() ~= nil and self.can_interact_in_battle == false then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.interactor, { key = 'err_cant_interact_in_battle' })
		end))
		return false
	end

	self:start_interacting()

	return true
end

function local_class:on_interact_cancel_event(e)
	self:cancel()

	return true
end

function local_class:on_interact_finish_event(e)
	self:done()

	return false
end

function local_class:on_damage_event(e)
	if self.interactor ~= nil and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.target, self.interactor) then
		self:cancel()
	end

	return false
end
--endregion

-- 업데이트. attach_to가 불린 시점부터 detach_from 이 불린 시점까지 매 프레임 불린다.
function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.is_interacting then
		self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

		local progress = self.time_passed / self.interacting_duration
		local prev_progress = self.prev_time_passed / self.interacting_duration

		if self.event_publish_progress ~= nil then
			for i = 1, #self.event_publish_progress do
				if prev_progress < self.event_publish_progress[i] and progress >= self.event_publish_progress[i] then
					message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.fo, { 'interacting', self.event_publish_progress[i], self.target_name }))
					break
				end
			end
		end

		if self.time_passed >= self.interacting_duration then
			self.is_interacting = false

			local command = CS.Oak.InteractFinishCommand.Create(self.interactor, self.fo)
			command_util.execute_cmd(command)
		else
			self.timer_bar.BarSprite:SetValue(self.time_passed, 0)
		end

		self.prev_time_passed = self.time_passed
	elseif self.timer_bar ~= nil then
		local interacting_reset_duration_scale = self.interacting_duration / self.interacting_reset_duration
		self.time_passed = self.time_passed - (interacting_reset_duration_scale * dt)

		if self.time_passed > 0 then
			self.timer_bar.BarSprite:SetValue(self.time_passed, 0)
		else
			field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(self.fo, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.TimerBar)
			self.timer_bar = nil
		end
	end
end

function local_class:start_interacting()
	message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.InteractEvent.Create(self.interactor, self.fo))

	self.is_interacting = true

	local look_dir

	if self.interacting_direction_locked_side then
		if user_party.Position.x < self.fo.Bounds.center.x then
			look_dir = 'right'
		else
			look_dir = 'left'
		end
	else
		look_dir = user_party.Leader.Direction
	end

	if self.playing_other_anim_args ~= nil then
		character_util.remove_anim(user_party.Leader)
	end

	character_util.set_locked_dir(user_party.Leader, look_dir)

	local interact_state = CS.Oak.CharacterControllerInteractState.Create(user_party.Leader, self.fo)
	message_system:SendSync(user_party.Leader, CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(interact_state))

	self.interacting_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = self.interacting_sfx_name, loop = true, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'default' })

	local req = CS.Oak.AnimationRequest(self.interacting_animation_name, CS.Oak.AnimationPriorities.Default, true)
	local state = CS.Oak.CharacterMarionetteState.Create(user_party.Leader, req)
	local state_change_event = CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(state)

	state.CurrentAction = CS.Oak.FieldObjectAction.Gathering
	message_system:SendSync(user_party.Leader.FieldObjectBehaviour, state_change_event)

	self:set_field_timer()
end

function local_class:cancel()
	if self.interacting_sfx ~= nil then
		self.interacting_sfx:FadeOut(0.05)
	end

	if self.playing_other_anim_args == nil then
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.interactor)
	else
		character_util.set_anim(self.interactor, self.playing_other_anim_args)
	end

	character_util.set_locked_dir(self.interactor, 'none')

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.interactor, user_party.Leader) then
		if not self.leader_reset_controller_when_cancel then
			party_util.reset_controllers()
		else
			message_system:SendSync(self.interactor, CS.Oak.StateResetEvent.Instance)
		end
	else
		message_system:SendSync(self.interactor, CS.Oak.StateResetEvent.Instance)
	end

	if self.interacting_reset_duration == 0 then
		field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(self.fo, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.TimerBar)
		self.timer_bar = nil
	end

	if self.time_passed < self.interacting_duration then
		message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.InteractCancelEvent.Create(self.interactor, self.fo))
	end

	self.is_interacting = false
end

function local_class:done()
	self.interacting_sfx:FadeOut(0.05)

	if self.remove_anim_and_emotion_when_done then
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.interactor)
	end

	character_util.set_locked_dir(self.interactor, 'none')

	if self.reset_controllers_when_done then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.interactor, user_party.Leader) then
			party_util.reset_controllers()
		else
			message_system:SendSync(self.interactor, CS.Oak.StateResetEvent.Instance)
		end
	end

	
	field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(self.fo, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.TimerBar)
	self.timer_bar = nil
	
	message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.InteractFinishEvent.Create(self.interactor, self.fo))
	
	self.is_interacting = false
end

-- 채집 시간을 알려주는 타이머를 세팅한다.
function local_class:set_field_timer()
	local u_dic = field_ui_manager:SetUI(self.fo, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.TimerBar)

	if self.timer_bar == nil then
		self.timer_bar = u_dic[CS.Oak.FieldUiType.TimerBar]
		self.timer_bar.BarSprite:SetWidth(100)
		self.timer_bar.BarSprite:SetMinMax(0, self.interacting_duration);
		self.timer_bar.BarSprite:SetValue(0, 0);

		self.timer_bar.gameObject:SetActive(true);

		self.time_passed = 0
		self.prev_time_passed = 0
	end
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	self.cs_behaviour:ChangeState(next_state)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent))

	self:change_state()
end

return {
	create = function(data_path, data_key, cs_behaviour)
		return local_class(data_path, data_key, cs_behaviour)
	end
}

		[self.ray_type.day] = fo.Transform:Find('[gimmick]morning_bomb').gameObject,
		[self.ray_type.night] = fo.Transform:Find('[gimmick]night_bomb').gameObject,
	}

	-- 현재 폭탄의 빛 타입
	self.current_ray_type = nil

	self.animator_play.animator = fo.Transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))

	-- 스테이트 생성
	self.states = {}

	for state_name, state in pairs(bomb_state) do

	end

		state:dispose()
	end

	self.animator_play.animator = nil

	self.bomb_state = nil
	self.states = nil
	self.fo = nil

	self.cs_behaviour:UnSubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.CharacterDeadEvent))

	self.cs_behaviour = nil

end

-- 현재 IFO가 취하고 있는 액션
function local_class:current_action()
	local current_state = self.cs_behaviour.CurrentState

	if lua_helper.type_compare(current_state, CS.Oak.FieldObjectThrownState) then
		if current_state.DidLandOnFloor then
			return CS.Oak.FieldObjectAction.ImpactMoving
		else
			return CS.Oak.FieldObjectAction.Flying
		end
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(current_state, CS.Oak.FieldObjectHeldUpState) then
		return CS.Oak.FieldObjectAction.Held
	end

	return CS.Oak.FieldObjectAction.Stopped
end

--region event
-- 이벤트 호출
function local_class:on_event(e)
	local consumed = CS.Oak.LuaScriptQuestUtil.CastToEventListenerAndSendSync(self.cs_behaviour.CurrentState, e, false)

	if consumed then
		return true
	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.HoldUpEvent) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.fo) then
			self.cs_behaviour:ChangeState(CS.Oak.FieldObjectHeldUpState.Create(self.fo, e.Holder))
			self:change_state(self.states.hold_up)
		end

		return true
	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.GetThrownEvent) then
		self.cs_behaviour:ChangeState(CS.Oak.FieldObjectIdleState.Instance)
		self:change_state(self.states.thrown)
		return true
	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent) and self.flower and
		not field:IsInSameCameraGrid(self.flower.Position, self.fo.Position) then
		self:reset_object()
		return true
	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.CharacterDeadEvent) and
		lua_helper.reference_equals(self.light_gimmick_manager.current_leader, e.Target) and
		self.bomb_state == self.states.hold_up then

		self:change_state(self.states.thrown)
		return true
	end
end

	self.bomb_state:update(dt)
end

--- 스테이트 변경
function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	local prev_state = self.bomb_state

	if prev_state == next_state then
		return
	end

	if prev_state then
		prev_state:exit(next_state)
	end

	self.bomb_state = next_state

	if next_state then
		next_state:enter(prev_state)
	end
end

--- 폭탄 스폰
function local_class:spawn_bomb(ray_type)
	if self.bomb_state == self.states.deactivate then
		self.current_ray_type = ray_type
		self:change_state(self.states.spawn)
	end
end

	if not self.is_held then
		self:change_state(self.states.despawn)
	end
end

	if self.bomb_state == self.states.explosion and self.fo.ActiveState == active_state_type.infield then
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:reset_object()
	if self.fo.Holdable.IsHeld then
		local holder = self.fo.Holdable.Holder
		self.fo.Holdable:GetThrownBy(holder)

		message_system:SendSync(self.fo, CS.Oak.GetThrownEndEvent.Instance)
		message_system:SendSync(holder, CS.Oak.ReleaseHoldingObjectEvent.Create(holder))
	end

	self:change_state(self.states.deactivate)

	local effect_pool = self.light_gimmick_manager.fx.public.reset

	if (self.fo.ActiveState & active_state_type.visible) ~= active_state_type.disabled then
		effect_pool:Instantiate(self.fo.Position)
	end

	self.light_gimmick_manager:remove_gimmick(self.fo, self)

	self.fo.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)

	field_object_util.set_active_state(self.fo, active_state_type.enabled)

	self.is_held = false

local local_class = newclass('LightConcentrator')

local concentrator_state_base = newclass('LightConcentratorState')
local concentrator_state = {
	idle = newclass('LightConcentratorIdleState', concentrator_state_base),
	rotation = newclass('LightConcentratorRotationState', concentrator_state_base),
}

--- 생성자
--- @param data_path string 해당 기믹이 사용할 Data의 경로.
--- @param data_key string 해당 기믹이 사용할 Data의 Key.
--- @param cs_behaviour any 해당 기믹의 C# Behaviour.
function local_class:init(data_path, data_key, cs_behaviour)
	self.cs_behaviour = cs_behaviour

	-- 기믹 데이터
	data_key = lua_helper.get_or_default(data_key, 'default')
	if data_key == '' then
		data_key = 'default'
	end

	self.data = load_util.load_lua_gimmick_data(data_path, data_key)

	self.type = 'concentrator'

	self.states = nil

	self.concentrator_state = nil

	-- 빛 기믹 매니저 등록
	self.light_gimmick_manager = get_or_create_global_table('Gimmick/LightGimmickManager')

	-- 빛 타입
	self.ray_type = self.light_gimmick_manager.ray_type

	-- 빛 발사 위치 오프셋
	self.shoot_offset = 0.3

	-- 초기 값
	self.default_angle = nil

	self.reset_switch_names = lua_helper.get_or_default(self.data.reset_switch_names, { 'resetSwitch' })
end

-- IFO에 붙었을 때
function local_class:attach_to(fo)
	self.fo = fo

	self.light_gimmick_manager:add_gimmick(fo, self)

	self.cs_behaviour:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.ResetSwitchTurnedOnEvent))

	self.default_angle = self.fo.Transform.eulerAngles

	self.states = {}

	for state_name, state in pairs(concentrator_state) do
		self.states[state_name] = state(self)
	end

	self:change_state(self.states.idle)
end

-- IFO에서 떨어졌을 때
function local_class:detach_from(fo)
	if self.light_gimmick_manager then
		self.light_gimmick_manager:remove_gimmick(fo, self)
	end

	for _, state in pairs(self.states) do
		state:dispose()
	end

	self.default_angle = nil

	self.concentrator_state = nil
	self.states = nil
	self.fo = nil
end

--- LuaMessageSystem(message_system)을 이용하여 콜백을 등록하였을 경우 이 곳에서 해제하여야 한다.
--- detach_from의 경우 LuaMessageSystem이 이미 날아간 상태이기 때문에 Leak발생함.
function local_class:dispose()
	self.cs_behaviour:UnSubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.ResetSwitchTurnedOnEvent))

	self.fo = nil
	self.light_gimmick_manager = nil
	self.cs_behaviour = nil
end

-- 현재 기본 스테이트 얻기(아이들, 걷기 등 전신 및 하체 상태)
function local_class:current_state()
	return nil
end

-- 현재 IFO가 취하고 있는 액션
function local_class:current_action()
	return CS.Oak.FieldObjectAction.None
end

--region event
-- 이벤트 호출
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		self:change_state(self.states.rotation)
		return true
	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ResetSwitchTurnedOnEvent) then
		for i = 1, #self.reset_switch_names do
			if e.SwitchObject.Name == self.reset_switch_names[i] then
				self:reset_object()
			end
		end

		return true
	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.GimmickResetEvent) then
		self:reset_object()
		return true
	end
end
--endregion

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	self.concentrator_state:update(dt)
end

--- 스테이트 변경
function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	local prev_state = self.concentrator_state

	if prev_state == next_state then
		return
	end

	if prev_state then
		prev_state:exit(next_state)
	end

	self.concentrator_state = next_state

	if next_state then
		next_state:enter(prev_state)
	end
end

--- 빛 쏠 수 있는지
function local_class:is_shootable()
	if self.concentrator_state == self.states.idle and
		(self.fo.ActiveState == active_state_type.infield or self.fo.ActiveState == active_state_type.enabled) then
		return true
	end

	return false
end

--- 오브젝트 초기화
function local_class:reset_object()
	self:change_state(self.states.idle)

	self.fo.Transform.eulerAngles = self.default_angle
	self.light_gimmick_manager:refresh_direction(self.fo)
end

--region Base State
function concentrator_state_base:init(controller)
	self.controller = controller
	self.fo = controller.fo

	self.time_passed = 0
end

function concentrator_state_base:dispose()
	self.fo = nil
	self.controller = nil
end

function concentrator_state_base:enter()
	self.time_passed = 0
end

function concentrator_state_base:exit()
	self.time_passed = 0
end

function concentrator_state_base:update(dt)
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt
end
--endregion Base State

--region Idle State
function concentrator_state.idle:init(controller)
	self.super:init(controller)
end

function concentrator_state.idle:dispose()
	self.super:dispose()
end

function concentrator_state.idle:enter()
	self.super:enter()

	self.controller.light_gimmick_manager:refresh_direction(self.fo)
end

function concentrator_state.idle:exit()
	self.super:exit()
end

function concentrator_state.idle:update(dt)
	self.super:update(dt)
end
--endregion Idle State

--region Rotation State
function concentrator_state.rotation:init(controller)
	self.super:init(controller)

	self.rotation_duration = 1
end

function concentrator_state.rotation:dispose()
	self.super:dispose()
end

function concentrator_state.rotation:enter()
	self.super:enter()

	self.start_angle = self.fo.Transform.eulerAngles.y
	self.end_angle = self.start_angle + 90
end

function concentrator_state.rotation:exit()
	self.super:exit()

	self.fo.Transform.eulerAngles = vector_util.get_x0z(self.fo.Transform.eulerAngles, self.end_angle)
end

function concentrator_state.rotation:update(dt)
	self.super:update(dt)

	if self.time_passed > self.rotation_duration then
		self.controller:change_state(self.controller.states.idle)
	else
		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(self.time_passed / self.rotation_duration)
		local cur_angle = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(self.start_angle, self.end_angle, progress)

		self.fo.Transform.eulerAngles = vector_util.get_x0z(self.fo.Transform.eulerAngles, cur_angle)
	end
end
--endregion Rotation State

return {
	create = function(data_path, data_key, cs_behaviour)
		return local_class(data_path, data_key, cs_behaviour)
	end
}

	self.current_ray_type = function()
		if self.override_ray then
			return self.override_ray
		end

		if self.time_conversion_manager then
			return self.time_conversion_manager.current_time_zone
		end

		return self.ray_type.day
	end

	-- 빛 이펙트 높이 오프셋

	self.entity_groups = {

	-- 이펙트

				ray_start = 'fx_morning_light_lazer_start',
				ray_end = 'fx_morning_light_lazer_end',

function local_class:dispose()
