	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TimeConversionChangingEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TimeConversionChangedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CharacterConvertEvent))

	update_util.remove_update(self, CS.Oak.UpdatePriorities.StageEvent, 'update_routine')

	self.cs_controller = nil
end

function local_class:load_resource()
	message_system:SubscribeOnce(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageLoadedEvent), 'on_stage_loaded_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TimeConversionChangingEvent), 'on_time_conversion_changing_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TimeConversionChangedEvent), 'on_time_conversion_changed_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent), 'on_camera_grid_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CharacterConvertEvent), 'on_character_convert_event')

	self.fx[self.ray_type.day]:create_all()
	self.fx[self.ray_type.night]:create_all()
	self.fx.public:create_all()

	-- 빛 충돌 범위
	self.ray_bounds = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(vector(999, 0, 999), vector(0.2, 1, 0.2))

	-- 홀더블 오브젝트 체크용 범위
	self.holdable_obj_bounds = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(vector(999, 0, 999), vector(0.9, 1, 0.9))
end

function local_class:on_stage_loaded_event(_)
	self.time_conversion_manager = get_stage_event_controller('TimeConversionManager')

	self.current_leader = get_party_leader()

	update_util.add_update(self, CS.Oak.UpdatePriorities.StageEvent, 'update_routine')
	return true
end

function local_class:on_time_conversion_changing_event(e)
	self.is_changing_time = true

	for concentrator, controller in pairs(self.light_gimmicks.concentrator) do
		self:disconnect_gimmick(concentrator, concentrator)
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:on_time_conversion_changed_event(e)
	self.is_changing_time = false

	for concentrator, controller in pairs(self.light_gimmicks.concentrator) do
		self:set_concentrator_effect(concentrator)
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_enter_event(e)
	self.current_grid_bounds = e.CameraGrid.bounds

	for concentrator, controller in pairs(self.light_gimmicks.concentrator) do
		self:set_concentrator_effect(concentrator)
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:on_character_convert_event(e)
	if e.Type == CS.Oak.CharacterConvertType.Player and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, get_party_leader()) then
		self.current_leader = get_party_leader()
		return true
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:update_routine()
	if not self.current_grid_bounds then
		return
	end

	local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime

	for obj, _ in pairs(self.connected_data) do
		for _, data in pairs(self.connected_data[obj]) do
			data.time_passed = data.time_passed + dt
		end
	end

	-- 집광기 빛 발사
	if not self.is_changing_time then
		for concentrator, controller in pairs(self.light_gimmicks.concentrator) do
			self:shoot_ray(concentrator, concentrator, controller,
				direction_util.to_vector3_ver2(concentrator.Direction), self.current_ray_type())
		end
	end

	-- 폭탄 빛 발사
	for bomb, controller in pairs(self.light_gimmicks.bomb) do
		local direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Down

		-- 4방향 발사
		for i = 1, 4 do
			direction = direction_util.get_cw_turn(direction, i - 1)
			self:shoot_ray(bomb, i, controller, direction_util.to_vector3_ver2(direction), controller.current_ray_type)
		end
	end

	-- 스위치 업데이트
	for _, controller in pairs(self.light_gimmicks.switch) do
		controller:update(dt)
	end

	-- 폭탄 꽃 업데이트
	for _, controller in pairs(self.light_gimmicks.bomb_flower) do
		controller:update(dt)
	end

	-- 빛 연결 시간에 따른 처리
	for obj, _ in pairs(self.connected_data) do
		-- 적용할 데이터
		local apply_data = {}

		for shooter, data in pairs(self.connected_data[obj]) do
			if not apply_data.time_passed or data.time_passed > apply_data.time_passed then
				-- 이전 연결 정보 time_passed 초기화
				if apply_data.connected_data then
					apply_data.connected_data.time_passed = 0
				end

				-- 현재 연결 정보로 갱신
				apply_data.time_passed = data.time_passed
				apply_data.shooter = shooter
				apply_data.connected_data = data
			else
				-- 이전 연결 time_passed 보다 작으면 초기화
				data.time_passed = 0
			end
		end

		-- 특정 시간 이상 빛을 받고 있을 때 처리
		if apply_data.time_passed and apply_data.time_passed >= 1 then
			if apply_data.connected_data.connected_type == self.ray_type.day then
				CS.Oak.ICombustibleBehaviourExtensions.DefaultBurn(nil, apply_data.shooter, obj)
			else
				command_util.publish_extinguish(apply_data.shooter, obj)
			end
		end
	end
end

--- 빛 발사
function local_class:shoot_ray(gimmick, owner, controller, shoot_dir, ray_type)
	-- 기믹이 빛 발사가 불가능한 상태면 관련된 이펙트들 제거
	if not controller:is_shootable() or not field:IsInSameCameraGrid(self.current_leader.Position, gimmick.Position) then
		self:disconnect_gimmick(gimmick, owner)
		return
	end

	self.given_light_gimmick[gimmick][owner] = owner

	-- 충돌 오브젝트 검사
	self.ray_bounds.center = gimmick.Position

	-- 빛 거리
	local dist

	if shoot_dir == unity_class.vector3.back then
		dist = gimmick.Position.z - self.current_grid_bounds.min.z
	elseif shoot_dir == unity_class.vector3.right then
		dist = self.current_grid_bounds.max.x - gimmick.Position.x
	elseif shoot_dir == unity_class.vector3.forward then
		dist = self.current_grid_bounds.max.z - gimmick.Position.z
	elseif shoot_dir == unity_class.vector3.left then
		dist = gimmick.Position.x - self.current_grid_bounds.min.x
	end

	local obj_list = CS.Oak.LuaCollisionUtil.GetFieldObjectsCollidedBy(self.ray_bounds, shoot_dir * dist)

	local closest_obj
	local closest_obj_center

	for i = 0, obj_list.Count - 1 do
		local obj = obj_list[i]

		if self.light_gimmicks.switch[obj] then
			-- 스위치 오브젝트면 연결
			self.light_gimmicks.switch[obj].connected_ray:add(ray_type)
		elseif not lua_helper.reference_equals(obj, gimmick) and
			-- 이외의 판정 처리
			not (self.light_gimmicks.bomb[obj] and not self.light_gimmicks.bomb[obj].is_held) and
			not CS.Oak.ICrashBehaviourExtensions.IsEthereal(obj.CrashBehaviour) and
			not CS.Oak.LuaEntityGroupsExtensions.HasEntityGroupOf(obj.EntityGroup, self.entity_groups.cliff) and
			(lua_helper.reference_equals(obj, self.current_leader) or
				CS.Oak.LuaEntityGroupsExtensions.IsObstacle(obj.EntityGroup) or
				CS.Oak.LuaEntityGroupsExtensions.GetCharacterEntityGroup(obj.EntityGroup) == CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Neutral or
				CS.Oak.LuaEntityGroupsExtensions.HasEntityGroupOf(obj.EntityGroup, self.entity_groups.hittable_obstacle)) and
			not self:is_held_up_obj(obj) then

			closest_obj = obj
			closest_obj_center = obj.Bounds.center
			break
		end
	end

	obj_list:Dispose()

	-- 빛 끝 이펙트 오프셋
	local end_effect_offset = unity_class.vector3.zero

	if closest_obj then
		-- 반사가 가능한 거울 및 빛 전환 기믹이 아닐 경우만 빛 끝 이펙트 오프셋을 적용
		if not (self.light_gimmicks.mirror[closest_obj] and self:get_reflection_direction(closest_obj, shoot_dir)) and
			not self.light_gimmicks.converter[closest_obj] then
			end_effect_offset = closest_obj.Bounds.extents
		elseif self.effects[gimmick].ray_end[owner] then
			self.effects[gimmick].ray_end[owner].effect:Dispose()
			self.effects[gimmick].ray_end[owner] = nil
		end

		-- 충돌한 물체가 있을 때 처리
		dist = gimmick.Bounds.center - closest_obj_center

		if shoot_dir == unity_class.vector3.back then
			dist = dist.z + shoot_dir.z * end_effect_offset.z
		elseif shoot_dir == unity_class.vector3.right then
			dist = -(dist.x + shoot_dir.x * end_effect_offset.x)
		elseif shoot_dir == unity_class.vector3.forward then
			dist = -(dist.z + shoot_dir.z * end_effect_offset.z)
		elseif shoot_dir == unity_class.vector3.left then
			dist = dist.x + shoot_dir.x * end_effect_offset.x
		end
	end

	-- 발사 위치만큼 빼줌
	dist = dist - controller.shoot_offset

	-- 이펙트 생성
	if not self.effects[gimmick].ray[owner] then
		local ray_pos = gimmick.Position + vector(0, self.ray_effect_y_offset, 0) + shoot_dir * controller.shoot_offset
		local ray_effect = self.fx[ray_type].ray:Instantiate(ray_pos)

		local angle_y = self:get_angle(shoot_dir)
		ray_effect.transform.localEulerAngles = vector_util.get_x0z(ray_effect.transform.localEulerAngles, angle_y)

		self.effects[gimmick].ray[owner] = {
			effect = ray_effect,
			type = ray_type,
			angle_y = angle_y,
			transform = ray_effect.transform,
			target_center = gimmick.Position
		}

		if controller.shoot_ray_sfx then
			music_player_util.play_sfx({
				sfx_name = controller.shoot_ray_sfx,
				parent = gimmick,
				volume = 0.7,
				type_priority = 'gimmick',
				player_priority = 'object'
			})
		end

	elseif self.effects[gimmick].ray[owner] and self.effects[gimmick].ray[owner].target_center ~= gimmick.Position then
		local ray_pos = gimmick.Position + vector(0, self.ray_effect_y_offset, 0) + shoot_dir * controller.shoot_offset
		self.effects[gimmick].ray[owner].transform.localPosition = ray_pos
		self.effects[gimmick].ray[owner].target_center = gimmick.Position
	end

	if self.light_gimmicks.concentrator[gimmick] then
		-- 윗 방향이면 start 이펙트 제거
		if self.effects[gimmick].ray_start[owner] and gimmick.Direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Up then
			self.effects[gimmick].ray_start[owner].effect:Dispose()
			self.effects[gimmick].ray_start[owner] = nil

		-- 집광기 기믹이면 start 이펙트 추가
		elseif not self.effects[gimmick].ray_start[owner] and gimmick.Direction ~= CS.Oak.Direction.Up then
			local effect_pos = gimmick.Position + vector(0, self.ray_effect_y_offset, 0) + shoot_dir * controller.shoot_offset
			local start_effect = self.fx[ray_type].ray_start:Instantiate(effect_pos)

			self.effects[gimmick].ray_start[owner] = {
				effect = start_effect
			}
		end
	end

	-- 이펙트 길이 변경
	if self.effects[gimmick].ray[owner].scale ~= dist then
		local scale = math.max(dist, 0)
		self.effects[gimmick].ray[owner].scale = scale
		self.effects[gimmick].ray[owner].transform.localScale = vector_util.get_xy0(self.effects[gimmick].ray[owner].transform.localScale, scale)
	end

	-- 이펙트 방향 변경 됐을 때 (보통 기믹이 리셋 됐을 경우)
	if self.effects[gimmick].ray[owner].angle_y ~= self:get_angle(shoot_dir) then
		local angle_y = self:get_angle(shoot_dir)
		self.effects[gimmick].ray[owner].angle_y = angle_y

		local angel = vector_util.get_x0z(self.effects[gimmick].ray[owner].effect.transform.localEulerAngles, angle_y)
		self.effects[gimmick].ray[owner].effect.transform.localEulerAngles = angel

		local ray_pos = gimmick.Position + vector(0, self.ray_effect_y_offset, 0) + shoot_dir * controller.shoot_offset
		self.effects[gimmick].ray[owner].effect.transform.localPosition = ray_pos
	end

	-- 기존에 연결됐던 기믹과 다른 오브젝트면 기믹과의 연결 끊음
	if self.received_light_gimmick[gimmick][owner] and self.received_light_gimmick[gimmick][owner] ~= closest_obj then
		self:disconnect_gimmick(self.received_light_gimmick[gimmick][owner], gimmick)
		self.received_light_gimmick[gimmick][owner] = nil
	end

	if not closest_obj then
		if self.effects[gimmick].ray_end[owner] then
			self.effects[gimmick].ray_end[owner].effect:Dispose()
			self.effects[gimmick].ray_end[owner] = nil
		end

		return
	end

	-- 빛 끝 이펙트 위치 가져오기
	local get_ray_end_effect_pos = function()
		if shoot_dir.z == 0 then
			return vector(closest_obj_center.x - shoot_dir.x * end_effect_offset.x, self.ray_effect_y_offset, gimmick.Position.z)
		else
			return vector(gimmick.Position.x, self.ray_effect_y_offset, closest_obj_center.z - shoot_dir.z * end_effect_offset.z)
		end
	end

	-- 빛 끝 이펙트 쏘는 대상이 움직였을 때 이펙트 위치 변경
	if self.effects[gimmick].ray_end[owner] and self.effects[gimmick].ray_end[owner].target_center ~= closest_obj_center then
		self.effects[gimmick].ray_end[owner].target_center = closest_obj_center
		self.effects[gimmick].ray_end[owner].transform.localPosition = get_ray_end_effect_pos()
	end

	-- 연결된 오브젝트가 바뀌었을 때
	if self.connected_obj[gimmick][owner] and self.connected_obj[gimmick][owner] ~= closest_obj then
		self.connected_data[self.connected_obj[gimmick][owner]][gimmick] = nil

		-- 빛 끝 이펙트가 있으면 제거
		if self.effects[gimmick].ray_end[owner] then
			self.effects[gimmick].ray_end[owner].effect:Dispose()
			self.effects[gimmick].ray_end[owner] = nil
		end
	end

	self.connected_obj[gimmick][owner] = closest_obj

	if not self.connected_data[closest_obj] then
		self.connected_data[closest_obj] = {}
	end

	if not self.connected_data[closest_obj][gimmick] then
		self.connected_data[closest_obj][gimmick] = {
			connected_type = ray_type,
			time_passed = 0
		}
	end

	-- 거울인지 검사 후 빛 반사
	if self.light_gimmicks.mirror[closest_obj] then
		local reflection_dir = self:get_reflection_direction(closest_obj, shoot_dir)

		if reflection_dir then
			self.given_light_gimmick[closest_obj][gimmick] = owner
			self.received_light_gimmick[gimmick][owner] = closest_obj

			self:shoot_ray(closest_obj, gimmick, self.light_gimmicks.mirror[closest_obj], reflection_dir, ray_type)
			return
		elseif self.connected_obj[closest_obj][gimmick] then
			self:disconnect_gimmick(closest_obj, gimmick)
		end
	end

	-- 빛 전환 기믹 처리
	if self.light_gimmicks.converter[closest_obj] then
		self.given_light_gimmick[closest_obj][gimmick] = owner
		self.received_light_gimmick[gimmick][owner] = closest_obj

		self.light_gimmicks.converter[closest_obj].animator_play:on()

		self:shoot_ray(closest_obj, gimmick, self.light_gimmicks.converter[closest_obj], shoot_dir, (ray_type % 2) + 1)
		return
	end

	-- 폭탄 꽃이면 연결
	if self.light_gimmicks.bomb_flower[closest_obj] then
		self.light_gimmicks.bomb_flower[closest_obj].connected_ray:add(ray_type)
	end

	-- 빛 끝 이펙트 생성 (
	if not self.effects[gimmick].ray_end[owner] and shoot_dir ~= unity_class.vector3.back and dist > 0 then
		local end_effect = self.fx[ray_type].ray_end:Instantiate(get_ray_end_effect_pos())

		self.effects[gimmick].ray_end[owner] = {
			effect = end_effect,
			transform = end_effect.transform,
			target_center = closest_obj_center
		}
	end
end

--- 빛 연결 끊김
function local_class:disconnect_gimmick(gimmick, owner)
	if self.is_changing_time and  self.effects[gimmick].ray[owner] then
		local ray_type = self.effects[gimmick].ray[owner].type
		local ray_transform = self.effects[gimmick].ray[owner].transform

		local finish_effect = self.fx[ray_type].ray_finish:Instantiate(ray_transform.localPosition)
		finish_effect.transform.localScale = ray_transform.localScale
		finish_effect.transform.localEulerAngles = ray_transform.localEulerAngles
	end

	self:dispose_effect(gimmick, owner)

	if self.light_gimmicks.converter[gimmick] then
		self.light_gimmicks.converter[gimmick].animator_play:off()
	end

	local connected_obj = self.connected_obj[gimmick][owner]

	if connected_obj then
		self.connected_data[connected_obj][gimmick] = nil
		self.connected_obj[gimmick][owner] = nil
	end

	local connected_light_gimmick = self.received_light_gimmick[gimmick][owner]

	if connected_light_gimmick then
		self:disconnect_gimmick(connected_light_gimmick, gimmick)

		self.given_light_gimmick[connected_light_gimmick][gimmick] = nil
		self.received_light_gimmick[gimmick][owner] = nil
	end

	self.given_light_gimmick[gimmick][owner] = nil
end

--- 해당 기믹 관련 이펙트 제거
function local_class:dispose_effect(gimmick, owner)
	for _, type_effects in pairs(self.effects[gimmick]) do
		if type_effects[owner] then
			type_effects[owner].effect:Dispose()
			type_effects[owner] = nil
		end
	end
end

--- 기믹 방향 갱신
function local_class:refresh_direction(gimmick)
	local y_angle = gimmick.Transform.eulerAngles.y

	if float_util.is_almost_zero(y_angle) then
		gimmick.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Down
	elseif float_util.almost_close_to(y_angle, 90) then
		gimmick.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Left
	elseif float_util.almost_close_to(y_angle, 180) then
		gimmick.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Up
	elseif float_util.almost_close_to(y_angle, -90) or float_util.almost_close_to(y_angle, 270) then
		gimmick.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Right
	end
end

--- 빛 방향 각도 가져오기
function local_class:get_angle(dir_vector)
	if dir_vector == unity_class.vector3.back then
		return 0
	elseif dir_vector == unity_class.vector3.left then
		return 90
	elseif dir_vector == unity_class.vector3.forward then
		return 180
	elseif dir_vector == unity_class.vector3.right then
		return 270
	end
end

--- 반사 방향 가져오기
function local_class:get_reflection_direction(mirror, ray_dir)
	local mirror_direction = mirror.Direction

	if mirror_direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Down then
		if ray_dir == unity_class.vector3.forward then
			return unity_class.vector3.left
		elseif ray_dir == unity_class.vector3.right then
			return unity_class.vector3.back
		end
	elseif mirror_direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Right then
		if ray_dir == unity_class.vector3.forward then
			return unity_class.vector3.right
		elseif ray_dir == unity_class.vector3.left then
			return unity_class.vector3.back
		end
	elseif mirror_direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Up then
		if ray_dir == unity_class.vector3.back then
			return unity_class.vector3.right
		elseif ray_dir == unity_class.vector3.left then
			return unity_class.vector3.forward
		end
	elseif mirror_direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Left then
		if ray_dir == unity_class.vector3.back then
			return unity_class.vector3.left
		elseif ray_dir == unity_class.vector3.right then
			return unity_class.vector3.forward
		end
	end
end

--- 리더 앞 타일의 위치
function local_class:get_next_tile_pos(fo)
	local dir_vector = direction_util.to_vector3_ver2(self.current_leader.Direction)
	local leader_tile_pos = vector(math.floor(self.current_leader.Position.x + 0.5), 0, math.floor(self.current_leader.Position.z + 0.5))
	local target_pos = leader_tile_pos + dir_vector

	self.holdable_obj_bounds.center = leader_tile_pos + dir_vector

	local obj_list = CS.Oak.LuaCollisionUtil.GetFieldObjectsCollidedBy(self.holdable_obj_bounds, unity_class.vector3.zero)

	for i = 0, obj_list.Count - 1 do
		local obj = obj_list[i]

		if not lua_helper.reference_equals(obj, fo) and not lua_helper.reference_equals(obj, self.current_leader) and
			not CS.Oak.ICrashBehaviourExtensions.IsEthereal(obj.CrashBehaviour) and
			(CS.Oak.LuaEntityGroupsExtensions.IsObstacle(obj.EntityGroup) or
				CS.Oak.LuaEntityGroupsExtensions.GetCharacterEntityGroup(obj.EntityGroup) == CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Neutral or
				CS.Oak.LuaEntityGroupsExtensions.HasEntityGroupOf(obj.EntityGroup, self.entity_groups.hittable_obstacle)) then

			target_pos = leader_tile_pos
			break
		end
	end

	obj_list:Dispose()

	return target_pos
end

--- 들고있는 오브젝트를 타일에 내려 놓음
function local_class:release_holding_obj(fo)
	local holder = fo.Holdable.Holder
	fo.Holdable:GetThrownBy(holder)

	local target_pos = self:get_next_tile_pos(fo)

	self.holdable_obj_bounds.center = target_pos

	local obj_list = CS.Oak.LuaCollisionUtil.GetFieldObjectsCollidedBy(self.holdable_obj_bounds, unity_class.vector3.zero)

	for i = 0, obj_list.Count - 1 do
		local obj = obj_list[i]

		-- 놓을 자리에 거울이나 폭탄이 있으면 깨트림
		if not lua_helper.reference_equals(obj, fo) and (self.light_gimmicks.mirror[obj] or self.light_gimmicks.bomb[obj]) then

			if self.light_gimmicks.mirror[obj] then
				self.light_gimmicks.mirror[obj]:destroy()
			end

			-- 들고있는 오브젝트도 거울이면 깨트림
			if target_pos and self.light_gimmicks.mirror[fo] then
				target_pos = nil
			end
		end

		-- 스위치 처리
		if lua_helper.type_compare(obj.FieldObjectBehaviour, CS.Oak.FloorSwitchBehaviour) then
			message_system:SendSync(obj, CS.Oak.FloorSwitchStepOnEvent.Create(fo))
		end
	end

	obj_list:Dispose()

	if target_pos then
		fo.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(target_pos, field:GetTileInfoAt(target_pos).y)
		return true
	else
		return false
	end
end

--- 해당 오브젝트가 리더가 현재 들고있는 오브젝트인지
function local_class:is_held_up_obj(obj)
	local leader_state = self.current_leader.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentActionState

	if lua_helper.type_compare(leader_state, CS.Oak.CharacterHoldUpState) and lua_helper.reference_equals(leader_state.HoldTarget, obj) then
		return true
	end

	return false
end

--- 집광기 이펙트 세팅
function local_class:set_concentrator_effect(concentrator)
	if self.effects[concentrator].loop[concentrator] or not field:IsInSameCameraGrid(self.current_leader.Position, concentrator.Position) then
		return
	end

	self.effects[concentrator].loop[concentrator] = {
		effect = self.fx[self.current_ray_type()].loop:Instantiate(concentrator.Position + vector(0, 1, -0.1))
	}

	music_player_util.play_sfx({
		sfx_name = '01_engage_01',
		parent = concentrator,
		volume = 0.7,
		type_priority = 'gimmick',
		player_priority = 'object'
	})
end

--- 오브젝트가 받고 있는 빛 가져오기
function local_class:get_received_light(obj)
	if not self.connected_data[obj] then
		return
	end

	self.obj_connected_ray:clear()

	local ray_type

	for _, data in pairs(self.connected_data[obj]) do
		self.obj_connected_ray:add(data.connected_type)
	end

	if #self.obj_connected_ray > 1 then
		ray_type = self.ray_type.both
	elseif self.obj_connected_ray:contains(self.ray_type.day) then
		ray_type = self.ray_type.day
	elseif self.obj_connected_ray:contains(self.ray_type.night) then
		ray_type = self.ray_type.night
	end

	return ray_type
end

--- 기믹 등록
function local_class:add_gimmick(gimmick, controller)
	self.light_gimmicks[controller.type][gimmick] = controller

	self.effects[gimmick] = {
		ray = {},
		ray_start = {},
		ray_end = {},
		loop = {},
	}

	self.given_light_gimmick[gimmick] = {}
	self.received_light_gimmick[gimmick] = {}
	self.connected_obj[gimmick] = {}
end

--- 기믹 해제
function local_class:remove_gimmick(gimmick, controller)
	for _, owner in pairs(self.given_light_gimmick[gimmick]) do
		self:disconnect_gimmick(gimmick, owner)
	end

	self.light_gimmicks[controller.type][gimmick] = nil
end

return {
	create = function(cs_controller)
		return local_class(cs_controller)
	end
}

--- @param data_path string 해당 기믹이 사용할 Data의 경로.

function local_class:init(data_path, data_key, cs_behaviour)
	self.cs_behaviour = cs_behaviour

	data_key = lua_helper.get_or_default(data_key, 'default')

	-- 빛 발사 위치 오프셋
	self.shoot_offset = 0

	-- 빛 발사 sfx
	self.shoot_ray_sfx = '01_lightsaber_03'

	-- 초기 값
	self.default_data = nil

	self.reset_switch_names = lua_helper.get_or_default(self.data.reset_switch_names, { 'resetSwitch' })

	-- 폭탄 대미지 타입
	self.bomb_damage_type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Trap | CS.Oak.DamageType.Explosion | CS.Oak.DamageType.AffectGimmick
end

-- IFO에 붙었을 때
function local_class:attach_to(fo)
	self.fo = fo

	self.light_gimmick_manager:add_gimmick(fo, self)

	self.cs_behaviour:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.ResetSwitchTurnedOnEvent))
	self.cs_behaviour:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent))
	self.cs_behaviour:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent))
	self.cs_behaviour:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.CharacterDeadEvent))

	self.default_data = {
		pos = self.fo.Position,
		angle = self.fo.Transform.eulerAngles
	}

	self.states = {}

	for state_name, state in pairs(mirror_state) do
		self.states[state_name] = state(self)
	end

	self:change_state(self.states.idle)
end

-- IFO에서 떨어졌을 때
function local_class:detach_from(fo)
	if self.light_gimmick_manager then
		self.light_gimmick_manager:remove_gimmick(fo, self)
	end

	for _, state in pairs(self.states) do
		state:dispose()
	end

	self.default_data = nil

	self.mirror_state = nil
	self.states = nil
	self.fo = nil
end

--- LuaMessageSystem(message_system)을 이용하여 콜백을 등록하였을 경우 이 곳에서 해제하여야 한다.
--- detach_from의 경우 LuaMessageSystem이 이미 날아간 상태이기 때문에 Leak발생함.
function local_class:dispose()
	self.cs_behaviour:UnSubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.ResetSwitchTurnedOnEvent))
	self.cs_behaviour:UnSubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent))
	self.cs_behaviour:UnSubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent))
	self.cs_behaviour:UnSubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.CharacterDeadEvent))

	self.fo = nil
	self.light_gimmick_manager = nil
	self.cs_behaviour = nil
end

-- 현재 기본 스테이트 얻기(아이들, 걷기 등 전신 및 하체 상태)
function local_class:current_state()
	return nil
end

-- 현재 IFO가 취하고 있는 액션
function local_class:current_action()
	local current_state = self.cs_behaviour.CurrentState

	if lua_helper.type_compare(current_state, CS.Oak.FieldObjectThrownState) then
		if current_state.DidLandOnFloor then
			return CS.Oak.FieldObjectAction.ImpactMoving
		else
			return CS.Oak.FieldObjectAction.Flying
		end
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(current_state, CS.Oak.FieldObjectHeldUpState) then
		return CS.Oak.FieldObjectAction.Held
	end

	return CS.Oak.FieldObjectAction.Stopped
end

--region event
-- 이벤트 호출
function local_class:on_event(e)
	local consumed = CS.Oak.LuaScriptQuestUtil.CastToEventListenerAndSendSync(self.cs_behaviour.CurrentState, e, false)

	if consumed then
		return true
	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.HoldUpEvent) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.fo) then
			self.cs_behaviour:ChangeState(CS.Oak.FieldObjectHeldUpState.Create(self.fo, e.Holder))
			self:change_state(self.states.hold_up)
		end

		return true
	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.GetThrownEvent) then
		self:change_state(self.states.thrown)
		return true
	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		self:change_state(self.states.rotation)
		return true
	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ResetSwitchTurnedOnEvent) then
		for i = 1, #self.reset_switch_names do
			if e.SwitchObject.Name == self.reset_switch_names[i] then
				self:reset_object()
			end
		end

		return true
	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent) and self.mirror_state ~= self.states.destroy and
		not field:IsInSameCameraGrid(self.default_data.pos, self.fo.Position) then
		self:reset_object()
		return true
	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.GimmickResetEvent) then
		self:reset_object()
		return true
	end

	-- 폭탄 기믹 대미지를 받았을 때 처리
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.DamageEvent) and lua_helper.reference_equals(self.fo, e.Info.target) and
		e.Info.type == self.bomb_damage_type then
		self:destroy()
		return true
	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.CharacterDeadEvent) and
		lua_helper.reference_equals(self.light_gimmick_manager.current_leader, e.Target) and
		self.mirror_state == self.states.hold_up then

		self:change_state(self.states.thrown)
		return true
	end
end
--endregion

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	self.mirror_state:update(dt)
end

--- 스테이트 변경
function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	local prev_state = self.mirror_state

	if prev_state == next_state then
		return
	end

	if prev_state then
		prev_state:exit(next_state)
	end

	self.mirror_state = next_state

	if next_state then
		next_state:enter(prev_state)
	end
end

--- 빛 쏠 수 있는지
function local_class:is_shootable()
	if self.mirror_state == self.states.idle and
		(self.fo.ActiveState == active_state_type.infield or self.fo.ActiveState == active_state_type.enabled) then
		return true
	end

	return false
end

--- 오브젝트 초기화
function local_class:reset_object()
	if self.fo.Holdable.IsHeld then
		local holder = self.fo.Holdable.Holder
		self.fo.Holdable:GetThrownBy(holder)

		message_system:SendSync(self.fo, CS.Oak.GetThrownEndEvent.Instance)
		message_system:SendSync(holder, CS.Oak.ReleaseHoldingObjectEvent.Create(holder))
	end

	self:change_state(self.states.idle)

	local effect_pool = self.light_gimmick_manager.fx.public.reset

	if (self.fo.ActiveState & active_state_type.visible) ~= active_state_type.disabled then
		effect_pool:Instantiate(self.fo.Position)
	end

	effect_pool:Instantiate(self.default_data.pos)

	self.fo.Position = self.default_data.pos
	self.fo.Transform.eulerAngles = self.default_data.angle
	self.light_gimmick_manager:refresh_direction(self.fo)

	field_object_util.set_active_state(self.fo, active_state_type.enabled)
end

function local_class:destroy()
	self:change_state(self.states.destroy)
end

--region Base State
function mirror_state_base:init(controller)
	self.controller = controller
	self.fo = controller.fo

	self.time_passed = 0
end

function mirror_state_base:dispose()
	self.fo = nil
	self.controller = nil
end

function mirror_state_base:enter()
	self.time_passed = 0
end

function mirror_state_base:exit()
	self.time_passed = 0
end

function mirror_state_base:update(dt)
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt
end
--endregion Base State

--region Idle State
function mirror_state.idle:init(controller)
	self.super:init(controller)
end

function mirror_state.idle:dispose()
	self.super:dispose()
end

function mirror_state.idle:enter()
	self.super:enter()

	self.controller.light_gimmick_manager:refresh_direction(self.fo)
end

function mirror_state.idle:exit()
	self.super:exit()
end

function mirror_state.idle:update(dt)
	self.super:update(dt)
end
--endregion Idle State

--region Rotation State
function mirror_state.rotation:init(controller)
	self.super:init(controller)

	self.rotation_duration = 1
end

function mirror_state.rotation:dispose()
	self.super:dispose()
end

function mirror_state.rotation:enter()
	self.super:enter()

	self.start_angle = self.fo.Transform.eulerAngles.y
	self.end_angle = self.start_angle + 90

	music_player_util.play_sfx({
		sfx_name = '02_iron_teatan_head_shake_01',
		parent = self.fo,
		volume = 0.7,
		type_priority = 'gimmick',
		player_priority = 'object'
	})
end

function mirror_state.rotation:exit()
	self.super:exit()

	self.fo.Transform.eulerAngles = vector_util.get_x0z(self.fo.Transform.eulerAngles, self.end_angle)
end

function mirror_state.rotation:update(dt)
	self.super:update(dt)

	if self.time_passed > self.rotation_duration then
		self.controller:change_state(self.controller.states.idle)
	else
		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(self.time_passed / self.rotation_duration)
		local cur_angle = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(self.start_angle, self.end_angle, progress)

		self.fo.Transform.eulerAngles = vector_util.get_x0z(self.fo.Transform.eulerAngles, cur_angle)
	end
end
--endregion Rotation State

--region Destroy State
function mirror_state.destroy:init(controller)
	self.super:init(controller)
end

function mirror_state.destroy:dispose()
	self.super:dispose()
end

function mirror_state.destroy:enter()
	self.super:enter()

	if self.fo.Holdable.IsHeld then
		local holder = self.fo.Holdable.Holder
		self.fo.Holdable:GetThrownBy(holder)

		message_system:SendSync(self.fo, CS.Oak.GetThrownEndEvent.Instance)
		message_system:SendSync(holder, CS.Oak.ReleaseHoldingObjectEvent.Create(holder))
	end

	self.controller.light_gimmick_manager.fx.public.mirror_break:Instantiate(self.fo.Position)

	music_player_util.play_sfx({
		sfx_name = '01_glass_01',
		play_pos = self.fo.Position,
		volume = 0.7,
		type_priority = 'gimmick',
		player_priority = 'object'
	})

	self.fo.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
	field_object_util.set_active_state(self.fo, active_state_type.disabled)
end

function mirror_state.destroy:exit()
	self.super:exit()
end

function mirror_state.destroy:update(dt)
	self.super:update(dt)
end
--endregion Destroy State

--region HoldUp State
function mirror_state.hold_up:init(controller)
	self.super:init(controller)
end

function mirror_state.hold_up:dispose()
	self.super:dispose()
end

function mirror_state.hold_up:enter()
	self.super:enter()

	-- 현재 타일의 위치
	self.current_tile_pos = nil

	self.attack_range = attack_range_util.create_rect_by_color_key('green', vector(999, 0, 999), vector(1, 1))
	self.attack_range:Show()
end

function mirror_state.hold_up:exit()
	self.super:exit()

	attack_range_util.destroy(self.attack_range)
	self.attack_range = nil
end

function mirror_state.hold_up:update(dt)
	self.super:update(dt)

	local prev_tile_pos = self.current_tile_pos
	self.current_tile_pos = self.controller.light_gimmick_manager:get_next_tile_pos(self.fo)

	if self.current_tile_pos ~= prev_tile_pos then
		attack_range_util.setup_by_position(self.attack_range, self.current_tile_pos, 0)
	end
end
--endregion HoldUp State

--region Thrown State
function mirror_state.thrown:init(controller)
	self.super:init(controller)
end

function mirror_state.thrown:dispose()
	self.super:dispose()
end

function mirror_state.thrown:enter()
	self.super:enter()

	self.wait_frame = 0

	music_player_util.play_sfx({
		sfx_name = '01_hit_dummy_02',
		parent = self.fo,
		volume = 0.7,
		type_priority = 'gimmick',
		player_priority = 'object'
	})
end

function mirror_state.thrown:exit()
	self.super:exit()

	self.controller.cs_behaviour:ChangeState(CS.Oak.FieldObjectIdleState.Instance)
end

function mirror_state.thrown:update(dt)
	self.super:update(dt)

	if self.wait_frame > 0 then
		if self.controller.light_gimmick_manager:release_holding_obj(self.fo) == true then
			self.controller:change_state(self.controller.states.idle)
		else
			self.controller:destroy()
		end
	end

	self.wait_frame = self.wait_frame + 1
end
--endregion Thrown State

return {
	create = function(data_path, data_key, cs_behaviour)
		return local_class(data_path, data_key, cs_behaviour)
	end
}

local local_class = newclass('LightningController')

--- 생성자
--- @param data_path string 해당 기믹이 사용할 Data의 경로.
--- @param data_key string 해당 기믹이 사용할 Data의 Key.
--- @param cs_behaviour any 해당 기믹의 C# Behaviour.
function local_class:init(data_path, data_key, cs_behaviour)
	self.cs_behaviour = cs_behaviour

	-- 기믹 데이터
	data_key = lua_helper.get_or_default(data_key, 'default')
	if data_key == '' then
		data_key = 'default'
	end

	self.data = load_util.load_lua_gimmick_data(data_path, data_key)

	-- 시전 시간
	self.casting_time = self.data.casting_time

	-- 재시전 대기 시간
	self.cool_down = self.data.cool_down

	-- 번개에 맞았을 때 리셋 정보
	self.reset_data = self.data.reset_data

	-- 번개를 맞아도 리셋 되지 않는 캐릭터
	self.ignore_character = self.data.ignore_character

	-- 현재 리셋 정보 (위치, 방향)
	self.current_reset_data = nil

	-- 번개 기믹 상태
	self.lightning_state = {
		-- 비활성화 상태
		deactivate = {
			enter = self.enter_deactivate_state
		},
		-- 시전 상태
		casting = {
			enter = self.enter_casting_state,
			exit = self.exit_casting_state,
			update = self.update_casting_state,
			time_passed = 0,
			leader = nil
		},
		-- 대기 상태
		waiting = {
			update = self.update_waiting_state
		}
	}

	self.current_lightning_state = self.lightning_state.deactivate

	-- 플레이어가 해당 구역 안에 있는지
	self.is_leader = false

	-- 피뢰침들
	self.lightning_rods = {}

	self.get_thunder = function()
		return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_gimmick_cloud_thunder')
	end

	self.get_thunder_player = function()
		return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_gimmick_cloud_thunder_player_elec')
	end

	self.get_cloud_thunder = function()
		return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_gimmick_cloud_thunder_screen')
	end
end

-- IFO에 붙었을 때
function local_class:attach_to(fo)
	self.fo = fo

	self.fo.ActiveState = active_state('visible')

	self.cs_behaviour:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent))
	self.cs_behaviour:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridLeaveEvent))
	self.cs_behaviour:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))
	self.cs_behaviour:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))

	self.lightning_rods = {}

	-- 번개 맞아서 리셋 되지 않는 캐릭터 등록
	if self.ignore_character then
		self.ignore_characters = {}
		for i = 1, #self.ignore_character do
			table.insert(self.ignore_characters, get_character(self.ignore_character[i]))
		end
	end

	self:change_state(self.lightning_state.deactivate)

	self.get_thunder()
	self.get_thunder_player()
	self.get_cloud_thunder()

-- IFO에서 떨어졌을 때
function local_class:detach_from(fo)
end

--- LuaMessageSystem(message_system)을 이용하여 콜백을 등록하였을 경우 이 곳에서 해제하여야 한다.
--- detach_from의 경우 LuaMessageSystem이 이미 날아간 상태이기 때문에 Leak발생함.
function local_class:dispose()

	self.cs_behaviour:UnSubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridLeaveEvent))
	self.cs_behaviour:UnSubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))
	self.cs_behaviour:UnSubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))

	self.lightning_rods = nil

	self.fo = nil
	self.cs_behaviour = nil
end

-- 현재 기본 스테이트 얻기(아이들, 걷기 등 전신 및 하체 상태)
function local_class:current_state()
	return nil
end

-- 현재 IFO가 취하고 있는 액션
function local_class:current_action()
	return CS.Oak.FieldObjectAction.None
end

--region event
-- 이벤트 호출
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if not self:is_activate() and lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent) and e.CameraGrid:Contains(self.fo.Position) and
		(lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, get_party_leader()) or lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party)) then
		self.lightning_rods = {}
		self.is_leader = true
		self:change_state(self.lightning_state.casting)
		return true
	end

	if self:is_activate() and lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.CameraGridLeaveEvent) and e.CameraGrid:Contains(self.fo.Position) and
		(lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, get_party_leader()) or lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party)) then
		self.is_leader = false
		self:change_state(self.lightning_state.deactivate)
		return true
	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent) then
		if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'add_lightning_rod' and not self.lightning_rods[e.Sender] then
			self.lightning_rods[e.Sender] = e.Sender.FieldObjectBehaviour:GetLuaTable().safe_range_radius
			return true
		end

		if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'remove_lightning_rod' then
			self.lightning_rods[e.Sender] = nil
			return true
		end

		if self.is_leader and not self:is_activate() and e:GetParamAt(0) == 'lightning_turn_on' then
			self:change_state(self.lightning_state.casting)
			return true
		end

		if self.is_leader and self:is_activate() and e:GetParamAt(0) == 'lightning_turn_off' then
			self:change_state(self.lightning_state.deactivate)
			return true
		end

		return false
	end

	for i = 1, #self.reset_data do
		local reset_data = self.reset_data[i]
		if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), reset_data.zone_name) then
			self.current_reset_data = {
				pos = field_util.get_marker_pos(reset_data.marker_name),
				dir = field_util.get_marker_dir(reset_data.marker_name)
			}
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if get_party_leader().FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead then
		return
	end

	if self.cloud_thunder_data then
		self:cloud_thunder_update(dt)
	end

	if not self:is_activate() then
		return
	end

	if self.current_lightning_state.update then
		self.current_lightning_state.update(self, dt)
	end
end

--region 비활성화 상태
--- 비활성화 상태 진입
function local_class:enter_deactivate_state()
	if self.cloud_thunder_data then
		self.cloud_thunder_data.dir_vector = unity_class.vector3.forward
		self.cloud_thunder_data.camera_dist = 8
	end

	if self.cloud_thunder_sfx then
		music_player_util.fade_out_sfx(self.cloud_thunder_sfx, 1)
		self.cloud_thunder_sfx = nil
	end
end
--endregion

--region 캐스팅 상태
--- 캐스팅 상태 진입
function local_class:enter_casting_state()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	self.lightning_state.leader = leader

	character_util.show_attack_timer(leader, self.casting_time)

	self.thunder_player_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
		sfx_name = '02_light_loop_03',
		parent = leader,
		loop = true,
		volume = 0.3
	})

	self.thunder_player_effect = self.get_thunder_player():Instantiate(leader.Position, unity_class.quaternion.identity, leader.Transform)

	if not self.cloud_thunder_sfx then
		self.cloud_thunder_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
			sfx_name = '01_thunder_03',
			loop = true,
			fade_in_time = 1
		})
	end

	if not self.cloud_thunder_data then
		-- 번개 구름 이펙트 생성
		local effect = self.get_cloud_thunder():Instantiate(
			stage_camera.LookAtPosition + vector(0, 0, 8), unity_class.quaternion.identity, stage_camera.Transform)

		-- 번개 구름 정보
		self.cloud_thunder_data = {
			effect = effect,
			transform = effect.transform,
			speed = 14,
			dir_vector = unity_class.vector3.back,
			camera_dist = 4
		}

	else
		self.cloud_thunder_data.dir_vector = unity_class.vector3.back
		self.cloud_thunder_data.camera_dist = 4
	end
end

--- 캐스팅 상태 나갈 때
function local_class:exit_casting_state()
	character_util.hide_attack_timer(self.lightning_state.leader)
	self.thunder_player_effect:Dispose()
	music_player_util.stop_sfx(self.thunder_player_sfx)
end

--- 캐스팅 상태 업데이트
function local_class:update_casting_state(dt)
	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(self.lightning_state.leader, get_party_leader()) then
		self:change_state(self.lightning_state.casting)
		return
	end

	-- 안전 지역에 있을 때 피뢰침에 번개 내려침
	local target = self:in_safe_zone()
	if target then
		music_player_util.play_sfx({
			sfx_name = '01_thunder_02',
			parent = target,
			type_priority = sfx_type_priority.gimmick,
			player_priority = sfx_player_priority.object
		})

		self.get_thunder():Instantiate(target.Position)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.PowerSourceTurnOnEvent.Create(target))
		self:change_state(self.lightning_state.waiting)
		return
	end

	self.current_lightning_state.time_passed = self.current_lightning_state.time_passed + dt

	-- 시간이 되면 번개 내려침
	if self.current_lightning_state.time_passed >= self.casting_time then
		-- 제외 캐릭터면 번개에 맞아도 리셋 되지 않음
		if self.ignore_characters then
			for i = 1, #self.ignore_characters do
				local ignore_character = self.ignore_characters[i]
				if lua_helper.reference_equals(ignore_character, get_party_leader()) then
					message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.fo, { 'lightning_ignore_player_start' }))

					music_player_util.play_sfx({
						sfx_name = '01_thunder_02',
						parent = ignore_character,
						type_priority = sfx_type_priority.gimmick,
						player_priority = sfx_player_priority.object
					})

					self.get_thunder():Instantiate(ignore_character.Position)
					self:change_state(self.lightning_state.casting)
					return
				end
			end
		end

		-- 번개 맞고 리셋
		sp_util.start_scene(self.reset_position, self)
	end
end
--endregion

--region 대기 상태
--- 대기 상태 업데이트
function local_class:update_waiting_state(_)
	if not self:in_safe_zone() then
		self:change_state(self.lightning_state.casting)
	end
end
--endregion

--- 상태 변경
function local_class:change_state(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.current_lightning_state
	if prev_state.exit then
		prev_state.exit(self, new_state)
	end

	self.current_lightning_state = new_state

	self.current_lightning_state.time_passed = 0

	if new_state.enter then
		new_state.enter(self, prev_state)
	end
end

--- 플레이어 리셋 연출
function local_class:reset_position()
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	music_player_util.play_sfx({
		sfx_name = '01_thunder_02',
		parent = leader
	})

	message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.fo, { 'lightning_reset_player_start' }))

	self.get_thunder():Instantiate(leader.Position)

	self:change_state(self.lightning_state.waiting)

	-- 들고 있던 물체 강제로 내려놓음
	if lua_helper.type_compare(leader.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentActionState, CS.Oak.CharacterHoldUpState) then
		local hold_target = user_party.Leader.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentActionState.HoldTarget
		command_util.execute_throw(leader, hold_target,
			direction_util.to_vector3(leader.Direction), leader.Position, 4, false)
	end

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
	character_util.set_direction(leader, direction_util.to_side_dir(leader.Direction))
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(leader, 'damaged')
	scene_util.set_dead_anim(leader)
	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_drown_01')
	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(1, 'linear')

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.fo, { 'lightning_reset_player' }))

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
	party_util.position_party(self.current_reset_data.pos, self.current_reset_data.dir, 'linear')
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(1, 'linear')

	message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.fo, { 'lightning_reset_player_end' }))
end

--- 활성화 되어 있는지
function local_class:is_activate()
	return self.current_lightning_state ~= self.lightning_state.deactivate
end

--- 번개 구름 업데이트
function local_class:cloud_thunder_update(dt)
	local cur_pos = self.cloud_thunder_data.transform.localPosition + self.cloud_thunder_data.speed * self.cloud_thunder_data.dir_vector * dt

	-- 시전 중일 때 아래로
	if self:is_activate() then
		if cur_pos.z - stage_camera.LookAtPosition.z > self.cloud_thunder_data.camera_dist then
			self.cloud_thunder_data.transform.localPosition = cur_pos

		else
			cur_pos = vector_util.get_xy0(self.cloud_thunder_data.transform.localPosition,
				stage_camera.LookAtPosition.z + self.cloud_thunder_data.camera_dist)
			self.cloud_thunder_data.transform.localPosition = cur_pos
		end

	-- 비활성화 때 위로
	else
		if cur_pos.z - stage_camera.LookAtPosition.z < self.cloud_thunder_data.camera_dist then
			self.cloud_thunder_data.transform.localPosition = cur_pos
		else
			self.cloud_thunder_data.effect:Dispose()
			self.cloud_thunder_data = nil
		end
	end
end

--- 안전 지역에 있는지
function local_class:in_safe_zone()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	for lightning_rod, radius in pairs(self.lightning_rods) do
		if (leader.Position - lightning_rod.Position).sqrMagnitude < radius * radius and
			lightning_rod.ActiveState == active_state('enabled') then
			return lightning_rod
		end
	end
end

return {
	create = function(data_path, data_key, cs_behaviour)
		return local_class(data_path, data_key, cs_behaviour)
	end
}

local local_class = newclass('LightningRod')

--- 생성자
--- @param data_path string 해당 기믹이 사용할 Data의 경로.
--- @param data_key string 해당 기믹이 사용할 Data의 Key.
--- @param cs_behaviour any 해당 기믹의 C# Behaviour.
function local_class:init(data_path, data_key, cs_behaviour)
	self.cs_behaviour = cs_behaviour

	-- 기믹 데이터
	data_key = lua_helper.get_or_default(data_key, 'default')
	if data_key == '' then
		data_key = 'default'
	end

	self.data = load_util.load_lua_gimmick_data(data_path, data_key)

	-- 안전 지역 범위
	self.safe_range_radius = self.data.safe_range_radius

	-- 활성화 지속 시간
	self.active_duration = self.data.active_duration

	-- 재생성 될 문 이름
	self.reset_door_name = data_key

	self.range_light_color = CS.UnityEngine.Color32(53, 255, 70, 76)
	self.range_dark_color = CS.UnityEngine.Color32(53, 255, 70, 153)

	-- 번개 기믹 상태
	self.lightning_rod_state = {
		-- 비활성화 상태
		deactivate = {},
		searching = {
			update = self.update_searching_state
		},
		resetting = {
			enter = self.enter_resetting_state,
			exit = self.exit_resetting_state,
			update = self.update_resetting_state
		}
	}

	self.current_lightning_rod_state = self.lightning_rod_state.deactivate

	self.active_time_passed = 0

	self.get_fx_dead = function()
		return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_dead')
	end
end

-- IFO에 붙었을 때
function local_class:attach_to(fo)
	self.fo = fo

	self.cs_behaviour:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent))
	self.cs_behaviour:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridLeaveEvent))

	-- 던질 수 있는 타입인지
	self.is_holdable_type = self.fo.Holdable.IsHoldable

	-- 던질 수 있는 타입인지에 따른 처리
	if not self.is_holdable_type then
		self.attack_range = attack_range_util.create_circle(self.fo.Position + vector(0, 0.03, 0),
			self.safe_range_radius, self.range_light_color, self.range_dark_color)

		attack_range_util.show(self.attack_range)

	else
		self.reset_door = get_field_object(self.reset_door_name)
		if self.reset_door then
			self.fo.Position = self.reset_door.Position
			self.default_pos = self.fo.Position

			self.animator = self.fo.Transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))
			self.door_animator = self.reset_door.Transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))
			self.animator:Play('off')
		else
			-- 재생성 문 없으면 에러 (재생성 문 필수)
			local position_str = 'Vector(' .. self.fo.Position.x .. ', ' .. self.fo.Position.y .. ', ' .. self.fo.Position.z .. ')'
			logger_util.error('Cannot find reset door : ' .. self.fo.Name .. ', Position : ' .. position_str)
		end
	end

	self.active_time_passed = 0

	self.get_fx_dead()
end

-- IFO에서 떨어졌을 때
function local_class:detach_from(fo)
end

--- LuaMessageSystem(message_system)을 이용하여 콜백을 등록하였을 경우 이 곳에서 해제하여야 한다.
--- detach_from의 경우 LuaMessageSystem이 이미 날아간 상태이기 때문에 Leak발생함.
function local_class:dispose()
	self.cs_behaviour:UnSubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent))
	self.cs_behaviour:UnSubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridLeaveEvent))

	if self.timer_bar then
		field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(self.fo, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.TimerBar)
		self.timer_bar = nil
	end

	if self.attack_range then
		attack_range_util.destroy(self.attack_range)
		self.attack_range = nil
	end

	self.fo = nil
	self.cs_behaviour = nil
end

-- 현재 기본 스테이트 얻기(아이들, 걷기 등 전신 및 하체 상태)
function local_class:current_state()
	return nil
end

-- 현재 IFO가 취하고 있는 액션
function local_class:current_action()
	local current_state = self.cs_behaviour.CurrentState

	if lua_helper.type_compare(current_state, CS.Oak.FieldObjectThrownState) then
		if current_state.DidLandOnFloor then
			return CS.Oak.FieldObjectAction.ImpactMoving
		else
			return CS.Oak.FieldObjectAction.Flying
		end
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(current_state, CS.Oak.FieldObjectHeldUpState) then
		return CS.Oak.FieldObjectAction.Held
	end

	return CS.Oak.FieldObjectAction.Stopped
end

--region event
-- 이벤트 호출
function local_class:on_event(e)
	local consumed = CS.Oak.LuaScriptQuestUtil.CastToEventListenerAndSendSync(self.cs_behaviour.CurrentState, e, false)

	if consumed then
		return true
	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.HoldUpEvent) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.fo) then
			self:set_timer()
			self.cs_behaviour:ChangeState(CS.Oak.FieldObjectHeldUpState.Create(self.fo, e.Holder))
		end

		return true
	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.GetThrownEvent) then
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.PowerSourceTurnOffEvent.Create(self.fo))
		self.cs_behaviour:ChangeState(CS.Oak.FieldObjectThrownState.Create(e.ThrowInfo))
		return true
	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.GetThrownEndEvent) then
		self.cs_behaviour:ChangeState(CS.Oak.FieldObjectIdleState.Instance)
		return true
	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.HitFloorEvent) then
		-- 설치된 형태로 변경
		self.animator:Play('on')

		self.is_holdable_type = false
		self.fo.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.WallCrashBehaviour.Instance
		self.fo.Holdable = CS.Oak.NonHoldable.Instance
		self.fo.Electrocutable.IsElectrocutable = true

		if self.timer_bar then
			self.timer_bar.gameObject:SetActive(true)
			self.timer_bar_update = true
		end

		music_player_util.play_sfx({
			sfx_name = '02_gimmick_ticking_01',
			parent = self.fo,
			type_priority = sfx_type_priority.gimmick,
			player_priority = sfx_player_priority.object
		})

		self.active_time_passed = 0

		self.attack_range = attack_range_util.create_circle(self.fo.Position + vector(0, 0.03, 0),
			self.safe_range_radius, self.range_light_color, self.range_dark_color)

		attack_range_util.show(self.attack_range)

		self:change_state(self.lightning_rod_state.searching)
		self.cs_behaviour:ChangeState(CS.Oak.FieldObjectIdleState.Instance)

		return true
	end

	if not self.is_holdable_type and lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent) and e.CameraGrid:Contains(self.fo.Position) and
		(lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, get_party_leader()) or lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party)) then
		self:change_state(self.lightning_rod_state.searching)
		return true
	end

	if not self.is_holdable_type and lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.CameraGridLeaveEvent) and e.CameraGrid:Contains(self.fo.Position) and
		(lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, get_party_leader()) or lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party)) then
		self:change_state(self.lightning_rod_state.deactivate)
		return true
	end

	return false
end
--endregion

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.timer_bar_update then
		-- 타이머 업데이트
		self.active_time_passed = self.active_time_passed + dt
		self.timer_bar.BarSprite:SetValue(self.active_duration - self.active_time_passed, 0)

		-- 활성화 시간 끝나면 파괴 후 재생성
		if self.active_time_passed > self.active_duration then
			self:reset_objet()
		end
	end

	if self.current_lightning_rod_state.update then
		self.current_lightning_rod_state.update(self, dt)
	end
end

--- 상태 변경
function local_class:change_state(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.current_lightning_rod_state
	if prev_state.exit then
		prev_state.exit(self, new_state)
	end

	self.current_lightning_rod_state = new_state

	self.current_lightning_rod_state.time_passed = 0

	if new_state.enter then
		new_state.enter(self, prev_state)
	end
end

--region 캐스팅 상태
--- 캐스팅 상태 업데이트
function local_class:update_searching_state(_)
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	-- 안전 구역에 플레이어가 들어오면 번개 기믹 컨트롤러에 알려줌
	if (leader.Position - self.fo.Position).sqrMagnitude < self.safe_range_radius * self.safe_range_radius then
		self:change_state(self.lightning_rod_state.deactivate)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.fo, { 'add_lightning_rod' }))
	end
end
--endregion

--region 재설정 상태
--- 재설정 상태 진입
function local_class:enter_resetting_state(_)
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.fo, { 'remove_lightning_rod' }))

	if self.timer_bar then
		field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(self.fo, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.TimerBar)
		self.timer_bar_update = false
		self.timer_bar = nil
	end

	if self.attack_range then
		attack_range_util.hide(self.attack_range)
		attack_range_util.destroy(self.attack_range)
		self.attack_range = nil
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx({
		sfx_name = '02_explosion_01',
		play_pos = self.fo.Position,
		type_priority = sfx_type_priority.gimmick,
		player_priority = sfx_player_priority.object
	})

	self.get_fx_dead():Instantiate(self.fo.Position)
	self.fo.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
	self.fo.ActiveState = active_state('visible')

	self.door_animator:Play('open')
	self.animator:Play('off', -1, 1)

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.PowerSourceTurnOffEvent.Create(self.fo))

	self.is_holdable_type = true
	self.fo.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.PortableCrashBehaviour()
	self.fo.Holdable = CS.Oak.Holdable()
	self.fo.Electrocutable.IsElectrocutable = false

	-- 문 열리기 시작한 시간
	self.door_open_time = unity_class.time.time

	self.fo.Position = self.reset_door.Position + vector(0, -1.5, 0)

	music_player_util.play_sfx({
		sfx_name = '02_gimmick_door_down_03',
		play_pos = self.fo.Position,
		type_priority = sfx_type_priority.gimmick,
		player_priority = sfx_player_priority.object
	})
end

--- 재설정 상태 나갈 때
function local_class:exit_resetting_state(_)
	self.door_animator:Play('close')
	self.fo.Position = self.default_pos
	self.fo.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
end

--- 재설정 상태 업데이트
function local_class:update_resetting_state(dt)
	if unity_class.time.time - self.door_open_time > 0.3 then
		local cur_y = self.fo.Position.y + 3 * dt
		if cur_y > self.default_pos.y then
			self:change_state(self.lightning_rod_state.deactivate)
		else
			self.fo.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(self.fo.Position, cur_y)
		end
	end
end
--endregion

--- 타이머 설정
function local_class:set_timer()
	local u_dic = field_ui_manager:SetUI(self.fo, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.TimerBar)

	if self.timer_bar == nil then
		self.timer_bar = u_dic[CS.Oak.FieldUiType.TimerBar]
		self.timer_bar.BarSprite:SetWidth(100)
		self.timer_bar.BarSprite:SetMinMax(0, self.active_duration)
		self.timer_bar.BarSprite:SetValue(self.active_duration, 0)
		self.timer_bar.gameObject:SetActive(false)
	end
end

--- 오브젝트 리셋
function local_class:reset_objet()
	self:change_state(self.lightning_rod_state.resetting)
end

return {
	create = function(data_path, data_key, cs_behaviour)
		return local_class(data_path, data_key, cs_behaviour)
	end
}

local local_class = newclass('LightSwitch')

local switch_state_base = newclass('LightSwitchState')
local switch_state = {
	idle = newclass('LightSwitchIdleState', switch_state_base),
	full_gauge = newclass('LightSwitchFullGaugeState', switch_state_base),
}

--- 생성자
--- @param data_path string 해당 기믹이 사용할 Data의 경로.
--- @param data_key string 해당 기믹이 사용할 Data의 Key.
--- @param cs_behaviour any 해당 기믹의 C# Behaviour.
function local_class:init(data_path, data_key, cs_behaviour)
	self.cs_behaviour = cs_behaviour

	--기믹 데이터
	data_key = lua_helper.get_or_default(data_key, 'default')
	if data_key == '' then
		data_key = 'default'
	end

	self.data = load_util.load_lua_gimmick_data(data_path, data_key)

	-- 게이지 상승 속도
	self.gauge_speed = lua_helper.get_or_default(self.data.gauge_speed, 1)

	-- 타이머 활성화 시간
	self.life_time = self.data.life_time

	self.type = 'switch'

	self.states = nil

	self.switch_state = nil

	-- 빛 기믹 매니저 등록
	self.light_gimmick_manager = get_or_create_global_table('Gimmick/LightGimmickManager')

	-- 빛 타입
	self.ray_type = self.light_gimmick_manager.ray_type

	-- 연결된 빛
	self.connected_ray = create_lua_hashset()

	-- 연결 가능한 빛
	self.connectable_ray = create_lua_hashset()

	-- 양쪽 빛 다 받아야 하는 스위치인지
	self.is_both_switch = false

	for i = 1, #self.data.connectable_ray do
		if self.data.connectable_ray[i] == 'day' then
			self.connectable_ray:add(self.ray_type.day)
		elseif self.data.connectable_ray[i] == 'night' then
			self.connectable_ray:add(self.ray_type.night)
		end
	end

	self.sfx = {
		turn_on = function()
			music_player_util.play_sfx({
				sfx_name = '01_lightsaber_02',
				parent = self.fo,
				volume = 0.7,
				type_priority = 'gimmick',
				player_priority = 'object'
			})
		end,
		turn_off = function()
			music_player_util.play_sfx({
				sfx_name = '01_lightsaber_01',
				parent = self.fo,
				volume = 0.7,
				type_priority = 'gimmick',
				player_priority = 'object'
			})
		end
	}

	-- ui가 보이고 있는지
	self.is_show_field_ui = nil
end

-- IFO에 붙었을 때
function local_class:attach_to(fo)
	self.fo = fo

	self.light_gimmick_manager:add_gimmick(fo, self)

	if self.life_time then
		self.cs_behaviour:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.FieldUIShowEvent))
		self.cs_behaviour:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.FieldUIHideEvent))

		self.is_show_field_ui = true
	end

	if #self.connectable_ray > 1 then
		-- 양쪽 빛 다 받는 스위치 처리
		self.is_both_switch = true

		self.switch_data = {
			[self.ray_type.day] = {
				animator = fo.Transform:Find('symbol_sun'):GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator)),
				on = function(this)
					if not this.is_anim_on then
						this.animator:Play('on_sun')
						this.is_anim_on = true
						self.sfx.turn_on()
					end
				end,
				off = function(this)
					if this.is_anim_on then
						this.animator:Play('off_sun')
						this.is_anim_on = false
						self.sfx.turn_off()
					end
				end,
				is_anim_on = false,
				gauge = fo.Transform:Find('gauge_L')
			},
			[self.ray_type.night] = {
				animator = fo.Transform:Find('symbol_moon'):GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator)),
				on = function(this)
					if not this.is_anim_on then
						this.animator:Play('on_moon')
						this.is_anim_on = true
						self.sfx.turn_on()
					end
				end,
				off = function(this)
					if this.is_anim_on then
						this.animator:Play('off_moon')
						this.is_anim_on = false
						self.sfx.turn_off()
					end
				end,
				is_anim_on = false,
				gauge = fo.Transform:Find('gauge_R')
			},
		}

		self:change_gauge_scale(0, self.ray_type.day)
		self:change_gauge_scale(0, self.ray_type.night)

	else
		-- 나머지 스위치 처리
		self.switch_data = {
			animator = fo.Transform:Find('symbol'):GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator)),
			on = function(this)
				this.animator:Play('on')
				self.sfx.turn_on()
			end,
			off = function(this)
				this.animator:Play('off')
				self.sfx.turn_off()
			end,
			gauge = fo.Transform:Find('gauge')
		}

		self:change_gauge_scale(0)
	end

	self.states = {}

	for state_name, state in pairs(switch_state) do
		self.states[state_name] = state(self)
	end

	self:change_state(self.states.idle)
end

-- IFO에서 떨어졌을 때
function local_class:detach_from(fo)
	if self.light_gimmick_manager then
		self.light_gimmick_manager:remove_gimmick(fo, self)
	end

	for _, state in pairs(self.states) do
		state:dispose()
	end

	self.switch_data = nil

	self.is_show_field_ui = nil

	self.switch_state = nil
	self.states = nil
	self.fo = nil
end

--- LuaMessageSystem(message_system)을 이용하여 콜백을 등록하였을 경우 이 곳에서 해제하여야 한다.
--- detach_from의 경우 LuaMessageSystem이 이미 날아간 상태이기 때문에 Leak발생함.
function local_class:dispose()
	if self.life_time then
		self.cs_behaviour:UnSubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.FieldUIShowEvent))
		self.cs_behaviour:UnSubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.FieldUIHideEvent))
	end

	self.connected_ray:clear()
	self.connected_ray = nil

	self.connectable_ray:clear()
	self.connectable_ray = nil

	self.fo = nil
	self.light_gimmick_manager = nil
	self.cs_behaviour = nil
end

-- 현재 기본 스테이트 얻기(아이들, 걷기 등 전신 및 하체 상태)
function local_class:current_state()
	return nil
end

-- 현재 IFO가 취하고 있는 액션
function local_class:current_action()
	return CS.Oak.FieldObjectAction.None
end

--region event
-- 이벤트 호출
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.GimmickResetEvent) then
		self:reset_object()
		return true
	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.FieldUIShowEvent) then
		self.is_show_field_ui = true
		return true
	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.FieldUIHideEvent) then
		self.is_show_field_ui = false
		return true
	end
end
--endregion

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
end

function local_class:update(dt)
	self.switch_state:update(dt)

	self.connected_ray:clear()
end

--- 현재 스위치에 맞는 빛이 연결됐는지
function local_class:is_connected()
	-- 아무 빛이나 다 받는 스위치
	if #self.connectable_ray == 0 then
		if #self.connected_ray > 0 then
			return true
		else
			return false
		end
	end

	local connected_count = 0

	-- 햇빛에 연결 됐는지
	if self.connectable_ray:contains(self.ray_type.day) and self.connected_ray:contains(self.ray_type.day) then
		connected_count = connected_count + 1
	end

	-- 달빛에 연결 됐는지
	if self.connectable_ray:contains(self.ray_type.night) and self.connected_ray:contains(self.ray_type.night) then
		connected_count = connected_count + 1
	end

	return connected_count == #self.connectable_ray
end

--- 게이지 크기 변경
function local_class:change_gauge_scale(value, ray_type)
	if self.is_both_switch then
		self.switch_data[ray_type].gauge.localScale = vector_util.get_x0z(self.switch_data[ray_type].gauge.localScale, value)
	else
		self.switch_data.gauge.localScale = vector_util.get_x0z(self.switch_data.gauge.localScale, value)
	end
end

--- 스테이트 변경
function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	local prev_state = self.switch_state

	if prev_state == next_state then
		return
	end

	if prev_state then
		prev_state:exit(next_state)
	end

	self.switch_state = next_state

	if next_state then
		next_state:enter(prev_state)
	end
end

--- 켜진 상태인지
function local_class:is_turn_on()
	if self.switch_state == self.states.full_gauge then
		return true
	end

	return false
end

--- 스위치 리셋
function local_class:reset_object()
	self:change_state(self.states.idle)

	if self.is_both_switch then
		self.switch_state.current_gauge = {
			[self.ray_type.day] = 0,
			[self.ray_type.night] = 0,
		}

		self:change_gauge_scale(0, self.ray_type.day)
		self:change_gauge_scale(0, self.ray_type.night)
	else
		self.switch_state.current_gauge = 0
		self:change_gauge_scale(0)
	end
end

--region Base State
function switch_state_base:init(controller)
	self.controller = controller
	self.fo = controller.fo

	self.time_passed = 0

	self.ray_type = self.controller.ray_type

	self.switch_data = self.controller.switch_data

	self.is_both_switch = self.controller.is_both_switch
end

function switch_state_base:dispose()
	self.fo = nil
	self.controller = nil
end

function switch_state_base:enter()
	self.time_passed = 0
end

function switch_state_base:exit()
	self.time_passed = 0
end

function switch_state_base:update(dt)
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt
end
--endregion Base State

--region Idle State
function switch_state.idle:init(controller)
	self.super:init(controller)

	if self.is_both_switch then
		self.current_gauge = {
			[self.ray_type.day] = 0,
			[self.ray_type.night] = 0,
		}
	else
		self.current_gauge = 0
	end
end

function switch_state.idle:dispose()
	self.super:dispose()
end

function switch_state.idle:enter()
	self.super:enter()
end

function switch_state.idle:exit()
	self.super:exit()
end

function switch_state.idle:update(dt)
	self.super:update(dt)

	if self.is_both_switch then
		-- 양쪽 빛 다 받는 스위치 처리
		for type, _ in pairs(self.current_gauge) do
			local speed = self.controller.gauge_speed

			if not self.controller.connected_ray:contains(type) then
				speed = -1 * speed
			end

			self.current_gauge[type] = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(self.current_gauge[type] + dt * speed)
			self.controller:change_gauge_scale(self.current_gauge[type], type)
		end

		for ray_type, _ in pairs(self.current_gauge) do
			if self.current_gauge[ray_type] >= 1 then
				self.switch_data[ray_type]:on()
			else
				self.switch_data[ray_type]:off()
			end
		end

		if self.switch_data[self.ray_type.day].is_anim_on and self.switch_data[self.ray_type.night].is_anim_on then
			self.controller:change_state(self.controller.states.full_gauge)
		end
	else
		-- 나머지 스위치들 처리
		local speed = self.controller.gauge_speed

		if not self.controller:is_connected() then
			speed = -1 * speed
		end

		self.current_gauge = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(self.current_gauge + dt * speed)
		self.controller:change_gauge_scale(self.current_gauge)

		if self.current_gauge >= 1 then
			self.controller:change_state(self.controller.states.full_gauge)
		end
	end
end
--endregion Idle State

--region FullGauge State
function switch_state.full_gauge:init(controller)
	self.super:init(controller)

	self.life_time = self.controller.life_time
end

function switch_state.full_gauge:dispose()
	self.super:dispose()
end

function switch_state.full_gauge:enter()
	self.super:enter()

	if not self.is_both_switch then
		self.switch_data:on()
	end

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.SwitchOnOffEvent.Create(self.fo, true, self.fo))
end

function switch_state.full_gauge:exit()
	self.super:exit()

	if not self.is_both_switch then
		self.switch_data:off()
	end

	if self.timer_bar then
		field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(self.fo, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.TimerBar)
		self.timer_bar = nil
	end

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.SwitchOnOffEvent.Create(self.fo, false, self.fo))
end

function switch_state.full_gauge:update(dt)
	if not self.life_time then
		return
	end

	self:set_timer()

	if self.controller:is_connected() then
		self.time_passed = 0
	else
		self.super:update(dt)
	end

	if self.timer_bar then
		self.timer_bar.BarSprite:SetValue(self.life_time - self.time_passed, 0)
	end

	if self.time_passed > self.life_time then
		self.controller:change_state(self.controller.states.idle)
	end
end

--- 타이머 설정
function switch_state.full_gauge:set_timer()
	if self.timer_bar or not self.controller.is_show_field_ui then
		return
	end

	local u_dic = field_ui_manager:SetUI(self.fo, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.TimerBar)

	self.timer_bar = u_dic[CS.Oak.FieldUiType.TimerBar]
	self.timer_bar.BarSprite:SetWidth(100)
	self.timer_bar.BarSprite:SetMinMax(0, self.life_time)
	self.timer_bar.BarSprite:SetValue(self.life_time, 0)
end
--endregion FullGauge State

return {
	create = function(data_path, data_key, cs_behaviour)
		return local_class(data_path, data_key, cs_behaviour)
	end
}

		if e.IsOpen then
			self.is_opened = true

			if not self.is_playing then
				start_coroutine(self.door_open_routine, self, e.Immediate)
			end

		else
			self.is_opened = false

			if not self.is_playing then

			end
		end

		return true;

end

function local_class:door_open_routine(immediate)
	local mesh = CS.Utils.FindChildRecursively(self.fo.Transform, 'mesh')
	local hitbox_size = self.fo.Hitbox.size
	local hitbox_pivot = self.fo.Hitbox.pivot

	if not immediate then
		self.is_playing = true

		local time_passed = 0
		local duration = self.open_duration
		local forward_opened = self.is_opened
		local start_pos = self.is_opened and 0 or self.height
		local end_pos = self.is_opened and self.height or 0

		local hitbox_height = 1
		local hit_start_pos = self.is_opened and 0 or hitbox_height
		local hit_end_pos = self.is_opened and hitbox_height or 0

		self.fo.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')

		while self.is_playing do
			--문 오픈 스테이트 바뀔 경우 값을 새로 셋팅
			if forward_opened ~= self.is_opened then
				forward_opened = self.is_opened
				start_pos = self.is_opened and 0 or self.height
				end_pos = self.is_opened and self.height or 0
				time_passed = duration - time_passed
				hit_start_pos = self.is_opened and 0 or 1
				hit_end_pos = self.is_opened and 1 or 0
			end

			if time_passed > duration then
				break
			end

			local progress = time_passed / duration

			mesh.localPosition = unity_class.vector3.down * unity_class.mathf.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, progress)
			hitbox_pivot.y = unity_class.vector3.down * unity_class.mathf.Lerp(hit_start_pos, hit_end_pos, progress)
			self.fo.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(hitbox_pivot, hitbox_size)

			coroutine.yield(nil)

			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		end

		self.is_playing = false

		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_switch_button_03', loop = false, parent = self.fo,
											type_priority = 'gimmick', player_priority = 'object', max_distance = 12 })
	end

	--오픈/클로즈 연출 완료 후 위치 값 고정 및 이벤트 호출
	if self.is_opened then
		self.fo.ActiveState = active_state('visible')
		mesh.localPosition = vector(0, -self.height, 0)
		--확실한 통과를 보장하기 위해 히트박스를 약간 더 내린다.
		hitbox_pivot.y = hitbox_pivot.y - 0.1
		self.fo.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(hitbox_pivot, hitbox_size)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.LinkDoorOpenedEvent.Create(self.door_data_key))
	else
		self.fo.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
		mesh.localPosition = vector(0, 0, 0)
		hitbox_pivot.y = 0
		self.fo.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(hitbox_pivot, hitbox_size)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.LinkDoorClosedEvent.Create(self.door_data_key))
	end
end

return {
	create = function(data_path, data_key, cs_behaviour)
		return local_class(data_path, data_key, cs_behaviour)
	end
}

	--플래그 스위치 여부

	self.is_reset_control = true

	end

		self.is_flag = true
		opened = stage_progress:GetNamedData(self.fo.Name, opened)
	end

	-- 이벤트 구독
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.LinkDoorEvent), 'on_link_door_event')

	-- ObjectPool Load
	self.get_fx_hit()
	self.get_fx_lasthit()

	-- publish를 위해 한 프레임 기다림
	if self.is_flag then
		coroutine_manager:RunInNextFrame(stage.StageGameObject, function()
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.LinkDoorEvent.Create(self.door_data_key, opened))

--- LuaMessageSystem(message_system)을 이용하여 콜백을 등록하였을 경우 이 곳에서 해제하여야 한다.

function local_class:current_state()
	return nil
end

-- 현재 IFO가 취하고 있는 액션
function local_class:current_action()
	return CS.Oak.FieldObjectAction.None
end

--region event
-- 이벤트 호출
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	-- 이미 실행 중인 스크린 플레이가 없다면 ScreenPlayRecorder에 Request를 등록
	if not stage.ScreenPlayRecorder:TryProceedRequest(self.cs_behaviour) then
		-- 이미 실행 중인 스크린 플레이가 있다면, 기믹 루틴 실행 안함.
		return false
	end

	if not self.is_playing then
		start_coroutine(self.interact_link_door_switch, self, self.fo)

		return true
	else
		--연출 실행 중이면 기믹 루틴 실행 하지 않고 ScreenPlayRecorder에 Request를 삭제
		stage.ScreenPlayRecorder:RemoveRequest(self.cs_behaviour)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_link_door_event(e)
	if e.LinkDoorTypeName == self.door_data_key then
		if e.IsOpen then
			if not self.is_opened then
				self.is_opened = true
				start_coroutine(self.switch_open_routine, self, e.Immediate)
			end
		else
			if self.is_opened then
				self.is_opened = false
				start_coroutine(self.switch_open_routine, self, e.Immediate)
			end
		end

		return true;
	end

	return false
end
--endregion

--스위치 기믹 인터렉트 시
--파티리더 공격하는 연출(청홍벽 인터렉트 사양 동일) + 도어 상호 작용 메시지 호출
function local_class:interact_link_door_switch(switch)
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(user_party.Leader, { name = 'sword_attack', loop = false }, { name = 'attack' })

	local dist = switch.Position - user_party.Leader.Position;
	character_util.spine_deviate_local(user_party.Leader, dist * 0.3, 0.2, 0.3)

	wait_for_sec(0.2)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_switch_button_02')
	switch:Shake(0.04, 0.3)

	self.get_fx_hit():Instantiate(switch.Position + vector(0, 0.3, 0))
	self.get_fx_lasthit():Instantiate(switch.Position + vector(0, 0.3, 0))

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(user_party.Leader)

	if self.is_tutorial then
		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		self:publish_door_event()
	else
		--링크 도어 이벤트 호출
		self:publish_door_event()

		wait_for_sec(0.2)
	end

	if not self.is_tutorial and
			self.is_reset_control then
		field_ui_manager:Show()
		party_util.reset_controllers()
	end

	--기믹 루틴 종료 시 ScreenPlayRecorder에 Request를 삭제
	stage.ScreenPlayRecorder:RemoveRequest(self.cs_behaviour)
end

function local_class:publish_door_event()
	if self.is_opened then
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.LinkDoorEvent.Create(self.door_data_key, false, false))
	else
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.LinkDoorEvent.Create(self.door_data_key, true, false))
	end
end

--스위치 열고 닫는 루틴
function local_class:switch_open_routine(immediate)
	local mesh = CS.Utils.FindChildRecursively(self.fo.Transform, 'mesh')

	if not immediate then
		self.is_playing = true

		local time_passed = 0
		local duration = self.open_duration
		local start_pos = self.is_opened and 0 or self.height
		local end_pos = self.is_opened and self.height or 0

		while self.is_playing do
			if time_passed > duration then
				break
			end

			local progress = time_passed / duration
			mesh.localPosition = unity_class.vector3.down * unity_class.mathf.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, progress)
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		self.is_playing = false
	end

	--열고 닫는 연출 완료 후 위치 고정
	if self.is_opened then
		mesh.localPosition = vector(0, -self.height, 0)
	else
		mesh.localPosition = vector(0, 0, 0)
	end

	if self.is_flag then
		stage_progress:SetNamedData(self.fo.Name, self.is_opened)
	end
end

function local_class:current_action()

		self.current_push_state == self.push_state.pushing or
		self.current_push_state == self.push_state.move_remain_distance then

		return CS.Oak.FieldObjectAction.Moving
	end

	return CS.Oak.FieldObjectAction.Stopped
end

--region event
-- 이벤트 호출
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, typeof(CS.Oak.GetPushedStartEvent)) then
		self.pusher = e.Pusher

		if self.current_push_state == self.push_state.move_remain_distance then
			return true
		end

		self.pushed_direction = e.Pusher.Direction

		local target_dist = 1
		local direction = CS.Oak.DirectionExtensions.To4WayVector3(self.pushed_direction)

		self.target_pos = self.fo.Position + direction * target_dist

		self.current_push_state = self.push_state.pushing
		self.fo.Pushable:StartPushedBy(e.Pusher)

		return true
	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, typeof(CS.Oak.PushMoveStartEvent)) then
		if self.current_push_state == self.push_state.move_remain_distance then
			return true
		end

		self.push_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_grass_slide_02', parent = self.fo,
													 type_priority = 'gimmick', player_priority = 'object' })

		return true
	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, typeof(CS.Oak.GetPushedEndEvent)) then
		if self.current_push_state == self.push_state.move_remain_distance then
			return true
		end

		self.fo.Pushable:EndPushedBy(e.Pusher)
		self:check_remain_distance(self.pushed_direction)

		return true
	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, typeof(CS.Oak.PushBlockedEvent)) then
		if self.push_sfx then
			self.push_sfx:Stop()
		end

		self.current_push_state = self.push_state.stopped
		return true
	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, typeof(CS.Oak.MoveBlockedEvent)) then
		if self.push_sfx then
			self.push_sfx:Stop()
		end

		self.current_push_state = self.push_state.stopped
		return true
	end

	return false
end
