--region event
-- 이벤트 호출
function local_class:on_event(e)

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent) then
		if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'activate_jammer' then
			self:on_active_jammer_event(e)
		end

		if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'remove_jammer' and e:GetParamAt(1) == self.fo.Name then
			self:release_jammer()
		end
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractCancelEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_cancel_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractFinishEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_finish_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.BattleEndEvent) then
		-- 기존 설치된 재머들 더 이상 사용 안하므로 제거
		self:release_jammer()
	end
end

-- 인터릭트 완료된 경우
-- 여기서 보스와의 위치를 판단하여 이벤트 보냄/안보냄 설정하도록 함.
function local_class:launch_jammer()
	-- 기본적으로 동작하는 이벤트
	-- 재머 사용 애니메이션 / 이펙트 플레이
	self.gimmick_animator:Play(self.jammer_attack_start_animation_name)
	self.fx_jammer_fire = self.get_fx_fire():Instantiate(self.fo.Position, self.fo.Transform.rotation, self.fo.Transform)

	--재머 사용됨 이벤트를 보스에게 보냄
	if self.boss_red_hood ~= nil then
		local current_dist = vector_util.distance(unity_class.vector3(self.range_center.x, 0, 0),
				unity_class.vector3(self.boss_red_hood.Position.x, 0, 0))
		local extents_x = (self.gimmick_interact_size_x / 2)

		--사거리 안으로 들어온 경우에만 보스에게 적중 메세지
		if current_dist <= extents_x then
			--보스에 적중된 경우에 완전종료 처리
			-- 상호작용 불가능하도록 설정한다.
			self.fo.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
			-- 크래시비헤비어 Ethereal 로 변경한다.
			self.fo.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.boss_red_hood, { 'jammer_activated', extents_x }))
			--재머 사용됨
			self.is_launched = true
			self:done()
		else
			--일정 범위안에 적들 데미지 & 밀치기
			for _, v in pairs(user_party) do
				local dist = vector_util.distance(v.Position, self.fo.Position)
				if dist <= self.jammer_push_range then
					local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
					damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Death
					damage_info.sender = self.fo
					damage_info.target = v
					damage_info.direction = vector_util.normalized(v.Position - self.fo.Position)
					damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
					damage_info.knockBackDirection = vector_util.normalized(v.Position - self.fo.Position)
					damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce
					command_util.publish_cmd(damage_info.Owner, CS.Oak.DamageCommand.Create(damage_info))
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

-- 배틀 종료로 인한 해제
function local_class:release_jammer()
	if not self.is_jammer_working then
		return
	end
	--죽으면서 취소되는 경우에 사운드 남아있는 이슈로 여기서 해제 해줌.
	if self.interacting_sfx ~= nil then
		self.interacting_sfx:FadeOut(0.05)
	end

	if not is_unity_null(self.fx_jammer_start) then
		self.fx_jammer_start:Dispose()
	end
	self.fx_jammer_start = nil

	--들어가는 애니메이션 플레이 해줄것.
	if not is_unity_null(self.fx_jammer_loop) then
		self.fx_jammer_loop:Dispose()
	end
	self.fx_jammer_loop = nil

	if not is_unity_null(self.fx_jammer_fire) then
		self.fx_jammer_fire:Dispose()
	end
	self.fx_jammer_fire = nil

	self.gimmick_animator:Play(self.jammer_attack_end_ani_name)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot(self.jammer_down_sfx_name)

	local leader = user_party.Leader
	if not leader.CharacterStatsBehaviour.IsDead then
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
		character_util.set_locked_dir(leader, 'none')
		user_party_leader:HideWeapon(false)
	end

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(leader, user_party.Leader) then
		party_util.reset_controllers()
	else
		message_system:SendSync(leader, CS.Oak.StateResetEvent.Instance)
	end

	field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(self.fo, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.TimerBar)
	--ActionState를 캐릭터 기본State로 변경
	message_system:Send(leader.CharacterBehaviour, CS.Oak.ActionStateChangeEvent.Create(nil))

	--인터렉트 및 충돌 안되도록 수정
	self.fo.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
	self.fo.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance

	for idx = 1, #self.gimmick_ranges do
		self.gimmick_ranges[idx]:Hide()
	end

	self.is_launched = false
end

function local_class:on_active_jammer_event(e)
	--활성화 되는 재머로 선택된 경우 인터렉터블 활성화
	local name = e:GetParamAt(1)
	if name == self.fo.Name  then
		-- 상호작용 가능하도록 복구한다.
		self.fo.Interactable = self.interactable
		-- 크래시비헤비어 원상복구
		self.fo.CrashBehaviour = nil
		--레디 애니메이션 플레이
		self.gimmick_animator:Play(self.jammer_ready_animation_name)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot(self.jammer_up_sfx_name)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot(self.jammer_up2_sfx_name)
		--이펙트 플레이 현재 없으니 주석
		self.fx_jammer_start = self:get_fx_start():Instantiate(self.fo.Position, self.fo.Transform.rotation, self.fo.Transform)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot(self.jammer_electric_sfx_name)

		self.fx_jammer_loop = self:get_fx_loop():Instantiate(self.fo.Position, self.fo.Transform.rotation, self.fo.Transform)
		-- 범위표시 해줄것.. 녹색 레인지 표시
		for idx = 1, #self.gimmick_ranges do
			self.gimmick_ranges[idx]:Show(0)
		end

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot(self.jammer_show_range_sfx_name)

		--일정 범위안에 적들 데미지 & 밀치기
		for _, v in pairs(user_party) do
			local dist = vector_util.distance(v.Position, self.fo.Position)
			if dist <= self.jammer_push_range then
				local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
				damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Death
				damage_info.sender = self.fo
				damage_info.target = v
				damage_info.damage = self.jammer_push_damage
				damage_info.direction = vector_util.normalized(v.Position - self.fo.Position)
				damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
				damage_info.knockBackDirection = vector_util.normalized(v.Position - self.fo.Position)
				damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce
				command_util.publish_cmd(damage_info.Owner, CS.Oak.DamageCommand.Create(damage_info))
			end
		end
		--활성화된 재머만 모션등 사용하기 위해
		self.is_jammer_working = true
	end
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)

	self.interactor = e.Interactor

	if self.is_interacting then
		return false
	end

	-- 인터렉트 안되는 경우
	if stage.BattleManager:GetBattleForMyParty() ~= nil and self.can_interact_in_battle == false then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.interactor, { key = 'err_cant_interact_in_battle' })
		end))
		return false
	end

	self:start_interacting()

	return true
end

function local_class:on_interact_cancel_event(e)
	self:cancel()

	return true
end

function local_class:on_interact_finish_event(e)

	--활성화 된 상태이고 동작되지 않은 상황에서
	if not self.is_launched then
		self:launch_jammer()
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_damage_event(e)
	if self.interactor ~= nil and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.target, self.interactor) then
		self:cancel()
	end

	return false
end
--endregion

-- 업데이트. attach_to가 불린 시점부터 detach_from 이 불린 시점까지 매 프레임 불린다.
function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.is_interacting then
		self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

		if self.time_passed >= self.interacting_duration then
			self.is_interacting = false

			local command = CS.Oak.InteractFinishCommand.Create(self.interactor, self.fo)
			command_util.execute_cmd(command)
		else
			self.timer_bar.BarSprite:SetValue(self.time_passed, 0)
		end

		self.prev_time_passed = self.time_passed
	elseif self.timer_bar ~= nil then
		local interacting_reset_duration_scale = self.interacting_duration / self.interacting_reset_duration
		self.time_passed = self.time_passed - (interacting_reset_duration_scale * dt)

		if self.time_passed > 0 then
			self.timer_bar.BarSprite:SetValue(self.time_passed, 0)
		else
			field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(self.fo, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.TimerBar)
			self.timer_bar = nil
		end
	end
end

--인터렉팅 시작
function local_class:start_interacting()
	self.is_interacting = true

	-- 무기 숨겨둠.
	user_party_leader:HideWeapon(true)

	local look_dir

	if self.interacting_direction_locked_side then
		if user_party.Position.x < self.fo.Bounds.center.x then
			look_dir = 'right'
		else
			look_dir = 'left'
		end
	else
		look_dir = character_util.get_direction(user_party.Leader)
	end

	character_util.set_locked_dir(user_party.Leader, look_dir)

	local interact_state = CS.Oak.CharacterControllerInteractState.Create(user_party.Leader, self.fo)
	message_system:SendSync(user_party.Leader, CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(interact_state))

	self.interacting_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = self.jammer_interact_sfx_name, loop = true, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'default' })

	local req = CS.Oak.AnimationRequest(self.interacting_animation_name, CS.Oak.AnimationPriorities.Default, true)
	local state = CS.Oak.CharacterMarionetteState.Create(user_party.Leader, req)
	local state_change_event = CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(state)

	state.CurrentAction = CS.Oak.FieldObjectAction.Gathering
	message_system:SendSync(user_party.Leader.FieldObjectBehaviour, state_change_event)

	self:set_field_timer()
end

function local_class:cancel()

	if self.interacting_sfx ~= nil then
		self.interacting_sfx:FadeOut(0.05)
	end

	if self.interactor ~= nil and not self.interactor.CharacterStatsBehaviour.IsDead then
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.interactor)
		character_util.set_locked_dir(self.interactor, 'none')
	end

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.interactor, user_party.Leader) then
		party_util.reset_controllers()
	else
		message_system:SendSync(self.interactor, CS.Oak.StateResetEvent.Instance)
	end

	if self.interacting_reset_duration == 0 then
		field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(self.fo, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.TimerBar)
		self.timer_bar = nil
	end
	user_party_leader:HideWeapon(false)
	--취소된경우 뭐 하는거 없음.
	self.is_interacting = false
end

function local_class:done()
	if self.interacting_sfx ~= nil then
		self.interacting_sfx:FadeOut(0.05)
	end

	if not self.interactor.CharacterStatsBehaviour.IsDead then
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.interactor)
		character_util.set_locked_dir(self.interactor, 'none')
	end

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.interactor, user_party.Leader) then
		party_util.reset_controllers()
	else
		message_system:SendSync(self.interactor, CS.Oak.StateResetEvent.Instance)
	end

	field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(self.fo, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.TimerBar)
	self.timer_bar = nil
	user_party_leader:HideWeapon(false)
	-- FIXME : 여기서 굳이 범위를 감출 필요 있을까?
	for idx = 1, #self.gimmick_ranges do
		self.gimmick_ranges[idx]:Hide()
	end
	--완료되면 보스에게 이펙트 사출
	self.is_interacting = false
end

-- 채집 시간을 알려주는 타이머를 세팅한다.
function local_class:set_field_timer()
	local u_dic = field_ui_manager:SetUI(self.fo, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.TimerBar)

	if self.timer_bar == nil then
		self.timer_bar = u_dic[CS.Oak.FieldUiType.TimerBar]
		self.timer_bar.BarSprite:SetWidth(100)
		self.timer_bar.BarSprite:SetMinMax(0, self.interacting_duration);
		self.timer_bar.BarSprite:SetValue(0, 0);

		self.timer_bar.gameObject:SetActive(true);

		self.time_passed = 0
		self.prev_time_passed = 0
	end
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	self.cs_behaviour:ChangeState(next_state)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self:change_state()

	self.cs_behaviour = nil
	self.interacting_duration = nil
	self.interacting_reset_duration = nil
	self.interacting_animation_name = nil
	self.interacting_direction_locked_side = nil
	self.can_interact_in_battle = nil
	self.gimmick_interact_size_x = nil
	self.gimmick_interact_size_z = nil

	self.time_passed = nil
	self.prev_time_passed = nil
	self.is_interacting = nil
	self.interacting_sfx = nil
	self.red_hood_name = nil
	self.boss_red_hood = nil
	self.is_launched = nil
	self.jammer_idle_ani_name = nil
	self.jammer_interact_animation_name = nil
	self.jammer_ready_animation_name = nil
	self.jammer_attack_start_animation_name = nil
	self.jammer_attack_end_ani_name = nil
	self.gimmick_interact_color_lights = nil
	self.gimmick_interact_color_darks = nil
	self.gimmick_range_ratio = nil
	self.jammer_charge_fx_name = nil
	self.jammer_loop_fx_name = nil
	self.jammer_activate_fx_name = nil

	-- 애니메이션 컨트롤용
	self.gimmick_animator = nil
	self.base_track = nil
	self.fo = nil
	self.timer_bar = nil
	self.interactor = nil
	self.boss_red_hood = nil
	self.interactable = nil
	self.zone_bound = nil

	if not is_unity_null(self.fx_jammer_loop) then
		self.fx_jammer_loop:Dispose()
	end
	self.fx_jammer_loop = nil
	if not is_unity_null(self.fx_jammer_fire) then
		self.fx_jammer_fire:Dispose()
	end
	self.fx_jammer_fire = nil

	if self.gimmick_ranges then
		for idx = #self.gimmick_ranges, 1, -1 do
			local range = table.remove(self.gimmick_ranges, idx)
			if not is_unity_null(range) then
				CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(range)
			end
		end
		self.gimmick_ranges = nil
	end

	if self.subscribe_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), self.subscribe_func)
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.BattleEndEvent), self.subscribe_func)
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), self.subscribe_func)
		self.subscribe_func = nil
	end
end

return {
	create = function(data_path, data_key, cs_behaviour)
		return local_class(data_path, data_key, cs_behaviour)
	end
}

local local_class = newclass('RollingBallBehaviour')

--- 생성자
--- @param data_path string 해당 기믹이 사용할 Data의 경로.
--- @param data_key string 해당 기믹이 사용할 Data의 Key.
--- @param cs_behaviour any 해당 기믹의 C# Behaviour.
function local_class:init(data_path, data_key, cs_behaviour)
	self.cs_behaviour = cs_behaviour

	-- 데이터가 필요할 경우 아래 주석을 풀고 사용하면 된다.
	-- 데이터 사용 방법은 Confluence 참고
	local data = load_util.load_lua_gimmick_data(data_path, data_key)
	self.thrown_speed = data['speed']
	self.reset_switch_name = data['reset_switch_name']
	self.move_magnitude = data['move_magnitude']
	self.ball_touch_sfxs = data['ball_touch_sfxs']

	self.get_fx_reset = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_reset_object') end
	self.get_fx_hit = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit') end

	self.spine_controller = nil
	self.base_track = nil

	-- 마지막으로 대미지를 받은 시간
	self.last_damage_time = 0

	-- 마지막 대미지를 받은 시점부터 대미지를 받지 않을 시간
	self.non_damage_time = 0.3
end

-- IFO에 붙었을 때
function local_class:attach_to(fo)
	self.fo = fo
	self.default_position = fo.Position

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent), 'on_damage_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ResetSwitchTurnedOnEvent), 'on_reset_switch_turned_on_event')

	self.get_fx_reset()
	self.get_fx_hit()

	-- 기본 애니메이션 지정
	self.spine_controller = self.fo.UnityGameObject:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.SpineController))

	self.base_track = CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(CS.Oak.Character.SpineAnimationTrack.Base)
	self.spine_controller:SetAnimation(self.base_track, 'walk', true)

	local current_anim_entry = self.spine_controller.SkeletonAnimation.state:GetCurrent(self.base_track)
	current_anim_entry.TimeScale = 0

	self.fo.CrashBehaviour.NonDamageTime = 0

	self.move_magnitude = lua_helper.get_or_default(self.move_magnitude, 0.0005)
end

-- IFO에서 떨어졌을 때
function local_class:detach_from(fo)
end

-- 현재 기본 스테이트 얻기(아이들, 걷기 등 전신 및 하체 상태)
function local_class:current_state()
	return nil
end

-- 현재 IFO가 취하고 있는 액션
function local_class:current_action()
	return CS.Oak.FieldObjectAction.None
end

-- 업데이트. attach_to가 불린 시점부터 detach_from 이 불린 시점까지 매 프레임 불린다.
function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.last_damage_time + self.non_damage_time < unity_class.time.realtimeSinceStartup and
		lua_helper.type_compare(self.cs_behaviour.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectThrownState)) and
		(user_party.Leader.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentAction == CS.Oak.FieldObjectAction.Moving or
		user_party.Leader.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentAction == CS.Oak.FieldObjectAction.ImpactMoving) then

		local move = self.move_magnitude * direction_util.to_vector3(direction_util.get_opposite(user_party.Leader.Direction))
		local fo_list = CS.Oak.LuaCollisionUtil.GetFieldObjectsCollidedBy(self.fo.Bounds, move)
		for i = 0, fo_list.Count - 1 do
			local fo = fo_list[i]
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(fo, user_party.Leader) then
				-- 애니메이션 멈추도록 함
				local current_anim_entry = self.spine_controller.SkeletonAnimation.state:GetCurrent(self.base_track)
				current_anim_entry.TimeScale = 0

				self.cs_behaviour:ChangeState(CS.Oak.FieldObjectIdleState.Instance)
			end
		end

		fo_list:Dispose()
	end
end

-- 이벤트 호출
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.GetThrownEndEvent) then
		-- 애니메이션 멈추도록 함
		local current_anim_entry = self.spine_controller.SkeletonAnimation.state:GetCurrent(self.base_track)
		current_anim_entry.TimeScale = 0

		self.cs_behaviour:ChangeState(CS.Oak.FieldObjectIdleState.Instance)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_damage_event(e)
	local info = e.Info
	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(info.target, self.fo) then
		return false
	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(self.cs_behaviour.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectThrownState)) then
		return false
	end

	-- 폭탄 대미지를 받았을 때
	if info.type:HasFlag(CS.Oak.DamageType.Trap) or info.type:HasFlag(CS.Oak.DamageType.Explosion) or info.type:HasFlag(CS.Oak.DamageType.AffectGimmick) then
		self.last_damage_time = unity_class.time.realtimeSinceStartup

		local throw_dir = vector_util.to_direction(info.direction)
		self.spine_controller.Direction = throw_dir

		local current_anim_entry = self.spine_controller.SkeletonAnimation.state:GetCurrent(self.base_track)
		current_anim_entry.TimeScale = 1

		local throw_info = CS.Oak.ThrowInfo()
		throw_info.thrower = info.sender
		throw_info.thrownObject = info.target
		throw_info.direction = direction_util.to_vector3(throw_dir)
		throw_info.initialSpeed = self.thrown_speed
		throw_info.throwStartPos = info.target.Position
		throw_info.pickedPos = vector_util.get_x0z(info.target.Position)
		throw_info.BounceSfxHandleName = info.target.Holdable.BounceSfxHandleName
		throw_info.resizeHitbox = false

		throw_info.bounce = 0
		throw_info.yElasticity = 1 / math.sqrt(2)
		throw_info.xzElasticity = 0

		local effect_offset = vector(0, 0.1, -0.05)
		self.get_fx_hit():Instantiate(self.fo.Position - 0.3 * throw_info.direction + effect_offset)

		for i = 1, #self.ball_touch_sfxs do
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot(self.ball_touch_sfxs[i])
		end

		local thrown_state = CS.Oak.FieldObjectThrownState.Create(throw_info)
		thrown_state.AddIgnoreCrash = false
		self.cs_behaviour:ChangeState(thrown_state)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_reset_switch_turned_on_event(e)
	if e.SwitchObject.Name == self.reset_switch_name then
		self:reset_object()
		return true
	end

	return false
end

--- 오브젝트 리셋
function local_class:reset_object()
	if self.fo.Position == self.default_position or self.fo.ActiveState == active_state('disabled') then
		return
	end

	local prev_effect_pos = self.fo.Position
	local effect_size = self.fo.Bounds.size

	self.fo.Position = self.default_position
	self.spine_controller.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Down

	self.spine_controller:SetAnimation(self.base_track, 'walk', true)

	local current_anim_entry = self.spine_controller.SkeletonAnimation.state:GetCurrent(self.base_track)
	current_anim_entry.TimeScale = 0

	local reset_effect_pool = self.get_fx_reset()

	local prev_effect = reset_effect_pool:Instantiate(prev_effect_pos)
	prev_effect.transform.localScale = effect_size

	local cur_effect = reset_effect_pool:Instantiate(self.fo.Position)
	cur_effect.transform.localScale = effect_size

	self.cs_behaviour:ChangeState(CS.Oak.FieldObjectIdleState.Instance)
end

--- Behaviour에 있는 StateMachine의 State를 변경
function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	self.cs_behaviour:ChangeState(next_state)
end

--- LuaMessageSystem(message_system)을 이용하여 콜백을 등록하였을 경우 이 곳에서 해제하여야 한다.
--- detach_from의 경우 LuaMessageSystem이 이미 날아간 상태이기 때문에 Leak발생함.
function local_class:dispose()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ResetSwitchTurnedOnEvent))

	self.spine_controller = nil
	self.base_track = nil

	self:change_state()
end

return {
	create = function(data_path, data_key, cs_behaviour)
		return local_class(data_path, data_key, cs_behaviour)
	end
}

local local_class = newclass('ShadowClone')

--- 생성자
--- @param data_path string 해당 기믹이 사용할 Data의 경로.
--- @param data_key string 해당 기믹이 사용할 Data의 Key.
--- @param cs_behaviour any 해당 기믹의 C# Behaviour.
function local_class:init(data_path, data_key, cs_behaviour)
	self.cs_behaviour = cs_behaviour

	-- 기믹 데이터
	data_key = lua_helper.get_or_default(data_key, 'default')
	if data_key == '' then
		data_key = 'default'
	end

	self.data = load_util.load_lua_gimmick_data(data_path, data_key)

	self.state = {
		deactivate = {},

		idle = {
			enter = self.enter_idle_state,
			update = self.update_idle_state,
		},

		-- 밀리는 상태
		pushing = {
			update = self.update_pushing_state,
			exit = self.exit_pushing_state
		},

		-- 소멸 되는 상태
		remove = {
			enter = self.enter_remove_state,
		},
	}

	self.current_state = self.state.deactivate

	self.arrow_radius = 0.75

	self.shadow_manager = nil

	self.clone_id = 999

	-- 푸쉬 상태
	self.push_state = {
		stopped = 1,
		pushing = 2,
		move_remain_distance = 3
	}

	--일차별 지속시간 데이터
	self.day_duration_table = {
		'day1_life_time',
		'day2_life_time',
		'day3_life_time'
	}

	self.time_passed = 0

	-- 현재 푸쉬 상태
	self.current_push_state = nil

	-- 푸쉬에 사용되는 변수
	self.pushed_direction = nil
	self.target_pos = nil

	-- 해당 오브젝트를 미는 fo
	self.pusher = nil

	--방향 표시기 fx
	self.fx_shadow = nil
	self.shadow_sfx = nil
	self.fx_arrow = nil

	--shadow 클론 이펙트
	self.fx_shadow_loop = nil

	self.spawn_camera_grid = nil

	self.is_screen_play = false
end

-- IFO에 붙었을 때
function local_class:attach_to(fo)
	self.fo = fo

	self.cs_behaviour:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.StageStartEvent))
	self.cs_behaviour:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.ScreenPlayEnterEvent))
	self.cs_behaviour:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.ScreenPlayExitEvent))

	-- 푸쉬 상태 초기화
	self.current_push_state = self.push_state.stopped
	self.pushed_direction = CS.Oak.Direction.None

	-- 리셋을 위한 초기값
	self.default_pos = self.fo.Position

	-- 기본 상태로 변경
	self.cs_behaviour:ChangeState(CS.Oak.FieldObjectIdleState.Instance)

	self:change_state(self.state.remove)
end

-- IFO에서 떨어졌을 때
function local_class:detach_from(fo)
end

--- LuaMessageSystem(message_system)을 이용하여 콜백을 등록하였을 경우 이 곳에서 해제하여야 한다.
--- detach_from의 경우 LuaMessageSystem이 이미 날아간 상태이기 때문에 Leak발생함.
function local_class:dispose()
	self.cs_behaviour:UnSubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.StageStartEvent))
	self.cs_behaviour:UnSubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.ScreenPlayEnterEvent))
	self.cs_behaviour:UnSubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.ScreenPlayExitEvent))

	if self.fx_arrow ~= nil then
		self.fx_arrow:Dispose()

		self.fx_arrow = nil
	end

	self.fo = nil
	self.cs_behaviour = nil
end

-- 현재 IFO가 취하고 있는 액션
function local_class:current_action()
	if lua_helper.type_compare(self.cs_behaviour.CurrentState, CS.Oak.FieldObjectMoveState) or
			self.current_push_state == self.push_state.pushing or
			self.current_push_state == self.push_state.move_remain_distance then

		return CS.Oak.FieldObjectAction.Moving
	end

	return CS.Oak.FieldObjectAction.Stopped
end

--region event
-- 이벤트 호출
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.StageStartEvent) then
		self.shadow_manager = get_stage_event_controller('ClevatessShadowCloneController')
	end

	if not self:is_activate() then
		return
	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.GetPushedStartEvent) then
		self.pusher = e.Pusher

		if self.current_push_state == self.push_state.move_remain_distance then
			return true
		end

		self.pushed_direction = e.Pusher.Direction

		local target_dist = 1
		local direction = direction_util.to_4way_vector3(self.pushed_direction)

		self.target_pos = self.fo.Position + direction * target_dist

		self.current_push_state = self.push_state.pushing
		self.fo.Pushable:StartPushedBy(e.Pusher)

		self.shadow_manager:set_all_shadow_fx_arrow(false)

		self:change_state(self.state.pushing)

		return true
	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.PushMoveStartEvent) then
		if self.current_push_state == self.push_state.move_remain_distance then
			return true
		end

		-- sfx 처리
		music_player_util.play_sfx({
			sfx_name = '01_push_snowball_01',
			parent = self.fo,
			type_priority = sfx_type_priority.gimmick,
			player_priority = sfx_player_priority.object
		})

		return true
	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.GetPushedEndEvent) then
		if self.current_push_state == self.push_state.move_remain_distance then
			return true
		end

		self.fo.Pushable:EndPushedBy(e.Pusher)
		self:check_remain_distance(self.pushed_direction)

		return true
	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.PushBlockedEvent) then
		self.current_push_state = self.push_state.stopped
		return true
	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.MoveBlockedEvent) then
		self.current_push_state = self.push_state.stopped
		return true
	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ScreenPlayEnterEvent) then
		self.is_screen_play = true
		self.arrow_renderer.enabled = false
		return true
	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ScreenPlayExitEvent) then
		self.is_screen_play = false
		self.arrow_renderer.enabled = true
		return true
	end

	return false
end
--endregion

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if not self:is_activate() then
		return
	end

	if self.current_state.update then
		self.current_state.update(self, dt)
	end
end

--region 기본 상태 체크
function local_class:enter_idle_state()
end

function local_class:update_idle_state(dt)
	if self.is_screen_play then
		return
	end

	--방향지시기 update
	do
		-- 타겟 위치 가져오기
		local target_position = self.fo.Position

		-- 기준점(원의 중심) 위치 - 보통 캐릭터의 위치
		local center_position = get_party_leader().Position

		-- 방향 벡터 계산 (target 위치 - 중심 위치)
		local direction = target_position - center_position

		-- 방향 벡터 정규화 (길이가 1인 단위 벡터로 변환)
		local normalized_direction = unity_class.vector3.Normalize(direction)

		-- 원의 반지름 (self.arrow_radius 값을 사용)
		local radius = self.arrow_radius

		-- 화살표의 새 위치 계산 (중심점 + 방향 * 반지름)
		local new_arrow_position = normalized_direction * radius

		-- fx_arrow 위치 업데이트
		self.fx_arrow.transform.localPosition = center_position + new_arrow_position + vector(0, 0.5, 0)

		-- 방향 벡터의 각도 계산 (Unity의 2D 좌표계에서 y축 회전)
		-- X와 Z 좌표를 사용하여 Y축 회전 계산
		local angle = unity_class.mathf.Atan2(direction.x, direction.z) * 180 / unity_class.mathf.PI

		-- 화살표가 기본적으로 아래를 향하고 있으므로 180도 추가 회전
		-- (기본 화살표 방향이 아래쪽을 향하고 있기 때문)
		angle = angle + 180

		-- fx_arrow의 회전 설정 (y축을 중심으로 회전)
		local rotation = CS.UnityEngine.Quaternion.Euler(0, 0, -angle)
		self.fx_arrow.transform.localRotation = rotation
	end

	--카메라 그리드 체크
	do
		if self.spawn_camera_grid ~= nil then

			if not self.spawn_camera_grid:Contains(self.fo.Position) then
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_klen_myth_attack_01')

				self:change_state(self.state.remove)

				self.shadow_manager:disabled_clone_data(self.fo.Name)

			end
		end
	end
end
--endregion

--region 밀리는 상태
--- 밀리는 상태 업데이트
function local_class:update_pushing_state(_)
	if self.current_push_state == self.push_state.stopped then
		self.shadow_manager:set_all_shadow_fx_arrow(true)

		self:change_state(self.state.idle)
	end
end
--endregion

--region 소멸 상태
function local_class:enter_remove_state()
	if self.fo.ActiveState == active_state('enabled') then
		if self.shadow_manager ~= nil then
			self.shadow_manager.fx.explosion():Instantiate(self.fo.Position)
		end
		field_object_util.set_active_state(self.fo, active_state_type.disabled)
	end

	if self.fx_arrow ~= nil then
		self.arrow_renderer.enabled = false
	end

	self:change_state(self.state.deactivate)
end
--endregion

--- 상태 변경
function local_class:change_state(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.current_state
	if prev_state.exit then
		prev_state.exit(self, new_state)
	end

	self.current_state = new_state

	if new_state.enter then
		new_state.enter(self, prev_state)
	end
end

--- 남은 유닛 단위 이동 거리 검사
function local_class:check_remain_distance(direction)
	local diff = 0

	local dir_vector = direction_util.to_vector3_ver2(direction)
	if direction_util.is_side(direction) then
		diff = (self.target_pos.x - self.fo.Position.x) * dir_vector.x
	else
		diff = (self.target_pos.z - self.fo.Position.z) * dir_vector.z
	end

	if diff > 0 then
		start_coroutine(self.move_remain_distance, self, direction)
	else
		self.current_push_state = self.push_state.stopped
	end
end

--- 유닛 단위 이동에 부족한 거리만큼 추가로 움직임
function local_class:move_remain_distance(dir)
	self.current_push_state = self.push_state.move_remain_distance

	local remain_dist = 0
	local speed = CS.Oak.Constants.UnitPushSpeed

	if vector_util.get_x0z(self.target_pos - self.fo.Position).magnitude > 2 then
		speed = CS.Oak.Constants.UnitPushSpeed * 3
	end

	repeat
		local diff = 0
		if self.current_push_state ~= self.push_state.move_remain_distance then
			break
		end

		if direction_util.is_side(dir) then
			diff = self.fo.Position.x - self.target_pos.x
		else
			diff = self.fo.Position.z - self.target_pos.z
		end

		remain_dist = math.abs(diff)

		local moving_dist = speed * unity_class.time.deltaTime

		CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameStageLogic.ExecutePush(self.fo, direction_util.to_vector3_ver2(dir), math.min(remain_dist, moving_dist))

		coroutine.yield(nil)

	until float_util.is_almost_zero(remain_dist)

	self.current_push_state = self.push_state.stopped
end

function local_class:is_activate()
	return self.current_state ~= self.state.deactivate
end

function local_class:is_idle_state()
	return self.current_state == self.state.idle
end

function local_class:enter_casting(spawner_pos, spawn_pos_offset, casting_duration)
	self.casting_end_pos = spawner_pos + spawn_pos_offset

	self.fx_shadow = self.shadow_manager.fx.klen_shadow():Instantiate(self.casting_end_pos)

	self.casting_duration = casting_duration

	self.fx_shadow.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.zero
end

function local_class:update_casting(time_passed)
	local progress = time_passed / self.casting_duration
	local scale_facter = 0.76

	self.fx_shadow.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(unity_class.vector3.zero, unity_class.vector3.one * scale_facter, progress)
	self.shadow_current_scale = self.fx_shadow.transform.localScale
end

function local_class:dispose_casting(time_passed, dispose_duration)
	local progress = time_passed / dispose_duration

	self.fx_shadow.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(self.shadow_current_scale, unity_class.vector3.zero, progress)
end

function local_class:exit_casting()
	self.fx_shadow:Dispose()
end

function local_class:active(shadow_lv, sprite_name)
	start_coroutine(function()
		if shadow_lv > 1 then
			self.shadow_manager:set_button_active_state(true)
		else
			self.shadow_manager:set_button_active_state(false)
		end

		self.shadow_manager.fx.explosion():Instantiate(self.casting_end_pos)
		self.fo.Position = self.casting_end_pos
		self.fo.Pushable = CS.Oak.UnitPushable()

		if self.fx_arrow == nil then
			self.fx_arrow = self.shadow_manager:create_arrow_sprite(sprite_name)
		end

		self.fx_arrow.gameObject:SetActive(true)

		if self.fx_shadow_loop == nil then
			self:get_or_create_loop_fx()
		end

		self.arrow_renderer = self.fx_arrow.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Renderer))
		self.arrow_renderer.enabled = true

		self.spawn_camera_grid = field_util.get_camera_grid_contains_point(self.fo.Position)


		local spine_controller = self.fo.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.SpineController))

		spine_controller.Direction = direction_util.to_side_dir(get_party_leader().Direction)

		field_object_util.set_active_state(self.fo, active_state_type.enabled)

		self.shadow_manager:set_shadow_clone_manager(self.fo.Name)

		self:change_state(self.state.idle)
	end)
end

function local_class:get_or_create_loop_fx()
	local prefix = 'fx_loop_' .. self.fo.Name

	self.fx_shadow_loop = self.shadow_manager.fx[prefix]():Instantiate(self.fo.Position, unity_class.quaternion.identity, self.fo.Transform)
end

function local_class:dispose_loop_fx()
	self.fx_shadow_loop:Dispose()
end

return {
	create = function(data_path, data_key, cs_behaviour)
		return local_class(data_path, data_key, cs_behaviour)
	end
}

-- 현재 IFO가 취하고 있는 액션
function local_class:current_action()
end

--region event
-- 이벤트 호출
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.StageStartEvent) then
		self.shadow_manager = get_stage_event_controller('ClevatessShadowCloneController')
		self.shadow_manager:set_spawner_table(self.fo)

		local renderer = self.fo:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.MeshRenderer))
		renderer.enabled = false

		self:check_activate()

		if get_field_object(self.first_clone_handle_name) == nil or get_field_object(self.second_clone_handle_name) == nil then
			logger_util.log('Error Not Find Shadow Clone')
		end
	end

	if not self:is_activate() then
		return false
	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.GotCrashedEvent) and self.current_state == self.state.idle and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Crasher, get_party_leader()) and
			not self.shadow_manager:is_spawner_in_shadow_clone(self.shadow_searching_bounds) then
		self:change_state(self.state.casting)
	end
	return false
end
--endregion

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if not self:is_activate() then
		return
	end

	if self.current_state.update then
		self.current_state.update(self, dt)
	end
end

--region 스포너 관련
--- 클론 생성할 때
function local_class:enter_spawn_state()
	self:set_clear_shadow_clone_flag(false)

	local is_activate_clone = self.shadow_manager:reset_shadow_clone(self.fo)

	if not is_activate_clone then
		self:set_clear_shadow_clone_flag(true)
	end
end

function local_class:update_spawn_state()
	if self.is_clear_shadow_clone then
		self:create_clone(self.spawn_lv)

		self:change_state(self.state.wait)
	end
end

function local_class:set_clear_shadow_clone_flag(boolean)
	self.is_clear_shadow_clone = boolean
end

--- 클론 생성 완료
function local_class:exit_spawn_state()
	self.cs_behaviour:UnSubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.GotCrashedEvent))
end
--endregion

--region 캐스팅 관련 함수
function local_class:enter_casting_state()
	self.time_passed = 0

	self.is_in_player = true

	self:activate_shadow_casting()

	start_coroutine(self.casting, self)
end

function local_class:update_casting_state(dt)
	local is_enter_player = false

	local bounds_list = CS.Oak.LuaCollisionUtil.GetFieldObjectsCollidedBy(self.searching_bounds, unity_class.vector3.zero)

	for _, fo in pairs(bounds_list) do
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(fo, get_party_leader()) then
			is_enter_player = true
		end
	end

	if is_enter_player then
		self.is_in_player = true
	else
		self.is_in_player = false
	end
end

function local_class:exit_casting_state()
	if self.casting_table ~= nil then
		for _, lua_table in pairs(self.casting_table) do
			lua_table:exit_casting()
		end
	end
end
--endregion

--region 대기 관련
function local_class:enter_wait_state()
	self.time_passed = 0

	self.is_in_player = true
end

function local_class:update_wait_state(dt)
	local is_enter_player = false
	local bounds_list = CS.Oak.LuaCollisionUtil.GetFieldObjectsCollidedBy(self.searching_bounds, unity_class.vector3.zero)

	for _, fo in pairs(bounds_list) do
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(fo, get_party_leader()) then
			is_enter_player = true
		end
	end

	if not is_enter_player then
		local time_passed = 0
		is_enter_player = false

		while time_passed < self.data.respawn_active_duration do
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		end

		bounds_list = CS.Oak.LuaCollisionUtil.GetFieldObjectsCollidedBy(self.searching_bounds, unity_class.vector3.zero)

		for _, fo in pairs(bounds_list) do
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(fo, get_party_leader()) then
				is_enter_player = true
			end
		end

		if not is_enter_player then
			self:change_state(self.state.idle)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:exit_wait_state()
	local time_passed = 0

	while time_passed < self.data.respawn_active_duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
	end

	self.cs_behaviour:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.GotCrashedEvent))
end
--endregion

--- 활성화 되어 있는지
function local_class:is_activate()
	return self.current_state ~= self.state.deactivate
end

function local_class:check_activate()
	if self.spawn_lv > 0 then
		self:change_state(self.state.idle)
	else
		self:change_state(self.state.deactivate)
	end
end

--- 상태 변경
function local_class:change_state(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.current_state
	if prev_state.exit then
		prev_state.exit(self, new_state)
	end

	self.current_state = new_state

	self.current_state.time_passed = 0

	if new_state.enter then
		new_state.enter(self, prev_state)
	end
end

--플레이어가 영역안에 들어와서 duration 동안 캐스팅 함수
function local_class:casting()
	while self.create_duration > self.time_passed and self.is_in_player do
		self.time_passed = self.time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		if self.casting_table ~= nil then
			for _, lua_table in pairs(self.casting_table) do
				lua_table:update_casting(self.time_passed)
			end
		end

		coroutine.yield()
	end

	if self.is_in_player then
		self:change_state(self.state.spawn)
	else
		local time_passed = 0
		local dispose_duration = 0.2
		while dispose_duration > time_passed do
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

			if self.casting_table ~= nil then
				for _, lua_table in pairs(self.casting_table) do
					lua_table:dispose_casting(time_passed, dispose_duration)
				end
			end

			coroutine.yield()
		end

		self:change_state(self.state.idle)
	end
end

--그림자 분신 생성 함수
function local_class:create_clone(lv)
	local spawn_count = self.data.spawn_count_table[lv]

	local function set_clone(name, arrow_sprite_name)
		local fo = get_field_object(name)
		local lua_table = fo.FieldObjectBehaviour:GetLuaTable()

		lua_table:active(self.spawn_lv, arrow_sprite_name)
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_klen_cwp_ready_01')
	if spawn_count > 1 then
		set_clone(self.first_clone_handle_name, self.first_arrow_sprite_name)
		set_clone(self.second_clone_handle_name, self.second_arrow_sprite_name)
	else
		set_clone(self.first_clone_handle_name, self.first_arrow_sprite_name)
	end
end

function local_class:activate_shadow_casting()
	local spawn_count = self.data.spawn_count_table[self.spawn_lv]
	local spawn_direction = {
		self.first_shadow_direction,
		self.second_shadow_direction
	}
	local function enter_casting(name, spawn_dir)
		local fo = get_field_object(name)
		local lua_table = fo.FieldObjectBehaviour:GetLuaTable()

		lua_table:enter_casting(self.fo.Position, self.direction_pos_data[spawn_dir], self.create_duration)

		table.insert(self.casting_table, lua_table)
	end

	self.casting_table = {}

	if spawn_count > 1 then
		enter_casting(self.first_clone_handle_name, spawn_direction[1])
		enter_casting(self.second_clone_handle_name, spawn_direction[2])
	else
		enter_casting(self.first_clone_handle_name, spawn_direction[1])
	end
end

function local_class:check_enter_camera_gird(camera_gird)
	if camera_gird == nil then
		return
	end

	if not self:is_activate() and camera_gird:Contains(self.fo.Position) and self.spawn_lv > 0 then
		self:change_state(self.state.idle)
	end
end

function local_class:check_leave_camera_gird(camera_gird)
	if camera_gird == nil then
		return
	end

	if self:is_activate() and camera_gird:Contains(self.fo.Position) then
		self:change_state(self.state.deactivate)
	end
end

return {
	create = function(data_path, data_key, cs_behaviour)
		return local_class(data_path, data_key, cs_behaviour)
	end
}

--- 생성자
--- @param data_path string 해당 기믹이 사용할 Data의 경로.
--- @param data_key string 해당 기믹이 사용할 Data의 Key.
--- @param cs_behaviour any 해당 기믹의 C# Behaviour.

	end

	 self.data = load_util.load_lua_gimmick_data(data_path, data_key)

	self.is_held = false

	self.default_pos = unity_class.vector3.zero

	self.reset_switch_names = lua_helper.get_or_default(self.data.reset_switch_names, { 'resetSwitch' })
end

-- IFO에 붙었을 때
function local_class:attach_to(fo)
	self.fo = fo

	self.default_pos = self.fo.Position

	self.cs_behaviour:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.ResetSwitchTurnedOnEvent))
end

-- IFO에서 떨어졌을 때
function local_class:detach_from(fo)
end

--- LuaMessageSystem(message_system)을 이용하여 콜백을 등록하였을 경우 이 곳에서 해제하여야 한다.
--- detach_from의 경우 LuaMessageSystem이 이미 날아간 상태이기 때문에 Leak발생함.
function local_class:dispose()
	self.cs_behaviour:UnSubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.ResetSwitchTurnedOnEvent))

	self.fo = nil
	self.cs_behaviour = nil
end

-- 현재 기본 스테이트 얻기(아이들, 걷기 등 전신 및 하체 상태)
function local_class:current_state()
	return nil
end

-- 현재 IFO가 취하고 있는 액션
function local_class:current_action()
	local current_state = self.cs_behaviour.CurrentState

	if lua_helper.type_compare(current_state, CS.Oak.FieldObjectThrownState) then
		if current_state.DidLandOnFloor then
			return CS.Oak.FieldObjectAction.ImpactMoving
		else
			return CS.Oak.FieldObjectAction.Flying
		end
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(current_state, CS.Oak.FieldObjectHeldUpState) then
		return CS.Oak.FieldObjectAction.Held
	end

	return CS.Oak.FieldObjectAction.Stopped
end

--region event
-- 이벤트 호출
function local_class:on_event(e)
	local consumed = CS.Oak.LuaScriptQuestUtil.CastToEventListenerAndSendSync(self.cs_behaviour.CurrentState, e, false)

	if consumed then
		return true
	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.HoldUpEvent) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.fo) then
			self.is_held = true
			self.cs_behaviour:ChangeState(CS.Oak.FieldObjectHeldUpState.Create(self.fo, e.Holder))
		end

		return true
	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.GetThrownEvent) then
		self.is_held = false
		self.cs_behaviour:ChangeState(CS.Oak.FieldObjectThrownState.Create(e.ThrowInfo))
		return true
	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.GetThrownEndEvent) then
		self.cs_behaviour:ChangeState(CS.Oak.FieldObjectIdleState.Instance)
		return true
	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ResetSwitchTurnedOnEvent) then
		for i = 1, #self.reset_switch_names do
			if e.SwitchObject.Name == self.reset_switch_names[i] then
				self:reset_object()
			end
		end
		return true
	end

	return false
end
--endregion

function local_class:update_frame(_)
	if self.is_held and self.fo.Direction ~= get_party_leader().Direction then
		self.fo.Direction = get_party_leader().Direction
		self:refresh_direction()
	end
end

--- 기믹 방향 갱신
function local_class:refresh_direction()
	local y_angle

	if self.fo.Direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Down then
		y_angle = 0
	elseif self.fo.Direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Left then
		y_angle = 90
	elseif self.fo.Direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Up then
		y_angle = 180
	elseif self.fo.Direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Right then
		y_angle = 270
	end

	self.fo.Transform.localEulerAngles = vector_util.get_x0z(self.fo.Transform.localEulerAngles, y_angle)
end

function local_class:reset_object()
	if self.is_held then
		self.is_held = false

		local holder = self.fo.Holdable.Holder
		self.fo.Holdable:GetThrownBy(holder)

		message_system:SendSync(self.fo, CS.Oak.GetThrownEndEvent.Instance)
		message_system:SendSync(holder, CS.Oak.ReleaseHoldingObjectEvent.Create(holder))

	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(self.cs_behaviour.CurrentState, CS.Oak.FieldObjectThrownState) then
		message_system:SendSync(self.fo, CS.Oak.GetThrownEndEvent.Instance)
	end

	do
		local effect_pool = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_reset_object')

		if (self.fo.ActiveState & active_state('visible')) ~= active_state('disabled') then
			effect_pool:Instantiate(self.fo.Position)
		end

		effect_pool:Instantiate(self.default_pos)
	end

	self.fo.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
	self.fo.Position = self.default_pos
end

return {
	create = function(data_path, data_key, cs_behaviour)
		return local_class(data_path, data_key, cs_behaviour)
	end
}

	self.cs_behaviour = nil
end

-- 현재 기본 스테이트 얻기(아이들, 걷기 등 전신 및 하체 상태)
function local_class:current_state()

end

end

--region event

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if self.current_statue_state ~= self.statue_state.rotation and lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		self:change_state(self.statue_state.rotation)
		return true
	end

	return false
end
--endregion

function local_class:update_frame(dt)

		self.current_statue_state.update(self, dt)
	end
end

--- 기믹 방향 갱신
function local_class:refresh_direction()
	local y_angle = self.fo_mesh_transform.eulerAngles.y

	if float_util.is_almost_zero(y_angle) then
		self.fo.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Down
	elseif float_util.almost_close_to(y_angle, 45) then
		self.fo.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.DownLeft
	elseif float_util.almost_close_to(y_angle, 90) then
		self.fo.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Left
	elseif float_util.almost_close_to(y_angle, 135) then
		self.fo.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.UpLeft
	elseif float_util.almost_close_to(y_angle, 180) then
		self.fo.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Up
	elseif float_util.almost_close_to(y_angle, -135) or float_util.almost_close_to(y_angle, 225) then
		self.fo.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.UpRight
	elseif float_util.almost_close_to(y_angle, -90) or float_util.almost_close_to(y_angle, 270) then
		self.fo.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Right
	elseif float_util.almost_close_to(y_angle, -45) or float_util.almost_close_to(y_angle, 315) then
		self.fo.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.DownRight
	end
end

--region 기본 상태
--- 기본 상태 진입할 때
function local_class:enter_idle_state()
	self:refresh_direction()
end
--endregion

--region 회전 상태
--- 회전 상태 진입할 때
function local_class:enter_rotation_state()
	self.current_statue_state.start_angle = self.fo_mesh_transform.eulerAngles.y
	self.current_statue_state.end_angle = self.fo_mesh_transform.eulerAngles.y + 45

	music_player_util.play_sfx({
		sfx_name = '01_push_rock_unit_01',
		parent = self.fo,
		type_priority = sfx_type_priority.gimmick,
		player_priority = sfx_player_priority.object
	})
end

--- 회전 상태 나갈 때
function local_class:exit_rotation_state()
end

--- 회전 상태 업데이트
function local_class:update_rotation_state(dt)
	self.current_statue_state.time_passed = self.current_statue_state.time_passed + dt

	local start_angle = self.current_statue_state.start_angle
	local end_angle = self.current_statue_state.end_angle
	local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(self.current_statue_state.time_passed / self.rotation_duration)

	local cur_y = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(start_angle, end_angle, progress)

	if self.current_statue_state.time_passed > self.rotation_duration then
		self.fo_mesh_transform.eulerAngles = vector_util.get_x0z(self.fo_mesh_transform.eulerAngles, end_angle)
		self:change_state(self.statue_state.idle)
	else
		self.fo_mesh_transform.eulerAngles = vector_util.get_x0z(self.fo_mesh_transform.eulerAngles, cur_y)
	end
end
--endregion

--- 상태 변경
function local_class:change_state(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.current_statue_state
	if prev_state.exit then
		prev_state.exit(self, new_state)
	end

	self.current_statue_state = new_state

	self.current_statue_state.time_passed = 0

	if new_state.enter then
		new_state.enter(self, prev_state)
	end
end

return {
	create = function(data_path, data_key, cs_behaviour)
		return local_class(data_path, data_key, cs_behaviour)
	end
}

	self.item_popup_sfx_handle_name = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'item_popup_sfx_handle_name', '03_treasure_item_popup_01')

	---@param open_anim_key string 오픈 애니메이션 키
	self.open_anim_key = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'open_anim_key', 'open')

	---@param close_anim_key string 클로즈 애니메이션 키
	self.close_anim_key = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'close_anim_key', 'close')

	--오픈 여부
	self.is_open = false

	self.item = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'item', nil)

	self.chest_animator = nil
end

-- IFO에 붙었을 때
function local_class:attach_to(fo)
	self.fo = fo

	self.is_open = self.open_on_start or self:check_quest_condition(self.quest_id, self.cleared_open, self.target_quest_progress)

	self.chest_animator = self.fo:GetComponentInChildren(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))

	--즉시 오픈
	if self.is_open then
		self.fo.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance

		self:open(true)
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TreasureOpenEvent), 'on_treasure_open_event')
end

-- IFO에서 떨어졌을 때
function local_class:detach_from(fo)
	self.chest_animator = nil
end

function local_class:unsubscribe_events()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TreasureOpenEvent))
end

--- LuaMessageSystem(message_system)을 이용하여 콜백을 등록하였을 경우 이 곳에서 해제하여야 한다.
--- detach_from의 경우 LuaMessageSystem이 이미 날아간 상태이기 때문에 Leak발생함.
function local_class:dispose()
	self:unsubscribe_events()

	self.fo = nil
	self.cs_behaviour = nil
end

-- 현재 기본 스테이트 얻기(아이들, 걷기 등 전신 및 하체 상태)
function local_class:current_state()
	return nil
end

-- 현재 IFO가 취하고 있는 액션
function local_class:current_action()
	return CS.Oak.FieldObjectAction.None
end

--region event
-- 이벤트 호출
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if not self.is_open then
		self.is_open = true
		start_coroutine(self.treasure_open_chest, self, e.Interactor, self.open_type)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_treasure_open_event(e)
	if not self.is_open and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.TreasureName, self.fo.Name) then
		self.is_open = true
		start_coroutine(self.treasure_open_chest, self, e.Opener, e.TreasureOpenType)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

--endregion

function local_class:treasure_open_chest(character, open_type)
	if open_type == treasure_open_type.none then
		self:normal_open(character)
	end
end

---@param fo IFieldObject 인터렉터
function local_class:normal_open(fo)
	local player_open = false

	--플레이어가 열었는가
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(fo, get_party_leader()) then
		player_open = true
	end

	--플레이어가 연다면 컨트롤 뺐음.
	if player_open then
		sp_util.enter_scene()
	end

	self:open_routine(player_open, fo)

	--플레이어가 연다면 컨트롤 복구
	if player_open then
		sp_util.exit_scene(nil, get_party_leader())
	end
end

function local_class:open_routine(player_open, character)
	self.fo.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance

	local diff = self.fo.Bounds.center - character.Position

	character_util.spine_deviate_local(character, diff.normalized * 0.3, 0.12, 0.15)
	character_util.set_anim(character, { name = 'bomb_attack', loop = false })

	wait_for_sec(0.09)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot(self.hit_sfx_handle_name)

	field_object_util.shake(self.fo, 0.03, 10)

	--내가 상자를 열 경우에는 카메라 연출을 해준다.
	if player_open then
		local duration = 1
		local camera_pos = self.fo.Bounds.center
		camera_pos.y = camera_pos.y - self.fo.Bounds.extents.y

		camera_util.resize_by_ratio(3.75, 1)
		camera_util.move_async(camera_pos, duration)
	end

	--drop item
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.TreasureOpenedEvent.Create(character, self.fo))

	--보물 상자 오픈 SFX Play
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot(self.open_treasure_sfx_handle_name)

	--상자 오픈
	self:open(false)

	wait_for_sec(0.15)

	field_object_util.stop_shake(self.fo)

	wait_for_sec(0.09)

	character_util.remove_anim(character)

	wait_for_sec(0.25)

	scene_util.set_direction_by_args(character, {
		look_target = self.fo.Bounds.center,
		look_mode = 'side',
		sfx = false
	})

	character_util.set_emotion(character, { name = 'smile' })
	character_util.set_anim(character, { name = 'victory_extra' })

	wait_for_sec(1)

	self:drop_item(character)

	--finish
	field_object_util.stop_shake(self.fo)

	if player_open then
		camera_util.resize_to_default(0.2)
		camera_util.return_to_leader(0.2)
	end

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(character)

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.TreasureOpenScreenPlayEndEvent.Create(character, self.fo))
end

--아이템 드랍
function local_class:drop_item(character)
	if self.item == nil then
		return
	end

	stage.DropManager.HideLooter = true

	local drop_end_base_pos = vector_util.get_0yz(self.fo.Bounds.min, self.fo.Bounds.center.x) +
			unity_class.vector3.back * 0.2

	local item_data = game_data_service.GetData('ItemData')

	for _, info in pairs(self.item) do
		local item_id = item_data:GetSpec(info.name).Id
		local offset = vector(info.drop_offset.x, info.drop_offset.y, info.drop_offset.z)

		local item = quest_drop_item_util.create_item({
			item_id = item_id,
			pos = self.fo.Bounds.center,
			target = drop_end_base_pos + offset,
		})

		item.ConsumeTarget = character

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot(self.item_popup_sfx_handle_name)

		camera_util.shake(0.06, 0.2)

		wait_for_sec(0.5)
	end

	wait_for_sec(1)

	stage.DropManager.HideLooter = false
end

function local_class:check_quest_condition(quest_id, cleared_open, target_quest_progress)
	local quest_progress = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(quest_id)

	if quest_progress == nil then
		return false
	end

	if cleared_open then
		return quest_progress.IsComplete
	end

	return quest_progress.InnerProgress >= target_quest_progress
end

--상자 여는 애니메이션 연출
---@param immediate boolean 즉시 여는지
function local_class:open(immediate)
	immediate = lua_helper.get_or_default(immediate, false)

	if immediate then
		self:play(self.open_anim_key, false, -1, 1)
		CS.Oak.AnimatorExtensions.SwitchCullMode(self.chest_animator, self.fo)
	else
		self:play(self.open_anim_key)
	end
end

--상자 닫는 애니메이션 연출
---@param immediate boolean 즉시 닫는지
function local_class:close(immediate)
	immediate = lua_helper.get_or_default(immediate, false)

	if immediate then
		self:play(self.close_anim_key, false, -1, 1)
		CS.Oak.AnimatorExtensions.SwitchCullMode(self.chest_animator, self.fo)
	else
		self:play(self.close_anim_key)
	end
end

---@param key string 애니메이션 키
---@param is_async boolean async 대기
---@param layer number 레이어
---@param normalized_time number
function local_class:play(key, is_async, layer, normalized_time)
	is_async = lua_helper.get_or_default(is_async, false)
	layer = lua_helper.get_or_default(layer, -1)
	normalized_time = lua_helper.get_or_default(normalized_time, 0)

	if self.chest_animator == nil then
		return
	end

	self.chest_animator:Play(key, layer, normalized_time)

	if is_async then
		while not self.chest_animator:GetCurrentAnimatorStateInfo(0):IsName(key) do
			coroutine.yield()
		end

		local length = self.chest_animator:GetCurrentAnimatorStateInfo(0).length
		wait_for_sec(length)
	end
end

return {
	create = function(data_path, data_key, cs_behaviour)
		return local_class(data_path, data_key, cs_behaviour)
	end
}

local local_class = newclass('WaterControlSwitch')

--- 생성자
--- @param data_path string 해당 기믹이 사용할 Data의 경로.
--- @param data_key string 해당 기믹이 사용할 Data의 Key.
--- @param cs_behaviour any 해당 기믹의 C# Behaviour.
function local_class:init(data_path, data_key, cs_behaviour)
	self.cs_behaviour = cs_behaviour

	-- 기믹 데이터
	-- self.data = load_util.load_lua_gimmick_data(data_path, data_key)

	self.switch_state = {
		-- 물이 찬 상태
		fill = 1,
		-- 물이 빠진 상태
		empty = 2
	}

	self.current_switch_state = self.switch_state.empty

	-- 물이 찼을 때 던져진 물체들
	self.throw_objs = nil

	self.scene_version = scene_util.default_version

	self.get_fx_hit = function()
		return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit')
	end

	self.get_fx_last_hit = function()
		return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_lasthit')
	end
end

-- IFO에 붙었을 때
function local_class:attach_to(fo)
	self.fo = fo

	self.cs_behaviour:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))

	-- 부표 앞 투명벽
	self.gimmick_buoy_objs = {}

	-- 계단 및 단차 투명벽
	self.gimmick_cliff_objs = {}

	self.animator = self.fo.Transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))
	self.animator.speed = 0.3
	self.animator:Play('off', -1, 1)

	-- 레이어 찾음
	local layers = field.Tilemap:GetComponentsInChildren(typeof(CS.Tilemaps.Layer))
	for i = 0, layers.Length - 1 do
		if layers[i].name == 'water' then
			self.water_layer = layers[i].Transform
		end

		if layers[i].name == 'gimmick_buoy' then
			local layer_transform = layers[i].Transform
			for j = 0, layer_transform.childCount - 1 do
				local wall = layer_transform:GetChild(j):GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObject))
				wall.EntityId = 0
				table.insert(self.gimmick_buoy_objs, wall)
			end
		end

		if layers[i].name == 'gimmick_cliff' then
			local layer_transform = layers[i].Transform
			for j = 0, layer_transform.childCount - 1 do
				local wall = layer_transform:GetChild(j):GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObject))
				wall.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
				wall.EntityId = 0
				wall.EntityGroup = CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Obstacle
				table.insert(self.gimmick_cliff_objs, wall)
			end
		end
	end

	self.get_fx_hit()
	self.get_fx_last_hit()
end

-- IFO에서 떨어졌을 때
function local_class:detach_from(fo)
end

--- LuaMessageSystem(message_system)을 이용하여 콜백을 등록하였을 경우 이 곳에서 해제하여야 한다.
--- detach_from의 경우 LuaMessageSystem이 이미 날아간 상태이기 때문에 Leak발생함.
function local_class:dispose()
	self.cs_behaviour:UnSubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))
	self.cs_behaviour:UnSubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.ThrowEvent))

	self.throw_objs = nil

	self.fo = nil
	self.cs_behaviour = nil
end

-- 현재 기본 스테이트 얻기(아이들, 걷기 등 전신 및 하체 상태)
function local_class:current_state()
	return nil
end

-- 현재 IFO가 취하고 있는 액션
function local_class:current_action()
	return CS.Oak.FieldObjectAction.None
end

--region event
-- 이벤트 호출
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Interactor, get_party_leader()) then
			start_coroutine(self.interact_switch, self, true)
		else
			start_coroutine(self.interact_switch, self, false)
		end

		return true
	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent) and not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Sender, self.fo) then
		if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'fill_water' then
			self.current_switch_state = self.switch_state.fill
			self.throw_objs = {}
			self.animator:Play('on')
			return true
		end

		if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'empty_water' then
			self.current_switch_state = self.switch_state.empty
			self.cs_behaviour:UnSubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.ThrowEvent))
			self.animator:Play('off')

			if self.water_sfx then
				start_coroutine(function()
					wait_for_sec(0.3)

					music_player_util.fade_out_sfx(self.water_sfx, 1)
					self.water_sfx = nil
				end)
			end
			return true
		end

		return false
	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ThrowEvent) then
		for i = 1, #self.throw_objs do
			local throw_obj = self.throw_objs[i]
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, throw_obj) then
				return true
			end
		end

		table.insert(self.throw_objs, e.Target)
		return true
	end

	return false
end
--endregion

function local_class:update_frame(_)
	-- 물이 찼을 때 holdable 오브젝트가 1층에 못 가도록 함
	if self.current_switch_state == self.switch_state.fill then
		for i = #self.throw_objs, 1, -1 do
			local obj = self.throw_objs[i]
			if obj.Position.y < 0.8 then
				message_system:SendSync(obj.FieldObjectBehaviour, CS.Oak.GimmickResetEvent.Instance)
				table.remove(self.throw_objs, i)
			end
		end
	end
end

--- 스위치 상호 작용
--- 상호 작용 주체가 리더인지
function local_class:interact_switch(is_leader)
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	if is_leader then
		sp_util.enter_scene({ hide_weapon = false })

		scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'attack')
		scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, { name = 'sword_attack', count = 1 })

		local dist = self.fo.Position - leader.Position
		character_util.spine_deviate_local(leader, dist * 0.3, 0.2, 0.3)
		wait_for_sec(0.2)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_switch_button_02')
		self.fo:Shake(0.04, 0.3)

		self.get_fx_hit():Instantiate(self.fo.Position + vector(0, 0.3, 0))
		self.get_fx_last_hit():Instantiate(self.fo.Position + vector(0, 0.3, 0))

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
	end

	-- 수위 조절 연출
	if self.current_switch_state == self.switch_state.empty then
		self.water_layer.position = vector_util.get_x0z(self.water_layer.position, 0.3)

		local moving_buoy = false
		local start_y = self.water_layer.position.y

		self.animator:Play('on')
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.fo, { 'fill_water' }))

		self.water_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_water_loop_03', loop = true })
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_stomp_water_01', fade_in_time = 0.5 })
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_water_float_01' })

		coroutine_util.while_from_to_each_frame(2, start_y, 1.2, function(_, cur_y)
			self.water_layer.position = vector_util.get_x0z(self.water_layer.position, cur_y)

			if cur_y > 0.8 and not moving_buoy then
				moving_buoy = true
				self:fill_water()
			end
		end)

	else
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_stomp_water_01', fade_in_time = 0.5 })

		self:empty_water()

		local start_y = self.water_layer.position.y
		coroutine_util.while_from_to_each_frame(1.5, start_y, 0.3, function(progress, cur_y)
			if progress > 0.3 and self.water_sfx then
				music_player_util.fade_out_sfx(self.water_sfx, 1)
				self.water_sfx = nil
			end

			self.water_layer.position = vector_util.get_x0z(self.water_layer.position, cur_y)
		end)
	end

	if is_leader then
		sp_util.exit_scene(nil, leader)
	end
end

-- 물 채우기
function local_class:fill_water()
	self.current_switch_state = self.switch_state.fill
	self.throw_objs = {}
	self.cs_behaviour:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.ThrowEvent))
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.fo, { 'fill_water_buoy' }))

	for i = 1, #self.gimmick_buoy_objs do
		self.gimmick_buoy_objs[i].ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
	end

	for i = 1, #self.gimmick_cliff_objs do
		self.gimmick_cliff_objs[i].ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
	end
end

-- 물 비우기
function local_class:empty_water()
	self.current_switch_state = self.switch_state.empty
	self.cs_behaviour:UnSubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.ThrowEvent))
	self.animator:Play('off')
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.fo, { 'empty_water' }))

	for i = 1, #self.gimmick_buoy_objs do
		self.gimmick_buoy_objs[i].ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
	end

	for i = 1, #self.gimmick_cliff_objs do
		self.gimmick_cliff_objs[i].ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
	end
end

return {
	create = function(data_path, data_key, cs_behaviour)
		return local_class(data_path, data_key, cs_behaviour)
	end
}

--- 생성자
--- @param data_path string 해당 기믹이 사용할 Data의 경로.
--- @param data_key string 해당 기믹이 사용할 Data의 Key.
--- @param cs_behaviour any 해당 기믹의 C# Behaviour.
function local_class:init(data_path, data_key, cs_behaviour)

	-- 기믹 데이터
	data_key = lua_helper.get_or_default(data_key, 'default')
	if data_key == '' then
		data_key = 'default'
	end

	self.data = load_util.load_lua_gimmick_data(data_path, data_key)

	-- 바람 적용 거리

	return nil
end

-- 현재 IFO가 취하고 있는 액션
function local_class:current_action()
	if lua_helper.type_compare(self.cs_behaviour.CurrentState, CS.Oak.FieldObjectMoveState) or
		self.current_push_state == self.push_state.pushing or
		self.current_push_state == self.push_state.move_remain_distance then

		return CS.Oak.FieldObjectAction.Moving
	end

	return CS.Oak.FieldObjectAction.Stopped

--region event
-- 이벤트 호출
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if not self:is_activate() and self.current_fan_state ~= self.fan_state.rotation and
		lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent) and e.CameraGrid:Contains(self.fo.Position) and
		(lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, get_party_leader()) or lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party)) then
		self:change_state(self.fan_state.idle)
		return true
	end

	if self:is_activate() and self.current_fan_state ~= self.fan_state.rotation and
		lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.CameraGridLeaveEvent) and e.CameraGrid:Contains(self.fo.Position) and
		(lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, get_party_leader()) or lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party)) then
		self:change_state(self.fan_state.deactivate)
		return true
	end

	if self.current_fan_state ~= self.fan_state.rotation and lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		self:change_state(self.fan_state.rotation)
		return true
	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.GetPushedStartEvent) then
		self.pusher = e.Pusher

		if self.current_push_state == self.push_state.move_remain_distance then
			return true
		end

		self.pushed_direction = e.Pusher.Direction

		local target_dist = 1
		local direction = direction_util.to_4way_vector3(self.pushed_direction)

		self.target_pos = self.fo.Position + direction * target_dist

		self.current_push_state = self.push_state.pushing
		self.fo.Pushable:StartPushedBy(e.Pusher)

		self:change_state(self.fan_state.pushing)

		return true
	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.PushMoveStartEvent) then
		if self.current_push_state == self.push_state.move_remain_distance then
			return true
		end

		-- sfx 처리
		music_player_util.play_sfx({
			sfx_name = '01_push_rock_unit_01',
			parent = self.fo,
			type_priority = sfx_type_priority.gimmick,
			player_priority = sfx_player_priority.object
		})

		return true
	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.GetPushedEndEvent) then
		if self.current_push_state == self.push_state.move_remain_distance then
			return true
		end

		self.fo.Pushable:EndPushedBy(e.Pusher)
		self:check_remain_distance(self.pushed_direction)

		return true
	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.PushBlockedEvent) then
		self.current_push_state = self.push_state.stopped
		return true
	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.MoveBlockedEvent) then
		self.current_push_state = self.push_state.stopped
		return true
	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ResetSwitchTurnedOnEvent) then
		for i = 1, #self.reset_switch_names do
			if e.SwitchObject.Name == self.reset_switch_names[i] then
				self:reset_object()
			end
		end
		return true
	end

	return false
end
--endregion

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if not self:is_activate() then
		return
	end

	if self.current_fan_state.update then
		self.current_fan_state.update(self, dt)
	end
end

--- 기믹 방향 갱신
function local_class:refresh_direction()
	local y_angle = self.fo_head_transform.eulerAngles.y

	if float_util.is_almost_zero(y_angle) then
		self.fo.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Down
	elseif float_util.almost_close_to(y_angle, 90) then
		self.fo.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Left
	elseif float_util.almost_close_to(y_angle, 180) then
		self.fo.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Up
	elseif float_util.almost_close_to(y_angle, -90) or float_util.almost_close_to(y_angle, 270) then
		self.fo.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Right
	end
end

--- 바람 영향력 바운드 갱신
function local_class:refresh_searching_bounds()
	local fo_bounds = self.fo.Bounds

	-- 바람 영향력 비율
	local size_ratio = 0.7

	local size
	local pos

	-- 리더 처리 전용
	local leader_size
	local leader_pos
	local leader_size_ratio = 0.5

	if direction_util.is_side_ver2(self.fo.Direction) then
		pos = fo_bounds.center + (fo_bounds.extents.x + self.range * 0.5) * direction_util.to_vector3_ver2(self.fo.Direction)
		size = vector_util.get_0yz(fo_bounds.size * size_ratio, self.range)

		leader_pos = pos - direction_util.to_vector3_ver2(self.fo.Direction) * leader_size_ratio * 0.5
		leader_size = size + unity_class.vector3.left * leader_size_ratio
	else
		pos = fo_bounds.center + (fo_bounds.extents.z + self.range * 0.5) * direction_util.to_vector3_ver2(self.fo.Direction)
		size = vector_util.get_xy0(fo_bounds.size * size_ratio, self.range)

		leader_pos = pos - direction_util.to_vector3_ver2(self.fo.Direction) * leader_size_ratio * 0.5
		leader_size = size + unity_class.vector3.back * leader_size_ratio
	end

	-- 기본 검색 바운드
	self.searching_bounds = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(pos, size)

	-- 초반 리더 검색 바운드 (기본 검색 바운드 보다 좀 작음)
	-- 선풍기 바람에 들어갔다가 밀렸다가 빠르게 반복되는 현상을 막기 위함
	self.leader_searching_bounds = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(leader_pos, leader_size)
end

--region 기본 상태
--- 기본 상태 진입할 때
function local_class:enter_idle_state()
	self.targets = {}

	self:refresh_direction()
	self:refresh_searching_bounds()
end

--- 기본 상태 나갈 때
function local_class:exit_idle_state()
	for i = 1, #self.targets do
		local target = self.targets[i]
		self.wind_fan_manager.remove_target(self.fo, target)
	end

	self.targets = nil
end

--- 기본 상태 업데이트
function local_class:update_idle_state()
	-- 이전에 등록했던 대상
	local prev_targets = self.targets

	local searching_targets = {}

	local leader = get_party_leader()

	-- 방향에 따른 거리 가져오기
	local get_dist = function(target)
		if direction_util.is_side_ver2(self.fo.Direction) then
			return math.abs(self.fo.Position.x - target.Position.x)
		else
			return math.abs(self.fo.Position.z - target.Position.z)
		end
	end

	local obj_list = CS.Oak.LuaCollisionUtil.GetFieldObjectsCollidedBy(
		self.fo.Bounds, direction_util.to_vector3_ver2(self.fo.Direction) * self.range)

	-- 가장 가까운 대상 찾기
	local min_dist = 99999

	for i = 0, obj_list.Count - 1 do
		local obj = obj_list[i]

		-- 자신 제외 및 플레이어가 들고있는 오브젝트 제외
		if not lua_helper.reference_equals(obj, self.fo) and
			not (lua_helper.type_compare(leader.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentActionState, CS.Oak.CharacterHoldUpState)
				and lua_helper.reference_equals(leader.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentActionState.HoldTarget, obj)) then

			local target_dist = get_dist(obj)

			-- 바람에 날아가는 대상 찾기
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(obj, leader) or obj.Holdable.IsHoldable then
				searching_targets[obj] = target_dist

			-- 바람에 날라가지 않는 가장 근접한 대상의 거리 찾기
			elseif target_dist < min_dist and CS.Oak.EntityGroupsExtensions.IsObstacle(obj.EntityGroup) and
				not CS.Oak.ICrashBehaviourExtensions.IsEthereal(obj.CrashBehaviour) then
				min_dist = target_dist
			end
		end
	end

	obj_list:Dispose()

	-- 이전 대상들 우선 조사
	for i = #prev_targets, 1, -1 do
		local target = prev_targets[i]
		-- 사이에 장애물이 있거나 바운드에서 벗어난 대상은 제거 (플레이어가 들고있는 물체도 제거)
		if get_dist(target) > min_dist or not bounds_util.is_overlapping_xz(self.searching_bounds, target.Bounds) or
			(lua_helper.type_compare(leader.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentActionState, CS.Oak.CharacterHoldUpState)
			and lua_helper.reference_equals(leader.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentActionState.HoldTarget, target)) then

			self.wind_fan_manager.remove_target(self.fo, target)
			table.remove(self.targets, i)
		end

		-- 이미 조사한 대상은 제외
		searching_targets[target] = nil
	end

	-- 사이에 장애물에 없고 바운드 안에 있는 대상 조사
	for target, dist in pairs(searching_targets) do
		if dist > min_dist or not bounds_util.is_overlapping_xz(self.searching_bounds, target.Bounds) then
			searching_targets[target] = nil
		else
			table.insert(self.targets, target)

			local wind_info = {
				fan = self.fo,
				wind_level = self.wind_level,
				leader_searching_bounds = self.leader_searching_bounds,
			}

			self.wind_fan_manager.add_target(target, wind_info)
		end
	end
end
--endregion

--region 회전 상태
--- 회전 상태 진입할 때
function local_class:enter_rotation_state()
	self.wind_effect_go:SetActive(false)
	self.current_fan_state.start_angle = self.fo_head_transform.eulerAngles.y
	self.current_fan_state.end_angle = self.fo_head_transform.eulerAngles.y + 90
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.fo, { 'wind_fan_start_rotation' }))

	music_player_util.play_sfx({
		sfx_name = self.wind_sfx,
		parent = self.fo,
		type_priority = sfx_type_priority.gimmick,
		player_priority = sfx_player_priority.object
	})

	if self.sfx_data and unity_class.time.time - self.sfx_data.time < 3 then
		music_player_util.fade_out_sfx(self.sfx_data.sfx, 0.5)
		self.sfx_data = nil
	end
end

--- 회전 상태 나갈 때
function local_class:exit_rotation_state()
	self.wind_effect_go:SetActive(true)
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.fo, { 'wind_fan_end_rotation' }))

	local wind_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
		sfx_name = '01_intro_vent_01',
		parent = self.fo,
		type_priority = sfx_type_priority.gimmick,
		player_priority = sfx_player_priority.object
	})

	self.sfx_data = {
		sfx = wind_sfx,
		time = unity_class.time.time
	}
end

--- 회전 상태 업데이트
function local_class:update_rotation_state(dt)
	self.current_fan_state.time_passed = self.current_fan_state.time_passed + dt

	local start_angle = self.current_fan_state.start_angle
	local end_angle = self.current_fan_state.end_angle
	local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(self.current_fan_state.time_passed / self.rotation_duration)

	local cur_y = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(start_angle, end_angle, progress)

	if self.current_fan_state.time_passed > self.rotation_duration then
		self.fo_head_transform.eulerAngles = vector_util.get_x0z(self.fo_head_transform.eulerAngles, end_angle)

		if field:IsInSameCameraGrid(get_party_leader().Position, self.fo.Position) then
			self:change_state(self.fan_state.idle)
		else
			self:refresh_direction()
			self:refresh_searching_bounds()

			self:change_state(self.fan_state.deactivate)
		end

	else
		self.fo_head_transform.eulerAngles = vector_util.get_x0z(self.fo_head_transform.eulerAngles, cur_y)
	end
end
--endregion

--region 밀리는 상태
--- 밀리는 상태 업데이트
function local_class:update_pushing_state(_)
	if self.current_push_state == self.push_state.stopped then
		self:change_state(self.fan_state.idle)
	end
end
--endregion

--- 상태 변경
function local_class:change_state(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.current_fan_state
	if prev_state.exit then
		prev_state.exit(self, new_state)
	end

	self.current_fan_state = new_state

	self.current_fan_state.time_passed = 0

	if new_state.enter then
		new_state.enter(self, prev_state)
	end
end

--- 남은 유닛 단위 이동 거리 검사
function local_class:check_remain_distance(direction)
	local diff = 0

	local dir_vector = direction_util.to_vector3_ver2(direction)
	if direction_util.is_side(direction) then
		diff = (self.target_pos.x - self.fo.Position.x) * dir_vector.x
	else
		diff = (self.target_pos.z - self.fo.Position.z) * dir_vector.z
	end

	if diff > 0 then
		start_coroutine(self.move_remain_distance, self, direction)
	else
		self.current_push_state = self.push_state.stopped
	end
end

--- 유닛 단위 이동에 부족한 거리만큼 추가로 움직임
function local_class:move_remain_distance(dir)
	self.current_push_state = self.push_state.move_remain_distance

	local remain_dist = 0
	local speed = CS.Oak.Constants.UnitPushSpeed

	if vector_util.get_x0z(self.target_pos - self.fo.Position).magnitude > 2 then
		speed = CS.Oak.Constants.UnitPushSpeed * 3
	end

	repeat
		local diff = 0
		if self.current_push_state ~= self.push_state.move_remain_distance then
			break
		end

		if direction_util.is_side(dir) then
			diff = self.fo.Position.x - self.target_pos.x
		else
			diff = self.fo.Position.z - self.target_pos.z
		end

		remain_dist = math.abs(diff)

		local moving_dist = speed * unity_class.time.deltaTime

		CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameStageLogic.ExecutePush(self.fo, direction_util.to_vector3_ver2(dir), math.min(remain_dist, moving_dist))

		coroutine.yield(nil)

	until float_util.is_almost_zero(remain_dist)

	self.current_push_state = self.push_state.stopped
end

--- 활성화 되어 있는지
function local_class:is_activate()
	return self.current_fan_state ~= self.fan_state.deactivate
end

--- 오브젝트 위치 및 회전 초기화
function local_class:reset_object()
	if self.fo.Position == self.default_pos and self.fo_head_transform.eulerAngles.y == self.default_angle then
		return
	end

	local prev_effect_pos = self.fo.Bounds.center
	local effect_size = self.fo.Bounds.size

	self.fo.Position = self.default_pos
	self.target_pos = self.default_pos

	self.fo_head_transform.eulerAngles = vector_util.get_x0z(self.fo_head_transform.eulerAngles, self.default_angle)

	local effect_pool = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_reset_object')

	local prev_pos_effect = effect_pool:Instantiate(prev_effect_pos)
	prev_pos_effect.transform.localScale = effect_size

	local reset_pos_effect = effect_pool:Instantiate(self.fo.Bounds.center)
	reset_pos_effect.transform.localScale = effect_size

	self:change_state(self.fan_state.idle)
end

--- 기믹 역회전
function local_class:reverse_rotate()
	self:change_state(self.fan_state.rotation)
	self.current_fan_state.end_angle = self.fo_head_transform.eulerAngles.y - 90
end

return {
	create = function(data_path, data_key, cs_behaviour)
		return local_class(data_path, data_key, cs_behaviour)
	end
}
