		elseif e.JoypadEventType == CS.Oak.JoypadEventType.StickNeutral then
			input_direction = nil
		end
	end

	return true
end

--- TouchEvent 핸들러
local touch_handler = {}
touch_handler.callback = function(_, e)
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	if joypad_escape and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.TouchEventType, CS.Oak.TouchEventType.Action1TouchDown) then
		local success_escape = false
		local move_pos

		local count = 1
		-- 방향키 입력이 없이 액션키 누르면 4방향 조사 (우선순위는 리더가 바람 영향 받을 때 방향으로)
		if not input_direction then
			count = 4
			input_direction = input_leader_direction
		end

		-- 주변 충돌 검색 크기 축소
		local new_bounds = leader.Bounds
		new_bounds.size = new_bounds.size * 0.9

		for i = 1, count do
			-- 4방향 검사
			local direction = direction_util.get_cw_turn(input_direction, i - 1)

			-- 탈출 불가능한 방향이 아닐 경우 장애물 조사하여 탈출 가능 여부 확인
			if not impossible_direction[direction] and wind_infos[leader].fan.Direction ~= direction then
				local fan_bounds = wind_infos[leader].fan.Bounds

				-- 방향 및 바람 기믹 크기에 따른 이동 위치
				if direction_util.is_side_ver2(direction) then
					move_pos = vector_util.get_0yz(leader.Position,
						fan_bounds.center.x + direction_util.to_vector3_ver2(direction).x * (fan_bounds.extents.x + 0.5))
				else
					move_pos = vector_util.get_xy0(leader.Position,
						fan_bounds.center.z + direction_util.to_vector3_ver2(direction).z * (fan_bounds.extents.z + 0.5))
				end

				-- 도착 위치만 조사하여 holdable과 같이 꼈을 때돋 탈출 가능하도록 함
				new_bounds.center = move_pos

				-- 이동하려는 곳에 장애물이 있다면 동작하지 않음
				-- 바닦이 없는 곳은 이동 불가능
				if field:IsThereFloorAt(move_pos) and
					not field:IsAnythingBlockingWithoutBounds(new_bounds, CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Obstacle, unity_class.vector3.zero) then

					input_direction = direction
					success_escape = true
					break
				end
			end
		end

		-- 4방향 중에 탈출이 가능한 곳이 있으면 탈출
		if not success_escape then
			return true
		end

		-- 탈출 성공
		joypad_escape = false
		message_system:Unsubscribe(joypad_handler, typeof(CS.Oak.JoypadEvent))
		field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(leader, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.DPad)

		local action_button = field_ui_manager:GetSingleUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ActionButton)
		action_button.OverridenButtonAction = nil
		field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(leader, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ActionButton)

		-- 탈출 연출
		start_coroutine(escape_wind, move_pos)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

local stage_end_handler = {
	callback = function(_, e)
		message_system:Unsubscribe(joypad_handler, typeof(CS.Oak.JoypadEvent))
		message_system:Unsubscribe(touch_handler, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))
	end
}

--- 대상 추가
function add_target(target, wind_info)
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local prev_info = wind_infos[target]

	-- 플레이어가 대상일 경우 못 가는 방향 추가
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(target, leader) then
		impossible_direction[direction_util.get_opposite_ver2(wind_info.fan.Direction)] = true
	else
		message_system:SendSync(target, CS.Oak.GetThrownEndEvent.Instance)
	end

	-- 바람 요청 저장
	if not wind_request[target] then
		wind_request[target] = {}
	else
		wind_request[target][wind_info.fan] = wind_info
	end

	-- 탈출 상태일 때는 대상 추가하지 않음
	if current_target_state[target] == target_state.escape then
		return
	end

	if prev_info then
		-- 새 요청의 바람 레벨이 기존 바람 레벨보다 낮으면 무시
		if prev_info.wind_level > wind_info.wind_level then
			return
		end

		-- 같은 레벨일 때 처리
		if prev_info.wind_level == wind_info.wind_level then
			-- 이동 상태일 때, 새 요청의 바람 방향이 기존 바람 방향의 반대면 무시
			if current_target_state[target] == target_state.moving and
				prev_info.fan.Direction == direction_util.get_opposite_ver2(wind_info.fan.Direction) then
				return
			end

			-- idle 상태일 때, 새 요청의 선풍기 거리가 더 멀면 무시
			if current_target_state[target] == target_state.idle and
				(prev_info.fan.Position - target.Position).sqrMagnitude < (wind_info.fan.Position - target.Position).sqrMagnitude then
				return
			end
		end
	end

	wind_infos[target] = wind_info
	wind_infos[target].is_center = false
	current_target_state[target] = target_state.idle

	if not wind_routine or wind_routine.IsDone then
		wind_routine = start_coroutine(update_frame)
	end
end

--- 대상 제거
function remove_target(fan, target)
	-- 바람 요청 제거
	if wind_request[target] then
		wind_request[target][fan] = nil
	end

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(target, get_party_leader()) then
		impossible_direction[direction_util.get_opposite_ver2(fan.Direction)] = nil
	end

	if current_target_state[target] == target_state.escape then
		return
	end

	-- 제거 요청한 선풍기와 현재 바람 정보에 있는 선풍기가 같은 경우 제거
	if wind_infos[target] and lua_helper.reference_equals(fan, wind_infos[target].fan) then
		wind_infos[target] = nil

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(target, get_party_leader()) and reset_controllers() then
			return
		end

		refresh_wind_info(target)
	end
end

--- 바람 루틴
function update_frame()
	coroutine.yield(nil)

	repeat
		-- 바람 정보가 있는지
		local is_wind_info = false
		local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime

		for target, wind_info in pairs(wind_infos) do
			--대상이 플레이어일 경우 처리
			local leader = get_party_leader()
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(target, leader) then
				if not stop_control and bounds_util.is_overlapping_xz(wind_info.leader_searching_bounds, target.Bounds) then
					stop_control = true
					stop_control_time = unity_class.time.time
					last_direction_time = unity_class.time.time

					input_leader_direction = leader.Direction

					ride_wind()
					party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

					if leader.CharacterStatsBehaviour ~= nil then
						leader.CharacterStatsBehaviour:AddStatsOptionRequest(
							leader, CS.Oak.CharacterStatsOptions.Invincible)
					end
				end

				if stop_control and unity_class.time.time - last_direction_time > next_direction_time then
					last_direction_time = unity_class.time.time
					character_util.set_direction(leader, direction_util.get_cw_turn(leader.Direction, 1))
				end

				-- 탈출 가능 대기 시간이 지났을 때 조이패드 탈출이 가능함
				if stop_control and not joypad_escape and unity_class.time.time - stop_control_time > waiting_time_to_escape then
					joypad_escape = true

					input_direction = nil
					field_ui_manager:SetUI(leader, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.DPad)
					message_system:Subscribe(joypad_handler, typeof(CS.Oak.JoypadEvent), 'callback')

					field_ui_manager:SetUI(leader, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ActionButton)
					local action_button = field_ui_manager:GetSingleUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ActionButton)
					action_button.OverridenButtonAction = CS.Oak.CharacterControllerManualTouchState.Button1Action.Jump
					message_system:Subscribe(touch_handler, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'callback')

					message_system:SubscribeOnce(stage_end_handler, typeof(CS.Oak.StageEndEvent), 'callback')
				end
			end

			is_wind_info = true

			-- 대상 이동
			if stop_control or not lua_helper.reference_equals(target, leader) then
				move_target(target, wind_info, dt)
			end
		end

		-- 바람 영향 받는 물체 없으면 바로 나가도록
		if not is_wind_info then
			return
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	until not is_wind_info
end

--- 대상 이동
function move_target(target, wind_info, dt)
	current_target_state[target] = target_state.moving

	local fan = wind_info.fan
	local fan_bounds_center = fan.Bounds.center

	-- 중앙으로 이동
	if not wind_info.is_center then
		local dist
		if direction_util.is_side_ver2(fan.Direction) then
			dist = unity_class.vector3.forward * (fan_bounds_center.z - target.Bounds.center.z)
		else
			dist = unity_class.vector3.right * (fan_bounds_center.x - target.Bounds.center.x)
		end

		local dist_magnitude =  dist.magnitude
		if dist_magnitude < 0.01 then
			wind_info.is_center = true

			if direction_util.is_side_ver2(fan.Direction) then
				target.Position = vector_util.get_xy0(target.Position, fan_bounds_center.z)
			else
				target.Position = vector_util.get_0yz(target.Position, fan_bounds_center.x)
			end
		else
			CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameStageLogic.ExecuteMove(target, dist.normalized, dist_magnitude * 10 * dt)
		end
	end

	CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameStageLogic.ExecuteMove(target, direction_util.to_vector3_ver2(fan.Direction), wind_speed * dt)

	-- 적용 중인 바람이 반대 방향이라 무시하고 있던 바람 기믹에 충돌했을 때 충돌한 선풍기 바람에 영향 받도록 함
	local obj_list = CS.Oak.LuaCollisionUtil.GetFieldObjectsCollidedBy(
		target.Bounds, direction_util.to_vector3_ver2(fan.Direction) * wind_speed * dt)

	for i = 0, obj_list.Count - 1 do
		local obj = obj_list[i]
		if obj.Direction == direction_util.get_opposite_ver2(fan.Direction) and
			lua_helper.type_compare(obj.FieldObjectBehaviour, CS.Oak.LuaGimmickBehaviour) and
			obj.FieldObjectBehaviour.ScriptName == 'WindFan' and wind_request[target][obj] then

			wind_infos[target] = nil
			add_target(target, wind_request[target][obj])
		end
	end

	obj_list:Dispose()
end

--- 탈출 연출
function escape_wind(move_pos)
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	-- 상태 변경
	current_target_state[leader] = target_state.escape
	wind_infos[leader] = nil

	if player_sfx then
		music_player_util.stop_sfx(player_sfx)
		player_sfx = nil
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_small_jump_01')

	local duration = 0.3
	character_util.jump(leader, 0.5, duration)
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(leader, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_anim_non_loop(leader, 'get')
	wp_util.move_async(leader, move_pos, nil, duration)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_land_01')

	current_target_state[leader] = target_state.idle

	if reset_controllers() then
		return
	end

	ride_wind()

	refresh_wind_info(leader)
end

-- 바람 정보 갱신
function refresh_wind_info(target)
	for _, wind_info in pairs(wind_request[target]) do
		add_target(target, wind_info)
	end
end

--- 리더를 대상으로 하는 바람이 있는지 체크 후 컨트롤 리셋
function reset_controllers()
	if not stop_control then
		return
	end

	local leader = get_party_leader()
	for _, _ in pairs(wind_request[leader]) do
		return false
	end

	-- 리더를 대상으로 하는 바람이 없다면
	stop_control = false
	joypad_escape = false
	message_system:Unsubscribe(joypad_handler, typeof(CS.Oak.JoypadEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(touch_handler, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))

	local action_button = field_ui_manager:GetSingleUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ActionButton)
	action_button.OverridenButtonAction = nil
	field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(leader, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ActionButton)
	field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(leader, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.DPad)

	if player_sfx then
		music_player_util.stop_sfx(player_sfx)
		player_sfx = nil
	end

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
	party_util.reset_controllers()

	if leader.CharacterStatsBehaviour ~= nil then
		leader.CharacterStatsBehaviour:RemoveStatsOptionRequest(leader, CS.Oak.CharacterStatsOptions.Invincible)
	end

	for i = 1, user_party.Count - 1 do
		local party_member = user_party[i]
		party_member.Position = leader.Position
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(party_member, 1, 0.3)
		field_ui_manager:SetUI(party_member, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
	end

	return true
end

-- 바람 탑승 연출
function ride_wind()
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	local target_dir = direction_util.to_side_dir(leader.Direction)
	character_util.set_direction(leader, target_dir)
	leader:SetLockedDirection(self, CS.Oak.LockDirectionRequest.Create(target_dir, CS.Oak.LockDirectionPriorities.Custom))

	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(leader, 'surprise')
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(leader, 'embarrassed')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_prologue_wind_01')

	leader.CharacterBehaviour:CancelAllBattleActions(true)

	leader:RemoveLockedDirection(self)

	if not player_sfx then
		player_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_runaway_01', loop = true, parent = leader })
	end

	for i = 1, user_party.Count - 1 do
		local party_member = user_party[i]
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(party_member, 0, 0.4)
		field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(party_member, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
	end
end

return {
	add_target = add_target,
	remove_target = remove_target
}

local local_class = newclass('LuaActionManager')

function local_class:init(cs_behaviour)
	-- 루아 엑션 부르고 싶은면 카테고리 별로 여기에 추가
	self.lua_tables = {
		--자석 관련 루아 엑션
		['MagnetLuaActions'] = get_or_create_global_table('LuaActionManager/MagnetLuaActions.lua')
	}

	for _, v in pairs(self.lua_tables) do
		local init = v['init']

		if init ~= nil then
			init()
		end
	end
end

function local_class:execute_lua_action(table_name, function_name, e)
	local table = self.lua_tables[table_name]

	if table ~= nil then
		local action = table[function_name]

		if action ~= nil then
			return action(e)
		else
			CS.UnityEngine.Debug.LogError('LuaActionManager.lua : lua function is null')
		end
	else
		CS.UnityEngine.Debug.LogError("LuaActionManager.lua : lua table is null");
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- lua_tables 내부의 의 global_table은 dispose 따로 불리고 있음
	self.lua_tables = nil
end

return {
	create = function(cs_behaviour)
		return local_class(cs_behaviour)
	end
}

local magnet_lua_actions = {}

magnet_lua_actions['magnetic_characters'] = {}

magnet_lua_actions.character_fx = {
	metal = 'fx_gimmick_char_magnetic_fx'
	--north_magnet = 'fx_gimmick_char_magnetic_fx',
	--south_magnet = 'fx_gimmick_char_magnetic_fx',
	--bipolar = 'fx_gimmick_char_magnetic_fx'
}

function magnet_lua_actions.init()
	-- 캐릭터 이팩트를 미리 로드한다.
	if magnet_lua_actions.character_fx ~= nil then
		for _, fx_name in pairs(magnet_lua_actions.character_fx) do
			unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(fx_name)
		end
	end
end

--자석에 의해 움직이기 시작
function magnet_lua_actions.start_moving_by_magnet(e)
	local fo = e.Sender

	if fo.Magnetizable.IsAffectingByMagnet then
		if lua_helper.type_compare(fo, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObject)) then
			magnet_lua_actions.turn_on_off_field_object_effect_by_state(fo, true)
		elseif lua_helper.type_compare(fo, typeof(CS.Oak.Character)) then
			magnet_lua_actions.turn_on_off_character_effect_by_state(fo, true)
		end

		music_player_util.play_sfx({
			sfx_name = '01_magnetic_01',
			parent = fo,
			type_priority = 'gimmick',
			player_priority = 'object'
		})
	end
end

--자석이 다른 금속 물체에게 힘을 가하기 시작
function magnet_lua_actions.start_applying_force(e)
	local fo = e.Sender

	if fo.Magnetizable.IsApplyingMagnetForce then
		if lua_helper.type_compare(fo, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObject)) then
			magnet_lua_actions.turn_on_off_field_object_effect_by_state(fo, true)
		elseif lua_helper.type_compare(fo, typeof(CS.Oak.Character)) then
			magnet_lua_actions.turn_on_off_character_effect_by_state(fo, true)
		end

		music_player_util.play_sfx({
			sfx_name = '01_magnetic_02',
			parent = fo,
			type_priority = 'gimmick',
			player_priority = 'object'
		})
	end
end

--이팩트를 끈다
function magnet_lua_actions.turn_off_effect(e)
	local fo = e.Sender
	local isDisabled = fo.ActiveState == active_state('disabled')

	if lua_helper.type_compare(fo, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObject)) then
		-- 폭탄은 폴발할 때 스테이트를 FieldObjectIdleState로 바꾸기 때문에 자석의 영향권 안에 있어도 State를 Exit한다.
		-- 따라서 위의 경우로 이 함수가 호출 되더라도 자석의 이팩트를 꺼야한다.
		local isBomb = lua_helper.type_compare(fo.FieldObjectBehaviour, CS.Oak.BarrelFieldObjectBehaviour) or
				lua_helper.type_compare(fo.FieldObjectBehaviour, CS.Oak.BombFieldObjectBehaviour)

		if (not fo.Magnetizable.IsAffectingByMagnet and not fo.Magnetizable.IsApplyingMagnetForce) or
				(isDisabled and isBomb) then
			magnet_lua_actions.turn_on_off_field_object_effect_by_state(fo, false)
		end
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(fo, typeof(CS.Oak.Character)) then
		if (not fo.Magnetizable.IsAffectingByMagnet and not fo.Magnetizable.IsApplyingMagnetForce) or
				isDisabled then
			magnet_lua_actions.turn_on_off_character_effect_by_state(fo, false)
		end
	end
end

function magnet_lua_actions.turn_on_off_field_object_effect_by_state(fo, state)
	local idx = fo.Transform.childCount - 1

	while idx >= 0 do
		local child_transform = fo.Transform:GetChild(idx)

		if child_transform.name == 'MagnetFX' then
			child_transform.gameObject:SetActive(state)
			break
		end

		idx = idx - 1
	end
end

function magnet_lua_actions.turn_on_off_character_effect_by_state(character, state)
	local character_unique_key = tostring(character.EntityId)
	local magnetic_characters = magnet_lua_actions.magnetic_characters

	if state == true then
		if magnetic_characters[character_unique_key] == nil then
			local fx = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_gimmick_char_magnetic_fx'):Instantiate(character.Bounds.center,
					unity_class.quaternion.identity, character.Transform)

			magnetic_characters[character_unique_key] = fx
		end

		magnetic_characters[character_unique_key].gameObject:SetActive(true)
	else
		if magnetic_characters[character_unique_key] ~= nil then
			magnetic_characters[character_unique_key].gameObject:SetActive(false)
		end
	end
end

function magnet_lua_actions.dispose()
	if magnet_lua_actions.magnetic_characters ~= nil then
		for _, fx in pairs(magnet_lua_actions.magnetic_characters) do
			if fx ~= nil then
				fx:Dispose()
				fx = nil
			end
